title.en: Sean wanted to raise his son here. Then came the 'massive black box'
title.zh: 肖恩想在这里抚养他的儿子。然后出现了“巨大的黑匣子”

summary.en: New rules aim to protect future communities. Residents already living with the impacts say they're being left behind.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及盼望、忍耐与重建。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
When Sean Brown moved to West Footscray two years ago, days after his son was born, he thought he'd found a good spot to raise a family — green space, a train station nearby, and a community with room to grow.

Instead, his home is now 300 metres from one of the largest data centres in the country.

"It's a massive black box in the middle of a residential area. There's this visual heaviness to it that you can't really escape," Brown tells SBS News.

NextDC's M3 facility in the Melbourne suburb brings a constant humming noise audible even 100m away, he says, while ongoing construction means near-constant light, noise and disruption.

Parking is scarce with facility workers competing for street spots, and Brown says whole streets have lost power for full days at a time during infrastructure works, with little warning and no compensation. He's also worried about health risks, and the future of his entire suburb.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Branded by its chief executive, Craig Scroggie, as "Australia's largest hyperscale AI factory", the M3 site is set to double in size by 2027 — covering 10 hectares in size, and drawing 225MW of power, 24 hours a day.

A separate facility, the Perri Melbourne Data Centre (PMDC), has been approved and planned just a few blocks over.

There are currently 162 operational data centres across Australia, with a further 90 proposed, according to the Climate Council — and it's unclear whether planned rules to data centres in residential areas will apply to any of them.

Prime Minister Anthony Albanese will use a speech to the Business Council of Australia's annual dinner on Tuesday night to announce new national rules that would block future data centres from being built near homes, schools, or prime agricultural land.

Developers will also be required to add more renewable energy to the grid than their data centres consume, minimise water use, and ensure new sites are appropriate for their size — avoiding land that could otherwise be used for housing.

"Australia is in a strong position to attract investment in data centres, but maintaining social licence will be essential," Albanese will say.

"That means ensuring energy bills do not rise, water security is maintained and locations are appropriate."

Asked about communities already living with data centres, Albanese did not directly answer when pressed on ABC Perth on Tuesday, instead pointing to the same social licence framework.

Asked by SBS News whether any measures would target existing sites or address community concern that the new rules don't cover people already affected, the prime minister's office declined to comment.

title.en: The 'extraordinarily expensive' project reshaping a state — and drawing political battlelines
title.zh: “极其昂贵”的项目正在重塑一个州——并划定政治战线

summary.en: Victoria's Premier Ben Carroll has announced a $2 billion reduction in the cost of the state's largest infrastructure project, the Suburban Rail Loop. This pivot comes amid ongoing debate over the project's "extraordinarily expensive" nature, its disputed economic benefits, and its lengthy construction timeline.

body.en:
Victorian Premier Ben Carroll has announced $2 billion in cuts to the state's largest infrastructure project, the Suburban Rail Loop (SRL), saying: "I respect your money."

His comments underline the controversy over the 90km underground rapid transit project, which will link Melbourne's middle suburbs and allow passengers to travel across the city without passing through the CBD.

The state government says the mega-project will reshape Melbourne into a multi-nodal city, bringing services and jobs closer to where people live, building more homes, and creating more jobs.

But its enormous cost, disputed economic benefits and lengthy construction timeline have also made it one of Australia's most controversial infrastructure projects.

Liam Davies, a lecturer in sustainability and urban planning at RMIT University, said the SRL was a step towards transforming Melbourne's city-centric public transport system into an interconnected network.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"Melbourne's greatest challenge is that it has become an extraordinarily large city, physically," he told SBS News.

"We can't just adopt the transport strategy for a denser, more compact city like London. We need to do something of our own, and the SRL is an attempt to do that in a Melburnian context."

With Labor and the Coalition deeply divided on the SRL, the project's future could be decided when Victorians head to the polls in November.

The SRL will connect Melbourne's middle suburbs from Cheltenham in the south-east to Werribee in the west via Melbourne Airport through a 90km underground rail line.

The project is split into three stages. The first section — SRL East — is under construction, running from Cheltenham to Box Hill via six new underground stations. The first trains are expected by 2035.

Critics argue the mega-project's business case doesn't stack up, and the multi-billion-dollar price tag is a financial liability for Victoria, which has the second-highest debt per capita of any state or territory, behind the Northern Territory.

More than $33 billion has already been invested in SRL East, according to the premier.

A Parliamentary Budget Office analysis puts the price tag for building the East and North sections at $96.4 billion, though there is currently no fully costed estimate for the entire project, which includes the final stage, SRL West.

An evaluation last year by Infrastructure Australia — an advisory body to the federal government — found the SRL's business case was insufficiently detailed and relied on future stages to justify its benefits.

title.en: 'Get it out': ARIA to ban AI-generated music from Australian charts
title.zh: “Get it out”：ARIA 将禁止人工智能生成的音乐出现在澳大利亚排行榜上

summary.en: ARIA says that songs must be "substantially human-made" to qualify for a spot on its long-running music charts.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Music will need to be "substantially human-made" in order to qualify for Australia's main music chart, in an industry bid to stamp out AI-generated tracks.

Songs wholly generated using artificial intelligence will no longer be eligible for the ARIA charts from Friday, in an update to The Australian Recording Industry Association's (ARIA) code of practice.

ARIA chief executive Annabelle Herd said a chart that rewards unlicensed AI output would "undercut the very basis of the recorded music we exist to present".

"The ARIA charts are about tracking consumption and sales of music in Australia, but they're also about celebrating human artistry and success," Herd told ABC radio.

"We're not particularly interested in including AI-generated music as part of that process, particularly when it's taking up a spot from an Australian artist in the chart."

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

AI-assisted songs will still feature on the charts, but they must be substantially human-made and raise no stream or chart manipulation concerns.

"I'm sure that there are a lot of artists that are using AI tools to enhance creativity, to do really cool, new, exciting things," Herd said.

"Artists have always been at the forefront of new tech ... it's made some of the best music ever created, and no doubt AI will create some really exciting evolution of that."

Songs on the ARIA charts that use AI include Gold Coast-based DJ and producer Josh Fawaz's dance track Like a Prayer, which is fourth on the ARIA's top 20 Australian singles after peaking at number two in May.

A dance cover of Madonna's 1989 hit, generative AI is credited for the drums and vocals on the track, according to Spotify.

Australian electronic band Peking Duk supported the association's call to outlaw generative AI from the charts, claiming it was "removing the human experience from life".

"AI is using our stuff. It's using a lot of our peers' stuff, you know, people we know," band member Adam Hyde told Channel Nine's Today show .

"There is so much good art in Australia and something like AI coming along and kind of sweeping the charts and all that jazz, it's like, get it out."

ARIA's decision heeds global AI principles drawn up by the record industry's peak body, The International Federation of the Phonographic Industry, in July.

The federation said the guidelines would be rolled out to official charts in Latin America, the Middle East, Africa and Southeast Asia and advocated to more than 20 other official chart programs in Europe and the Pacific, including the ARIAs.

title.en: A common tax misconception could catch some Australians by surprise
title.zh: 常见的税收误解可能会让一些澳大利亚人感到惊讶

summary.en: Online sellers could be overlooking a key distinction that affects their tax obligations.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及管家责任、供应与公共福祉。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
It’s now easier than ever to sell your unwanted clothes or household items online in Australia. Many popular sites, from eBay, Depop, Facebook Marketplace to newly arrived competitors like Vinted, have either scrapped or limited their seller’s fees, depending on the location, value and number of items sold.

So when do you need to declare your online sales income to the Australian Taxation Office and pay tax on it?

The answer can be as messy as your wardrobe. Be aware there is no minimum value of sales that triggers taxation obligations in Australia.

Digging into the law reveals key questions to consider whether you’re spring cleaning your wardrobe to get some cash for the latest fashion, selling a more valuable asset, or starting to run a business.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Two of the biggest online sales sites, eBay and Amazon, are required to provide lots of transaction data to the tax office.

What about selling goods on other platforms? The tax office may be tracking that too. Its tentacles are vast, with more than 600 million transactions reported and matched to taxpayers every year from a wide variety of private and public sources.

Even if a platform is not required to report, the transactions may still be captured through credit and debit card payment systems, such as Stripe or Square.

The tax office can also request information from the banks. It may even gather information via insurers on unexplained wealth based on "lifestyle assets" – such as cars, boats or art – you may own. There are also examples of taxpayers being caught out with unexplained deposits leading to hefty tax bills.

Let’s say you found a dress in your wardrobe that you bought for A$250, wore once, but don’t like. So you decide to sell it on eBay or Amazon, rather than giving it away.

You list it and sell it for $100. While you’ve now got $100 more than before, you have really lost $150 overall.

This is not a sound business model. Anything you sell actually comes at a cost to you; think profit, not just sales.

The tax office is unlikely to be interested in these types of occasional, low-value, generally loss-making personal-type activities.

In this scenario, where you’re just cashing in on your existing wardrobe, the tax office is likely to consider it private in nature and just a "hobby".

This is unlikely to create a tax bill. However, you still may need to declare certain activity and have records to support your position.

What happens when you go from selling just a few old dresses to spotting a market opportunity? Perhaps you start to develop a pattern of buying vintage clothes from...
body.zh: 现在在澳大利亚在线出售不需要的衣服或家居用品比以往任何时候都更容易。许多受欢迎的网站，从 eBay、Depop、Facebook Marketplace 到像 Vinted 这样的新来的竞争对手，都已经取消或限制了卖家的费用，具体取决于所售商品的位置、价值和数量。 那么您什么时候需要向澳大利亚税务局申报您的网上销售收入并纳税呢？ 答案可能和你的衣柜一样混乱。请注意，澳大利亚没有触发纳税义务的最低销售价值。 深入研究这条法律，可以揭示出你是在春季大扫除衣柜以换取最新时尚的现金、出售更有价值的资产还是开始经营企业时需要考虑的关键问题。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 最大的两个在线销售网站 eBay 和亚马逊需要向税务局提供大量交易数据。 那么在其他平台上销售商品呢？税务局可能也在追踪这一点。它的触角很大，每年通过各种私人和公共来源向纳税人报告和匹配超过 6 亿笔交易。 即使平台不需要报告，交易仍然可以通过信用卡和借记卡支付系统（例如 Stripe 或 Square）捕获。 税务局还可以向银行索取信息。它甚至可能通过保险公司收集基于您可能拥有的“生活方式资产”（例如汽车、船只或艺术品）的无法解释的财富信息。也有纳税人因不明原因存款而被查出导致巨额税款的例子。 假设您在衣柜里发现了一件花 250 澳元买的衣服，穿过一次，但不喜欢。因此，您决定在 eBay 或亚马逊上出售它，而不是赠送它。 您将其列出并以 100 美元的价格出售。虽然您现在比以前多了 100 美元，但实际上总共损失了 150 美元。 这不是一个健全的商业模式。你出售的任何东西实际上都会给你带来成本；考虑利润，而不仅仅是销售额。 税务局不太可能对这些偶尔发生的、低价值的、通常亏损的个人活动感兴趣。 在这种情况下，如果您只是利用现有的衣柜赚钱，税务局可能会认为它本质上是私人的，只是一种“爱好”。 这不太可能产生税收法案。但是，您可能仍然需要申报某些活动并有记录来支持您的立场。 当您从只出售几件旧衣服到发现市场机会时会发生什么？也许您开始养成从以下地方购买复古服装的习惯：

title.en: 'Contaminated': How deadly bird flu crossed a new threshold in Australia
title.zh: 澳大利亚达到“毁灭性”禽流感里程碑。接下来会发生什么？

summary.en: The deadly H5N1 strain of avian influenza has been detected in a mammal in South Australia, marking the first confirmed bird-to-mammal transmission in the country. Experts warn this is just the beginning and anticipate widespread mortalities among native birds and mammals.
summary.zh: 致命的H5N1禽流感病毒株已在南澳大利亚的一种哺乳动物身上被检测到，这标志着该国首次确认禽类与哺乳动物之间的传播。专家警告说，这仅仅是个开始，预计当地鸟类和哺乳动物将出现大规模死亡。

body.en:
The "devastating" H5N1 variant of avian influenza marked a grim milestone on Sunday as the first confirmed case of transmission between bird and mammal species was recorded, with experts warning the worst is yet to come.

A long-nosed fur seal was confirmed to have died of the disease in coastal South Australia, with a second case being investigated in a seal in The Pages Conservation Park islands near Kangaroo Island on Monday.

Earlier, Environment Minister Murray Watt said the country needed to be "realistic" about the impact this illness will have on native wildlife.

"We are likely to see mass mortalities of birds and mammals, and I know that is a very distressing thing for Australians to hear," Watt told ABC television.

Sean Dooley of the avian conservation group BirdLife Australia told SBS News that the virus could have an ecology-shifting impact.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"That's why we need an effective response, where we can, to mitigate the losses.

"We also need a massive increase in the resources that go into ensuring resilient populations of as many of our species, or else we're going to be facing a real ongoing crisis beyond the actual outbreak."

Avian influenza, a flu-type virus, is airborne and contracted by birds and other mammals when they breathe or ingest it from an infected animal.

Robyn Alders, an honorary professor at the Development Policy Centre at Australian National University, told SBS News that the virus also survives outside of a host animal.

"Even if you can't see a diseased carcass or a dead animal, it doesn't mean that the environment there is safe," she said.

"Particularly now that we're starting to see areas where you've got larger die-offs, the potential contamination in that area is going to be significant."

In cooler temperatures where water is present, Alders said there is evidence H5N1 can survive for days.

In areas where the virus has yet to arrive, Dooley recommends people continue spending time in nature and report anything they suspect could be bird flu-related to the emergency animal disease hotline.

"That's still really valuable because it can help slow the spread as they remove those birds which are potential sources of infection," he said.

Cats are particularly susceptible to the disease, and Alders recommends people keep their cats indoors as the virus has a "50 per cent" mortality rate for them.

Bird flu vaccinations are underway in specific, suitable populations at the moment, but experts question whether the government is adequately prepared.

Dooley said the country is in a stronger position now than it was a few years ago, but that government claims to have "done everything...

Yahweh's word tells us that the whole creation groans, a truth echoed in the distress of ecosystems facing new threats. This moment calls us to acknowledge the...

title.en: 'Alarm bells': How Australia ended up back where it started
title.zh: “警钟敲响”：1940年代现象重现，这些澳大利亚人面临的持续现实

summary.en: A recent analysis indicates that homeownership rates for younger Australians (25-34 years old) have fallen to levels last seen in the 1940s, with fewer than 40% owning their homes. This stagnation occurs amidst rising home prices and rents, making it increasingly difficult for this demographic to save for a mortgage....
summary.zh: 最新分析显示，年轻澳大利亚人（25至34岁）的住房拥有率已降至1940年代的水平，其中不足40%的人拥有自己的住房。这种停滞发生在房价和租金上涨的背景下，使得这一年龄段的人群越来越难以储蓄以支付抵押贷款。一位专家指出，基本政策领域的失误是导致这一趋势的原因之一。

body.en:
The number of younger Australians who own their own homes has stagnated, sitting at around the same levels recorded during World War Two, as the cost of living and rents rise.

Fewer than 40 per cent of 25 to 34-year-olds were listed as homeowners in the 2021 Census, and that rate is expected to have fallen since, according to analysis from social welfare charity Anglicare Australia.

This is equivalent to the homeownership rate recorded in the 1940s, before the post-war boom took hold as multiple policies prioritised construction and housing for veterans.

At the same time, home prices and rents have risen, putting pressure on younger Australians to save for a mortgage while living away from home.

A recent report from property data company Cotality has shown that rents in some parts of Australia have soared by 80 per cent over the last five years, since COVID-era rent freezes were lifted.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Anglicare Australia said that support lines for younger people are dominated by stress over housing security and related bills.

"It's almost impossible to have a call from a younger person who doesn’t mention the stress of rents or bills," Anglicare Australia executive director Kasy Chambers told SBS News.

"They are studying, working and contributing. But they are earning less than the generations before them, being locked out of housing, and struggling to build the security that past generations took for granted."

Home ownership has steadily declined across age groups since the 1970s, but younger Australians have felt the sharpest declines, according to the Australian Bureau of Statistics.

Angela Jackson, an economist at the Productivity Commission, the Australian government's independent economic advisory body, said home ownership is particularly hard for lower socioeconomic groups.

"It is a lot more expensive relative to people's incomes to get into the housing market than it was for Gen Z's parents or grandparents," she told SBS News.

Home ownership rates have declined generation on generation in Australia, off the back of the housing boom in the post-war era.

Liz Allen, a demographer and social researcher from ANU, described 1940s Australians as going through "tough times".

"There were issues with inequalities, especially around education, geographic and income and wealth inequality," she said.

"I think it would be fair to say that the inequalities faced in that period and the global shocks during that period surpassed those that we're experiencing now."

Home ownership across all ages was lower than it is today, with younger people aged 25-34 the least likely to own property.

title.en: 130,000 or 230,000? The migration figures One Nation is trying to explain
title.zh: 13万还是23万？一国组织试图解释的移民数据

summary.en: Conflicting comments from One Nation figures have raised questions about the party's migration target.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
One Nation MP Barnaby Joyce has faced questions over his party's immigration target, claiming fellow MP David Farley misspoke when he revealed their figures were "not too different" from Labor's.

The MP for Farrer told ABC's Insiders program on Sunday that One Nation's stated figure of 130,000 net overseas migration annually into Australia did not include those who enter under a Pacific labour scheme, aged-care nurses, and other in-demand skilled workers.

He conceded that those groups would add roughly 100,000 people, bringing their total to 230,000 — 5,000 fewer than the current Labor budget projections.

Party leader Pauline Hanson intervened just hours later, writing on social media that One Nation's policy is to reduce net overseas migration (NOM) to 130,000.

Speaking to Channel Seven's Sunrise program on Monday, Joyce added that Farley simply made a mistake while explaining the numbers.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"Show me a political career where people haven't made a mistake, and I'll show you a person who's not told the truth," Joyce said.

"I'm not going to throw anybody under a bus. When people are new in parliament, they can sometimes get things incorrect, and that's what happens. God knows, I've done it enough."

The debate over Australia's migration figures has intensified in recent months, with a recent Redbridge/Accent Research poll, conducted for the Australian Financial Review, indicating that voters trust One Nation and its traditionally restrictive approach to handle migration better than Labor or the Liberal Party.

However, the disjointed nature of One Nation's ongoing public discourse on the topic has prompted claims that the party is "incoherent" and "not fit to govern" from federal minister Pat Conroy.

Since its 1997 inception, cutting immigration has been seemingly a foundational pillar of One Nation policy. During her first speech to federal parliament, Hanson alleged Australia was in danger of being "swamped by Asians", that migrants never assimilated, and that multiculturalism should be abolished.

Its website currently states One Nation would "cut immigration by over 570,000 people" through "capping visas at 130,000 per year".

In a social media post on Sunday, Hanson wrote that NOM would be cut to 130,000 — a figure the party has previously clarified to SBS News . This number would be achieved by reducing international students, temporary graduate visas, and a "much more targeted" skilled migration program, Hanson said.

Those figures are different to the ones put forward by Farley, who said One Nation is focusing on "the NOM in its true form", as separate to labour programs "that drive our...
body.zh: 一国党议员巴纳比·乔伊斯 (Barnaby Joyce) 面临有关该党移民目标的质疑，声称同僚议员戴维·法利 (David Farley) 在透露他们的数字与工党的数字“相差不大”时说错了话。 法雷尔议员周日告诉美国广播公司的 Insiders 节目，一国党公布的每年有 13 万名海外净移民进入澳大利亚的数字不包括根据太平洋劳工计划进入的人、老年护理护士和其他急需的技术工人。 他承认这些团体将增加大约 10 万人，使总人数达到 23 万人——比当前工党预算预测少 5,000 人。 几小时后，该党领导人保琳·汉森(Pauline Hanson)介入，她在社交媒体上写道，一国党的政策是将海外净移民(NOM)减少到13万人。 乔伊斯周一在第七频道的《日出》节目中补充说，法利只是在解释这些数字时犯了一个错误。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 乔伊斯说：“向我展示一个人们没有犯过错误的政治生涯，我就会向你展示一个没有说实话的人。” “我不会把任何人扔到公共汽车下。当人们刚进入议会时，他们有时会弄错事情，这就是发生的事情。上帝知道，我已经做得足够多了。” 近几个月来，有关澳大利亚移民数据的争论愈演愈烈，Redbridge/Accent Research 最近为《澳大利亚金融评论》进行的一项民意调查显示，选民相信一国党及其传统的限制性政策，能够比工党或自由党更好地处理移民问题。 然而，一国党持续就这一话题进行的公开讨论的脱节性质促使联邦部长帕特·康罗伊声称该党“语无伦次”且“不适合执政”。 自 1997 年推出以来，减少移民似乎一直是一国政策的基本支柱。汉森在联邦议会的第一次演讲中声称澳大利亚面临“被亚洲人淹没”的危险，移民永远不会被同化，多元文化主义应该被废除。 其网站目前表示，一国党将通过“每年 13 万个签证上限”来“减少超过 57 万移民”。 汉森在周日的社交媒体帖子中写道，NOM 将削减至 13 万人——该党此前已向 SBS 新闻澄清了这一数字。汉森表示，这一数字将通过减少国际学生、临时毕业生签证和“更有针对性”的技术移民计划来实现。 这些数字与法利提出的数字不同，法利表示，一国党正在关注“真正形式的 NOM”，与“推动我们……的劳工计划”分开。

title.en: Rush to vaccinate little penguins against H5N1 as another seal is diagnosed
title.zh: 随着另一只海豹被诊断出感染H5N1，人们正紧急为小企鹅接种疫苗

summary.en: A second seal in South Australia has likely contracted the H5N1 bird flu virus, prompting an urgent vaccination program for the iconic little penguin population on Phillip Island to prevent further spread.
summary.zh: 南澳大利亚的第二只海豹可能感染了H5N1禽流感病毒，促使菲利普岛紧急启动了为其标志性小企鹅种群接种疫苗的计划，以防止病毒进一步传播。

body.en:
Bird flu has likely spread to a second seal, one day after the first mammal in Australia was confirmed to have contracted the virus.

Five suspected H5 bird flu cases were recorded in South Australia on Monday, including a long-nosed fur seal at The Pages Conservation Park, the state's Department of Primary Industries and Regions said in a statement on Monday morning.

The Pages — which covers two small islands between Kangaroo Island and the mainland — is a haven for the endangered Australian sea lion.

The fur seal has been tested for bird flu, with results expected in the coming days.

The first positive case of the virus in a mammal was confirmed on Sunday in a long-nosed fur seal at Beachport, 300km south of Adelaide, which authorities believed was contracted from wild birds.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Before the new case was announced, Environment Minister Murray Watt said the spread from birds to mammals was inevitable and the government was examining whether further vaccination programs were needed.

"We are likely to see mass mortalities of birds and mammals, and I know that is a very distressing thing for Australians to hear. But we also need to be realistic," he told ABC TV on Monday.

"This is what we've seen happen overseas. Australia is very fortunate that we've been the last continent on Earth to have this strain of bird flu happen. But we are likely to see those kind of events as we have overseas."

Agriculture Minister Julie Collins said the federal government was investigating whether bird flu vaccines were available for use in mammals.

"There are trials underway in North America, in California and Hawaii, and this is using a vaccine that's been developed for cattle," she told ABC radio.

"There certainly is nothing commercially available, but we do continue to look at that research."

Bird flu vaccinations have been rolled out to at-risk species, including the little penguins on Victoria's Phillip Island.

Many were corralled into pens to receive the first of two vaccinations on Sunday night.

With case numbers on the rise, authorities have stepped in to do what they can to defend the 5,000-strong colony.

The penguins' nightly ritual of returning to the same burrow, along the same path, made them ideal candidates for vaccination, Phillip Island Nature Parks reserve manager Ben Thomas said.

As a world-first in scale, the process has taken some experimentation and fine-tuning.

"We've had our teams out late into the night for a week now and learning a lot along the process," Thomas said.

"We started on some of the quieter penguin pathways to fine-tune the whole process and get it working as quickly as we...

body.en: A consortium of mainland Chinese firms and a local property company has been awarded a HK$1.03 billion tender for the first major land parcel to be developed as part of the Northern Metropolis mega project in the northern New Territories. Hung Shui Kiu. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. However, the fact that the consortium will operate only one of the three tech parks on the plot, with the government to oversee the others, may indicate that the market remains “cautious” about investing in the infrastructure project, a former lawmaker said . The six enterprises, consisting of both state-owned and private firms, have projected an investment of about HK$16.8 billion in the Hung Shui Kiu/Ha Tsuen New Development Area, which is expected to create 6,000 jobs and provide 3,000 residential flats, according to a Monday statement . The six-company joint venture, HSK New Development, comprises subsidiaries of China Overseas Land & Investment, China Merchants Land, China Resources Land (Overseas), China Tourism Group, and e-commerce giant JD.com, as well as Hong Kong developer Sino Land. The 11-hectare Hung Shui Kiu/Ha Tsuen site is the first “large-scale land disposal” in the Northern Metropolis to be tendered. Secretary for Development Bernadette Linn said in the Monday statement that the plot “is a project of considerable scale with a long investment period.” “The consortium of successful tenderers encompasses not only major enterprises that have long participated in local real estate development, but also market leaders that are well-established in other industries with undeniable experience and capability,” Linn said. Hong Kong’s border areas near Shenzhen is set to be transformed into a 30,000-hectare Northern Metropolis. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The firms had pooled their strengths to “cast a vote of confidence” in the Northern Metropolis, she said. The Northern Metropolis is a sprawling infrastructure project set to transform 30,000 hectares of land in rural Hong Kong near the border with mainland China into a tech hub, providing more homes and deepening the city’s integration with neighbouring Shenzhen. The government adopted a “two-envelope” system when assessing the tenders, with a 30 per cent weighting for bids’ monetary value and 70 per cent for non-monetary benefits such as creating jobs and bringing in high-quality enterprises. Remaining cautious The joint venture will be responsible for developing three residential sites that can yield about 3,000 flats, as well as an Enterprise and Technology Park. They will be granted to the consortium on 50-year leases. The consortium will also build a large-scale modern logistics hub within the park, with e-commerce titan JD.com positioned as the anchor tenant. Hung Shui Kiu in Hong Kong. File...

title.en: Three helpers warned for using bosses' data for loans
title.zh: 三名帮工因使用老板数据贷款而被警告

summary.en: The Office of the Privacy Commissioner for Personal Data has issued warning letters to three foreign domestic helpers for misusing employers' personal data for loan applications without consent. Its announcement on Tuesday about the letters came after the watchdog received...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: The Office of the Privacy Commissioner for Personal Data has issued warning letters to three foreign domestic helpers for misusing employers' personal data for loan applications without consent. Its announcement on Tuesday about the letters came after the watchdog received complaints from employers of the helpers. It said financial institutions contacted two of the complainants and requested them up to four times a day to remind the migrant workers to settle their debts, while the third employer received overdue payment notices addressed to his helper. One firm also warned that a debt collector would head to the home of one of the employers if repayments were not made by the deadline. All three helpers were dismissed after they defaulted on repayments. They also admitted to offering their employers' personal information – including names, home addresses and telephone numbers – to local and overseas lenders in the process of applying for loans. One of the three applied to four financial institutions for loans. Privacy commissioner Ada Chung said these migrant workers contravened the Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance as they failed to obtain permission to use the particulars of their employers for loan applications. "We have explained the requirements of the ordinance in question to them clearly," she said. "We are aware that they understand the requirements, and they have agreed that they will not commit the same mistake in the future." The trio are required to strictly comply with the ordinance, Chung added. She also said they would not be prosecuted. "In any prosecution, we have to prove that the person in question has the relevant criminal intent," Chung said. The watchdog called on employers to make it clear to foreign domestic helpers that their personal information may only be used for matters related to employment and that the helpers should obtain their consent before using it for other purposes. They should also be careful when signing documents for workers and study the contents carefully. For migrant workers, the watchdog prepared a pamphlet that also comes in Tagalog and Bahasa Indonesia with the aim of raising their awareness on using employers' personal data. Meanwhile, with enhanced regulations of licensed money lenders having taken effect this month, Chung expects complaints or enquiries over misuse of employers' data by foreign domestic helpers to be fewer. This came as the regulations place restrictions on the ability of money lenders to request borrowers to provide loan referees. The watchdog logged 14 enquiries and seven related complaints as of June 30 this year. Edited by Tony Sabine
body.zh: 个人资料私隐专员公署已向三名外籍家庭佣工发出警告信，指其未经同意滥用雇主个人资料申请贷款。该监管机构在收到外佣雇主的投诉后于周二宣布了有关这些信件的消息。报道称，金融机构联系了其中两名投诉人，并要求他们每天最多四次提醒农民工还清债务，而第三名雇主则收到了发给他的帮工的逾期付款通知。一家公司还警告说，如果未在截止日期前还款，收债员将前往其中一名雇主的家中。三名佣工均因拖欠还款而被解雇。他们还承认在申请贷款的过程中向本地和海外贷款机构提供雇主的个人信息，包括姓名、家庭住址和电话号码。三人中的一人向四家金融机构申请贷款。私隐专员钟丽珊表示，这些外来工违反《个人资料（私隐）条例》，因为他们没有获得雇主的许可，使用其雇主的资料申请贷款。 “我们已经向他们清楚地解释了有关条例的要求，”她说。 “我们知道他们理解这些要求，并且他们同意将来不会犯同样的错误。”钟补充说，三人必须严格遵守该条例。她还表示，他们不会被起诉。 “在任何起诉中，我们都必须证明当事人有相关的犯罪意图，”钟说。监管机构呼吁雇主向外籍家庭佣工明确表示，其个人信息只能用于与雇佣相关的事宜，外佣在将其用于其他目的之前应征得他们的同意。给工人签署文件时也要小心，仔细研究内容。该监管机构为移民工人准备了一本同样有他加禄语和印度尼西亚语版本的小册子，旨在提高他们对使用雇主个人数据的认识。与此同时，随着本月对持牌放债人的加强监管生效，钟预计有关外籍家庭佣工滥用雇主数据的投诉或查询将会减少。这是因为法规限制了放债人要求借款人提供贷款推荐人的能力。截至今年 6 月 30 日，该监管机构共收到 14 起询问和 7 起相关投诉。托尼·萨宾编辑

summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: The latest round of flat selections under the Green Form Subsidised Home Ownership Scheme kicked off on Tuesday, drawing eager crowds to the sales office in Kwun Tong. Applicants – comprising public housing tenants and Green Form certificate holders – arrived early, hoping to secure one of the discounted units on offer. This year’s scheme centres on the newly developed Shing Chi Court in Kowloon Bay, where flats are being sold at 60 percent of the market price. According to the Housing Authority, more than 800 units are available, ranging in size from about 280 to 469 square feet. Prices fall between HK$1.68 million and HK$3.54 million, making the development an attractive option for buyers. In addition to the new inventory, the authority is also offering around 120 previously sold Green Form HOS flats and a fresh batch of about 400 recovered units from the Tenants Purchase Scheme. Priority in the selection process has been given to tenants affected by the authority’s recently announced public rental housing clearance projects. These include residents from five blocks at Wah Fu Estate, three blocks at Choi Hung Estate, two blocks at Ma Tau Wai Estate, and Sai Wan Estate – all of whom have the option of purchasing a subsidised flat rather than relocating to another rental unit. The atmosphere at the sales centre was tense yet hopeful, with many prospective buyers arriving well before their scheduled slots. Applicants sat fixated on a large display screen, tracking which units had already been snapped up. Among the successful buyers was a former resident of Wah Fu Estate, Ng, who was visibly thrilled to have landed his preferred home – a two-bedroom, 430-square-foot flat on a high floor of Block A for his family of three. Speaking to reporters, he said the choice was a no-brainer. "I like a higher floor because it offers a wider view. The transport links here are excellent. I walked to the nearby MTR stations and found it very convenient. And the price for the flat is also acceptable and within our budget," Ng said. Another happy buyer, Cheung, who is retired, previously lived in Sai Wan Estate. She opted for a mid-floor, two-bedroom unit, citing Kowloon Bay’s established community and good transport connections as key factors. But for her, the purchase carried a deeper meaning. "Another thing that makes me happy is being able to choose what I want, and that we can pass our home on to someone in need – just like what happened to us back then," Cheung said. "When we lived in Sai Wan Estate, we only managed to get our flat because someone else had moved out." As for the move from Hong Kong Island to Kowloon, Cheung said that didn't bother her, especially now that she is retired. She added that she would actually be living closer to her family, and while...
body.zh: 绿表置业计划最新一轮选楼已于周二展开，观塘售楼处吸引了大批人潮。申请者——包括公屋租户和绿表证书持有者——提前抵达，希望能获得其中一套折扣单位。今年的计划以九龙湾新开发的盛智苑为中心，该处的单位售价为市价的60%。据房屋委员会称，现有800多个单位，面积约280至469平方英尺不等。价格介乎 168 万至 354 万港元，对买家来说是一个有吸引力的选择。除了新库存外，当局还提供约120个以前出售的绿表居屋单位，以及新一批约400个从租者置其屋计划中收回的单位。受当局最近宣布的公共租赁住房清理项目影响的租户将被优先考虑。其中包括华富村五个街区、彩虹村三个街区、马头围村两个街区和西环村的居民，他们都可以选择购买资助单位，而不是搬迁到另一个出租单位。销售中心的气氛紧张而又充满希望，许多潜在买家提前到达。申请者们全神贯注地坐在大显示屏上，追踪哪些单位已经被抢购一空。在成功的买家中，吴先生是华富村的前居民，他显然很高兴能买到自己最喜欢的房子——一套位于A座高层、面积为430平方英尺的两居室公寓，供一家三口居住。他在接受记者采访时表示，这一选择是理所当然的。 “我喜欢高层，因为视野更开阔。这里的交通四通八达。我步行到附近的地铁站，觉得很方便。而且单位的价格也可以接受，在我们的预算之内。”吴说。另一位快乐的买家是退休的张先生，以前曾居住在西环村。她选择了中层两房单位，并以九龙湾成熟的社区和良好的交通连接为关键因素。但对她来说，这次购买有着更深的意义。 “另一件让我高兴的事情是能够选择我想要的东西，并且我们可以将我们的家传递给有需要的人 - 就像我们当时发生的事情一样，”张说。 “我们住在西环村时，因为别人搬走了，我们才得到单位。”至于从港岛搬到九龙，张表示这并不困扰她，尤其是现在她已经退休了。她补充说，她实际上会住得离家人更近，同时……

summary.en: Hong Kong police arrested a woman for alleged sedition outside the West Kowloon Law Courts Building on Friday, hours before leaders of a Tiananmen vigil group were found guilty under the national security law. Police told local media outlets that a 45-year-old was arrested early...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Hong Kong police arrested a woman for alleged sedition outside the West Kowloon Law Courts Building on Friday, hours before leaders of a Tiananmen vigil group were found guilty under the national security law . Hong Kong police set up a cordon outside the West Kowloon Law Courts Building on August 21, 2026, ahead of the verdict hearing of the trial of two Tiananmen vigil activists Chow Hang-tang and Lee Cheuk-yan on national security charges. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Police told local media outlets that a 45-year-old was arrested early on Friday on suspicion of acting with seditious intention, disorder in public places, and obstructing police. She was detained for investigation. According to The Collective, the woman was among those queueing for seats in the public gallery for the verdict for Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan. The two are former leaders of the Hong Kong Alliance in Support of Patriotic Democratic Movements of China, which used to organise Hong Kong’s annual Tiananmen vigils. See also: Conviction of Hong Kong Tiananmen vigil activists draws approval from gov’t, concern from overseas human rights groups The organisation itself, which announced its disbandment in September 2021, was also on trial. The Tiananmen vigil in Victoria Park on June 4, 2018. File photo: Etan Liam, via Flickr. Both the two activists and the Alliance were accused of inciting subversion through calls for “ending one-party rule” – a slogan that prosecutors said amounted to calling for the overthrow of the Chinese Communist Party. The woman was taken into a police vehicle at around 5am, according to The Collective. A witness who was also in the queue told the media outlet that the woman was wearing a black t-shirt with Japanese characters. HKFP has reached out to the police for comment. Acting with seditious intention is an offence under Article 23, the city’s local security law. It is punishable by up to seven years’ imprisonment, or 10 years if the offence is committed with foreign forces. The Alliance case was adjourned to Friday for mitigation statements.
body.zh: 周五，香港警方在西九龙法院大楼外逮捕了一名涉嫌煽动叛乱的妇女，几个小时后，天安门守夜组织的领导人根据国家安全法被判有罪。 2026 年 8 月 21 日，在两名天安门守夜活动人士周行棠和李卓人因国家安全罪名受审的判决听证会之前，香港警方在西九龙法院大楼外设置了警戒线。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。警方告诉当地媒体，一名 45 岁的男子于周五早些时候被捕，罪名是涉嫌煽动叛乱、扰乱公共场所秩序以及妨碍警察执法。她被拘留接受调查。据《The Collective》报道，这名女子是在旁听席上排队等待周恒东和李卓人判决的人之一。两人是香港支持中国爱国民主运动联盟的前领导人，该联盟曾组织香港一年一度的天安门守夜活动。另请参阅：对香港天安门守夜活动人士的定罪获得政府批准、海外人权组织的关注 该组织本身也在接受审判，该组织于 2021 年 9 月宣布解散。 2018 年 6 月 4 日，维多利亚公园举行的天安门守夜活动。资料照片：Etan Liam，来自 Flickr。这两名活动人士和联盟都被指控通过呼吁“结束一党统治”煽动颠覆——检察官称这一口号相当于呼吁推翻中国共产党。据 The Collective 报道，该女子于凌晨 5 点左右被带上警车。一名也在排队的目击者告诉媒体，这名女子穿着一件印有日文的黑色T恤。 HKFP已联系警方置评。根据该市当地安全法第 23 条，具有煽动意图的行为属于犯罪行为。如果是外国军队所为，最高可判处 7 年监禁，如果是与外国军队共同犯罪，则可判处 10 年监禁。联盟案件押后至周五发表缓解声明。

body.en: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department reported a modest turnout on the first day of its reservation trial for the Po Pin Chau trail located in Sai Kung East Country Park. As of 6pm on Monday, about 200 of the 2,000 daily slots had been booked for September 5 and 6 – representing just 10 percent of the quota. Speaking on an RTHK radio programme on Tuesday, Esther To, an assistant director at the department, attributed the sluggish take-up to the ongoing summer heat. "It might be because the weather is still quite hot, so the number of visitors is definitely going to be lower. We expect that the number will only start to pick up around the Mid-Autumn Festival or the October Golden Week," she said. The pilot scheme, which requires visitors to register using their real names, is designed to protect the trail’s natural environment, enhance the overall visitor experience, and assess the site's carrying capacity, according to To. She noted that the 2,000-slot daily limit was set based on past foot traffic during Golden Week holidays, the trail’s length, and typical visitor behaviour patterns – factors she believes make the quota appropriate. When asked whether the absence of a time limit could lead to overcrowding, To explained that the round-trip route at Po Pin Chau spans roughly two kilometres and is typically completed within two hours. She added that during the Labour Day Golden Week in May, the department had already introduced crowd control measures at popular viewpoints. "If too many people gather there for photos, we would direct them to keep moving. Essentially, most people gather at the photo spot, take their pictures, and then follow the trail down," she said. "They rarely linger in between because the area is exposed – it's either too hot, too windy, or even rainy, so they tend to come down after taking their photos." Regarding the lack of penalties for no-shows or a fee structure, To said the department is taking a gradual approach, as country parks have historically operated without charges. She encouraged visitors to cancel their reservations at least 48 hours in advance if their plans change. Through the pilot scheme, the department will monitor no-show rates and later decide whether or not to introduce penalties or fees. Edited by Aaron Tam
body.zh: 渔农自然护理署报告称，位于西贡东郊野公园的破边洲径的预留试验首日参加人数不多。截至周一下午 6 点，9 月 5 日至 6 日的每日 2,000 个时段中约有 200 个已被预订——仅占配额的 10%。周二，该部门助理处长杜淑仪在香港电台的一个广播节目中表示，收视率低迷的原因是持续的夏季炎热。 “可能是因为天气还很热，所以游客数量肯定会减少。我们预计，中秋节或十月黄金周前后，游客数量才会开始回升。”她说。杜表示，试点计划要求游客实名登记，旨在保护步道的自然环境、提升整体游客体验并评估场地的承载能力。她指出，每日 2,000 个停车位的限制是根据过去黄金周假期期间的人流量、步道长度和典型游客行为模式而设定的，她认为这些因素使配额是合适的。当被问及没有时间限制是否会导致人满为患时，杜解释说，破边洲的来回路线全长约两公里，通常在两小时内完成。她补充，五月五一黄金周期间，该部门已在热门观点推出人流控制措施。 “如果太多人聚集在那里拍照，我们会引导他们继续前进。基本上，大多数人聚集在拍照点，拍照，然后沿着小路下去，”她说。 “他们很少在这之间徘徊，因为该地区暴露在外——要么太热，要么风太大，要么甚至下雨，所以他们往往会在拍照后下来。”关于没有对缺席的处罚或收费结构，杜表示，该部门正在采取渐进的方法，因为郊野公园历来都是免费运营的。她鼓励游客如果计划有变，至少提前 48 小时取消预订。通过试点计划，该部门将监测缺席率，然后决定是否征收罚款或费用。谭咏麟编辑

title.en: 78% of low-income elderly Hongkongers have suffered heat-related distress – Greenpeace
title.zh: 绿色和平组织称，78％的低收入香港老年人遭受过高温困扰

summary.en: Close to 80 per cent of low-income elderly residents in Hong Kong report suffering physical or mental distress related to extreme heat, a Greenpeace survey has found, highlighting the demographic’s vulnerability to rising temperatures. Greenpeace said on Monday that it surveyed...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Close to 80 per cent of low-income elderly residents in Hong Kong report suffering physical or mental distress related to extreme heat, a Greenpeace survey has found, highlighting the demographic’s vulnerability to rising temperatures. Hong Kong saw a record-breaking heatwave in summer 2026. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Greenpeace said on Monday that it surveyed 127 residents aged 65 or above across seven districts with rapidly ageing populations. Among the respondents, more than half live in public rental flats while 35.4 per cent reside in “inadequate housing” such as subdivided units or rooftop squatter huts. Those living alone or with an elderly partner accounted for 60 per cent of respondents, the NGO said. The survey, conducted in June and July this year, found that 78.7 per cent of respondents reported experiencing at least one form of heat-related discomfort affecting their health, mood, or sleep. A total of 5.5 per cent said they had been hospitalised due to a heat-related illness in the past year. ‘Silent killer’ Greenpeace campaigner Prudence Yeung said in a statement that extreme heat is a “silent killer” for the elderly population. “Elderly people are at high risk from extreme heat due to declining physiological functions, and some suffer from chronic illnesses,” Yeung was quoted as saying in the Chinese-language statement. Between 2015 and 2024, the number of hospital discharges and deaths related to heatstroke among patients aged 65 or above rose 16-fold from four to 68, Yeung said, citing official data Greenpeace obtained from the Department of Health. This increase was the sharpest among all age groups and did not include patients who were hospitalised due to other heat-related conditions, she added. Greenpeace campaigner Prudence Yeung. Photo: Greenpeace. Greenpeace also found that more than 70 per cent of elderly residents tended to underestimate heat-related health risks, believing that they would not suffer from heatstroke if they stayed at home. Surviving Hong Kong’s sweltering summer: A comprehensive guide to beating the heat and staying safe About a third of respondents said they never or rarely use air conditioning, even during extreme temperatures. That figure rose to 55 per cent among those living in inadequate housing, with respondents citing a lack of air conditioner units or high electricity bills as their primary reasons. Meanwhile, about 80 per cent of respondents said they had not received any heat-related community services, such as cooling supplies or educational resources, in the previous two years. This highlights a lack of social support surrounding rising temperatures, the NGO said. Nearly 60 per cent found government support during extreme heat to be insufficient, while 27 per cent said they...
body.zh: 绿色和平组织的一项调查发现，近 80% 的香港低收入老年居民表示，他们因酷热而遭受身体或精神困扰，这突显了该人群对气温上升的脆弱性。 2026 年夏季，香港遭遇破纪录的热浪。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。绿色和平组织周一表示，对人口迅速老龄化的七个地区的 127 名 65 岁或以上居民进行了调查。受访者中，超过一半居住于公屋，而35.4%则居住于劏房或天台寮屋等“不足房屋”。该非政府组织表示，独居或与年长伴侣居住的人占受访者的 60%。这项于今年 6 月和 7 月进行的调查发现，78.7% 的受访者表示经历过至少一种与热有关的不适，影响了他们的健康、情绪或睡眠。共有 5.5% 的人表示，他们在过去一年中曾因中暑而住院。 “无声杀手”绿色和平组织活动家 Prudence Yeung 在一份声明中表示，极端高温是老年人口的“无声杀手”。中文声明援引杨的话说：“由于生理功能下降，老年人面临高温的风险很高，有些人还患有慢性病。”杨说，2015年至2024年期间，65岁或以上患者因中暑而出院和死亡的人数增加了16倍，从4人增加到68人，绿色和平组织从卫生署获得的官方数据。她补充说，这一增幅在所有年龄段中是最显着的，并且不包括因其他与高温相关的疾病而住院的患者。绿色和平活动家 Prudence Yeung。照片：绿色和平组织。绿色和平组织还发现，超过70%的老年居民往往低估与高温相关的健康风险，认为如果呆在家里就不会中暑。度过香港酷热的夏季：避暑和保持安全的综合指南 约三分之一的受访者表示，他们从不或很少使用空调，即使在极端气温下也是如此。在居住在住房不足的人中，这一数字上升至 55%，受访者认为缺乏空调或高电费是他们的主要原因。与此同时，约80%的受访者表示，他们在过去两年中没有接受过任何与高温相关的社区服务，例如降温用品或教育资源。该非政府组织表示，这凸显了气温上升缺乏社会支持。近 60% 的人认为政府在酷暑期间的支持不够，而 27% 的人表示他们……

title.en: The Guardian view on the Tiananmen vigil convictions: Hong Kong too has been silenced. Others should speak out | Editorial
title.zh: 《卫报》评论天安门守夜活动定罪：香港也被噤声。其他人应发声 | 社论

summary.en: Two activists in Hong Kong face jail sentences for organizing commemorations of the 1989 Tiananmen Square crackdown. For decades, Hong Kong was the only place in China where the annual vigil could publicly keep the memory of the pro-democracy protests alive, but recent crackdowns have suppressed these freedoms.
summary.zh: 两名香港社运人士因组织纪念1989年天安门镇压的活动而面临牢狱之灾。几十年来，香港是中国唯一可以公开纪念天安门民主抗议活动的地方，但最近的镇压已经扼杀了这些自由。

body.en: Two activists who organised commemorations of the bloody crackdown on China’s 1989 pro-democracy protests now face jail. Remembering is not a crime For decades, Hong Kong mourned when the mainland could not. Its huge annual Tiananmen vigil kept alive the memory of the 1989 pro-reform protests in Beijing, and of the massacre that suppressed them. Along with Macau, it was the only place in China where the anniversary could be publicly marked and the truth preserved. But the crackdown on the 2019 uprising in Hong Kong has crushed the freedoms that the region once enjoyed. That year’s vigil was the last. On Friday, two leaders of the Hong Kong Alliance, which organised the commemoration, were convicted of incitement to subversion under the draconian national security law. Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, and Chow Hang-tung, 41, face up to 10 years in jail. Do you have an opinion on the issues raised in this article? As freedoms are crushed in Hong Kong, this story reminds us of the moral...

title.zh: 批地促进大型项目开发

summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: The chairman of the Hung Shui Kiu Industry Park Company, Jeffrey Lam, has welcomed the government’s decision to grant them an additional 20 percent of land size upon formation carried out by the winning tender of the first large-scale development project at the Northern Metropolis, saying it shows the authorities' determination towards industry development at the site. The Development Bureau on Monday said it awarded a nearly 11-hectare project in the Hung Shui Kiu/Ha Tsuen New Development Area to HSK New Development Limited which comprises six shareholders: China Overseas Land and Investment, China Merchants Land, China Resources Land, China Travel Service, JD.com and a subsidiary of Sino Land. Apart from flattening and developing three residential sites and building a smart logistics centre on an "Enterprise and Technology Park" site, the consortium will be tasked with forming various remaining sites in the pilot area, to be handed back to the government later. Development Secretary Bernadette Linn said two of the “Enterprise and Technology Park” sites of 4.5 hectares will be granted to Hung Shui Kiu Industry Park Company upon formation, increasing the size of sites at a nominal land premium for 50 years from 23 hectares to 27.5 hectares, to allow firms to settle in early once the site formation is completed in 2028. Lam said that the decision highlighted the government’s support for the park company and the emphasis on industrial development. He added that the newly allocated sites will help the park company to establish a regional industrial ecosystem at Hung Shui Kiu and enhance its appeal to businesses and talents. Meanwhile, Ryan Ip, vice president of the think-tank Our Hong Kong Foundation, said the winning consortium has expertise in various fields, which will help expedite the development of the mega project. “Each of the corporate has its own merit. You have a developer with long history of local operations, and then you also have large SOE [state-owned enterprise] developers who have strong experience on operating this kind of I&T enterprises on the mainland, and then you also have an established, large logistics operator,” said Ip, who's also a member of the Advisory Committee on the Northern Metropolis. “So I think it bring a lot of different experience to Hong Kong not only on residential development, but also on the operation of technology park, and also on the operations of high-end logistics facilities.” JD.com – the anchor tenant at the centre – will start operations within 55 months, which Ip described as an “aggressive timeline” compared with the minimum requirement of 96 months in the tender documents. “I think they have to work very hard to achieve that not only on a smooth construction schedule, but also they will have to...
body.zh: 洪水桥工业园公司主席林俊杰对政府在北都会首个大型发展项目中标后批出额外20%土地面积的决定表示欢迎，称这显示了当局在该地块发展工业的决心。发展局周一表示，已将洪水桥/厦村新发展区近11公顷的项目批给HSK新发展有限公司，该公司由六家股东组成：中国海外发展、招商局置地、华润置地、中国旅行社、京东以及信和置业的子公司。除了平整和开发三个住宅用地以及在“企业和科技园”用地建设智能物流中心外，该联合体还将负责在试验区内形成各种剩余用地，稍后交还给政府。发展局局长林柏纳黛表示，其中两幅面积为4.5公顷的“企业及科技园”用地将在洪水桥工业园公司成立后批出，以50年名义补地价将用地面积从23公顷增加至27.5公顷，以便企业在2028年用地完成后尽早入驻。林表示，这一决定凸显了政府对园区公司和工业园公司的支持。重视产业发展。他补充，新分配的用地将有助园区公司在洪水桥建立区域产业生态系统，增强对企业和人才的吸引力。与此同时，智库团结香港基金会副总裁叶瑞恩表示，中标财团拥有多个领域的专业知识，这将有助于加快这个大型项目的开发。 “每家企业都有自己的优点。你有一个在本地运营历史悠久的开发商，然后你还有在内地运营此类创科企业方面拥有丰富经验的大型国有企业开发商，然后你还有一个成熟的大型物流运营商，”同时也是北方都市咨询委员会成员的叶说。 “所以我认为它给香港带来了很多不同的经验，不仅是住宅开发，还有科技园的运营，还有高端物流设施的运营。”该中心的主要租户京东将在 55 个月内开始运营，叶先生称，与招标文件中 96 个月的最低要求相比，这是一个“激进的时间表”。 “我认为他们必须非常努力才能实现这一目标，不仅要保证施工进度顺利，而且还必须……

title.en: China abruptly delays unmanned moon mission over ‘launch conditions’
title.zh: 中国因“发射条件”突然推迟无人登月任务

summary.en: China’s manned space agency said on Sunday it is delaying a research moon mission that is part of Beijing’s efforts to land a crew there by 2030, less than two weeks after a rare launch failure. The agency said after a “comprehensive assessment” the mission, which involved...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: China’s manned space agency said on Sunday it is delaying a research moon mission that is part of Beijing’s efforts to land a crew there by 2030, less than two weeks after a rare launch failure. The Chang’e-7 lunar probe on a Long March 5 carrier rocket. Photo: CCTV screenshot. The agency said after a “comprehensive assessment” the mission, which involved sending the Chang’e-7 lunar probe on a Long March 5 carrier rocket, “does not meet launch conditions and cannot take place during the planned window this year”. The decision to delay was “based on the principle of prudence, reliability and absolute mission success,” it added, without providing further details on what conditions weren’t met or when the launch would be rescheduled. The mission — meant to search for water on the moon’s south pole — was scheduled to depart either over the weekend or Monday, according to media reports. Last week, the agency said the probe and carrier rocket had been moved to the takeoff area at Wenchang Space Launch Center in southern Hainan province. As of Wednesday, the takeoff site and equipment were in good condition, with inspections to take place and a launch “scheduled for the coming period”. The Chang’e-7 delay comes just under two weeks after media reports showed a rocket launched from the Hainan site had exploded, as crowds watched a fiery ball in the sky. The failed mission involved a Long March 7A carrier rocket, which had lifted off from the Wenchang Space Launch Site, state news agency Xinhua said at the time. China’s Long March 7A carrier rocket exploded on Monday, August 10, 2026. Photo: Supplied. An “anomaly” occurred when the rocket carrying the Zhongxing-4B communications satellite was in flight, Xinhua added. The cause of the failure was under investigation, it said. Beijing has ploughed billions of dollars into its space programme in recent years to achieve what President Xi Jinping calls the country’s “space dream”. China successfully landed a reusable rocket for the first time in July, according to its space agency, marking a major step in its space ambitions and in reducing launch costs. The country is aiming to land astronauts on the Moon before 2030, a race in which the United States is also competing with its Artemis programme.
body.zh: 中国载人航天局周日表示，将推迟一项研究月球任务，该任务是北京计划在 2030 年之前将宇航员送上月球的努力的一部分，距离一次罕见的发射失败还不到两周。长征五号运载火箭上的嫦娥七号月球探测器。照片：央视截图。该机构表示，经过“全面评估”，此次由长征五号运载火箭发射嫦娥七号月球探测器的任务“不符合发射条件，不能在今年计划的窗口期进行”。它补充说，推迟的决定是“基于审慎、可靠和任务绝对成功的原则”，但没有提供有关哪些条件不满足或何时重新安排发射的进一步细节。据媒体报道，该任务旨在在月球南极寻找水，计划在周末或周一出发。上周，该机构表示，探测器和运载火箭已转移至海南省南部文昌航天发射中心的起飞区。截至周三，起飞场地和设备状况良好，将进行检查并“计划在未来一段时间内”发射。嫦娥七号的发射推迟不到两周，此前媒体报道称，一枚从海南发射场发射的火箭发生爆炸，当时人群正在观看天空中的一个火球。官方通讯社新华社当时称，此次失败的任务涉及一枚从文昌航天发射场升空的长征七号甲运载火箭。中国的长征七号甲运载火箭于 2026 年 8 月 10 日星期一爆炸。照片：提供。新华社补充说，搭载中星四号B通信卫星的火箭在飞行过程中出现“异常”。声明称，故障原因正在调查中。近年来，北京已在太空计划上投入了数十亿美元，以实现习近平主席所说的国家“太空梦想”。据中国航天局称，中国于 7 月首次成功着陆可重复使用火箭，标志着其太空雄心和降低发射成本迈出了重要一步。该国的目标是在 2030 年之前将宇航员送上月球，美国也在这场竞赛中与其阿耳忒弥斯计划展开竞争。

reflection.en: This story draws attention to wisdom, knowledge, and the pursuit of truth. Proverbs 2:6 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with humble learning and wise application, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到智慧、知识与追求真理。Proverbs 2:6提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以谦卑学习与智慧运用来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: If any of you lacks wisdom, you should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault.
verse.textZh: 你们中间若有缺少智慧的，应当求那厚赐与众人、也不斥责人的神，主就必赐给他。

title.en: Shein to make market debut in Hong Kong next Tuesday
title.zh: Shein 将于下周二在香港上市

summary.en: Shein will debut on the Hong Kong stock exchange on September 1, the fast-fashion retailer said on Monday, in a long-awaited listing that would value the group at close to US$27 billion. The online retailer plans to offer 280 million shares at a price between HK$47.60 and...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及管家责任、供应与公共福祉。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Shein will debut on the Hong Kong stock exchange on September 1, the fast-fashion retailer said on Monday, in a long-awaited listing that would value the group at close to US$27 billion. Shein app. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The online retailer plans to offer 280 million shares at a price between HK$47.60 and HK$49.50, raising up to HK$13.86 billion (US$1.7 billion), it said in a filing to the bourse. The final price will be announced on August 31, but the higher figure would value the company at around US$26.8 billion. Founded in China and now headquartered in Singapore, Shein finally won Beijing’s approval last month to make its initial public offering in Hong Kong. Plans to list in New York and London had been held back in recent years by regulatory hurdles, according to media reports. With most of its factories located in China, Shein sets itself apart from its competitors thanks to the speed of its product design and its highly efficient production and supply chain. Its vast selection of products at stunningly low prices has brought Shein into the same league as Amazon in the United States. With the funds raised from the market, Shein said it aims to finance its technological capabilities as well as boost its international presence. Growing scrutiny Shein reported a full-year net profit of US$2.06 billion in 2025 but swung to a $99 million quarterly loss as the United States scrapped an import duty exemption on small packages. The firm moved its headquarters to Singapore between 2021 and 2022, a move analysts say was intended to avoid increasing global scrutiny of Chinese firms. But it still benefits from China’s unique combination of a huge, low-cost textile manufacturing sector and a highly sophisticated e-commerce logistics network. The company ranks suppliers by their flexibility and ability to deliver urgent orders, and regularly eliminates the poorest performers, according to a 2021 Zhongtai Securities report. By the end of last year, its European customer base rose to 156 million average monthly users, making Shein one of the continent’s biggest e-commerce platforms alongside China’s AliExpress (193 million users) and Amazon (around 180 million). Shein has been scrutinised over its environmental footprint and allegations of human rights violations, though its executive chairman told AFP last year that the company has “zero tolerance” on forced labour. Activists from Mouv’Enfants, an association for the protection of children, stage a protest during the opening of Asian e-commerce giant Shein’s first physical store at the Bazar de l’Hotel de Ville (BHV) in Paris on November 5, 2025. Photo: Mouv’Enfants, via Facebook. Shein also drew criticism last year in France over the discovery of...
body.zh: 这家快时尚零售商周一表示，Shein 将于 9 月 1 日在香港证券交易所上市，这是一次期待已久的上市，该集团的估值将接近 270 亿美元。谢因应用程序。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。该在线零售商计划以 47.60 港元至 49.50 港元的价格发行 2.8 亿股股票，筹集至多 138.6 亿港元（17 亿美元）。最终价格将于 8 月 31 日公布，但较高的价格将使该公司估值约为 268 亿美元。 Shein 成立于中国，现总部位于新加坡，上个月终于获得北京方面的批准，在香港进行首次公开​​募股。据媒体报道，近年来在纽约和伦敦上市的计划因监管障碍而受阻。 Shein 的大部分工厂位于中国，凭借其产品设计速度以及高效的生产和供应链，使其在竞争对手中脱颖而出。 Shein 的产品种类繁多且价格极低，使其与美国的亚马逊处于同一水平。 Shein 表示，通过从市场筹集的资金，其目标是为其技术能力提供资金并提高其国际影响力。日益严格的审查 Shein 报告称，2025 年全年净利润为 20.6 亿美元，但由于美国取消小包装进口关税豁免，季度亏损 9,900 万美元。该公司在 2021 年至 2022 年间将总部迁至新加坡，分析师称此举是为了避免全球对中国公司日益严格的审查。但它仍然受益于中国庞大、低成本的纺织制造业和高度复杂的电子商务物流网络的独特结合。根据中泰证券 2021 年的报告，该公司根据供应商的灵活性和交付紧急订单的能力对供应商进行排名，并定期淘汰表现最差的供应商。截至去年年底，其欧洲客户群平均每月用户数增至 1.56 亿，使 Shein 成为欧洲大陆最大的电子商务平台之一，与中国的全球速卖通（1.93 亿用户）和亚马逊（约 1.8 亿用户）齐名。 Shein 因其环境足迹和侵犯人权的指控而受到审查，尽管其执行主席去年告诉法新社，该公司对强迫劳动采取“零容忍”态度。 2025 年 11 月 5 日，保护儿童协会 Mouv’Enfants 的活动人士在亚洲电子商务巨头 Shein 在巴黎 Bazar de l’Hotel de Ville (BHV) 的第一家实体店开业期间举行抗议。照片：Mouv’Enfants，来自 Facebook。谢因去年在法国也因发现……而受到批评。

reflection.en: This story draws attention to stewardship, provision, and the common good. 1 Peter 4:10 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with stewardship that serves neighbours, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到管家责任、供应与公共福祉。1 Peter 4:10提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以服事邻舍的好管家心态来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: ‘She’s not afraid of anyone’: the prison writings of one of Hong Kong’s last outspoken democracy activists
title.zh: “她无所畏惧”：香港最后一位直言不讳的民主活动家之一的狱中手稿

summary.en: Chow Hang-tung, a prominent Hong Kong democracy activist, has been detained since 2021. From prison, she continues to write on various topics, including the meaning of freedom and the Tiananmen Square events, despite being found guilty of “inciting subversion.”
summary.zh: 香港著名民主活动家邹幸彤自2021年起被拘留。尽管被判“煽动颠覆罪”，她仍在狱中笔耕不辍，撰写关于自由的意义和天安门事件等各种主题的文章。

body.en: Chow Hang-tung has been detained since 2021, and written about everything from clothes to Tiananmen Square and the meaning of freedom Tiananmen Square vigil organisers in Hong Kong found guilty of ‘inciting subversion’ In one essay written from prison, Chow Hang-tung worries about her hairstyle before court appearances because there are no combs or mirrors in her cell. “In a place like prison, where anything that is personal is stripped away, it’s even more important to hold on to every means by which you can express yourself,” she writes. “Don’t let uniform, depersonalised rules, dress codes, schedules, and behavioural requirements grind down your edges and mould you into a ‘model citizen’”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 周恒东自 2021 年以来一直被拘留，并撰写了从服装到天安门广场以及自由的意义等各种内容。香港天安门广场守夜活动组织者被判犯有“煽动颠覆罪”。在一篇在狱中写的文章中，周恒东对自己出庭前的发型感到担忧，因为她的牢房里没有梳子或镜子。 “在监狱这样的地方，任何个人的东西都被剥夺了，更重要的是要坚持一切可以表达自己的方式，”她写道。 “不要让统一的、非个性化的规则、着装规范、时间表和行为要求磨掉你的棱角，把你塑造成‘模范公民’”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The unwavering spirit of activists like Chow Hang-tung, who continue to speak truth from confinement, reminds us of the biblical call to advocate for the vulnerable. Yahweh's word encourages us to be a voice for those who cannot speak for themselves, especially the destitute and those whose rights are denied. Her writings from prison embody a profound...
reflection.zh: 邹幸彤等活动家在囚禁中仍坚定不移地发出真理之声，这提醒我们圣经呼召我们要为弱势群体发声。雅伟的话语鼓励我们为那些不能为自己说话的人，特别是贫困和权利被剥夺的人，开口辩护。她在狱中的文字体现了对正义和自由的深刻承诺，即使为此付出个人代价。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

summary.en: UK Foreign Office condemns use of national security law to convict activists Lee Cheuk-yan and Chow Hang-tung Two Hong Kong activists who organised annual vigils marking China’s deadly Tiananmen crackdown in 1989 have been found guilty of “incitement to subversion” in one of the...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: UK Foreign Office condemns use of national security law to convict activists Lee Cheuk-yan and Chow Hang-tung Two Hong Kong activists who organised annual vigils marking China’s deadly Tiananmen crackdown in 1989 have been found guilty of “incitement to subversion” in one of the most high-profile cases in Hong Kong since Beijing imposed its national security law in 2020. Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, and Chow Hang-tung, 41, “incited other persons to organise, plan, commit or participate in acts by unlawful means with a view to subverting the state power”, a press summary handed out to reporters said. The defendants each face a maximum penalty of 10 years in jail, with sentencing expected at a later date. Continue reading...
body.zh: 英国外交部谴责利用国家安全法对活动人士李卓人和周恒东定罪 两名香港活动人士组织了年度守夜活动，纪念中国 1989 年致命的天安门镇压，他们被判犯有“煽动颠覆罪”，这是自北京于 2020 年实施国家安全法以来香港最引人注目的案件之一。李卓人，69 岁和周恒东，41 岁，一份发给记者的新闻摘要称，“煽动他人以非法手段组织、策划、实施或者参与颠覆国家政权的行为”。被告每人将面临最高 10 年监禁的刑罚，预计稍后宣判。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This story draws attention to justice, dignity, and accountability. Micah 6:8 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with justice tempered by mercy, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到公义、尊严与问责。Micah 6:8提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以带着怜悯的公义来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.zh: 创纪录的热浪席卷亚洲大片地区，土豆在地里“沸腾”

summary.en: South Korean farmers are suffering in record heat, as Hong Kong reports its highest ever temperature and Japan swelters through newly designated ‘cruelly hot’ days In a potato field in Yanggu county, 80 miles (130km) north-east of Seoul, Lee Sang-hyuk dug into the soil and found...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: South Korean farmers are suffering in record heat, as Hong Kong reports its highest ever temperature and Japan swelters through newly designated ‘cruelly hot’ days In a potato field in Yanggu county, 80 miles (130km) north-east of Seoul, Lee Sang-hyuk dug into the soil and found nothing worth saving. A week earlier the crop, located in Gangwon province, had looked fine. Now the potatoes came up soft and collapsing, “like boiled potatoes”, spoiled by heat that had turned the ground into something closer to an oven. Continue reading...
body.zh: 韩国农民正遭受创纪录的高温，香港报告了有史以来的最高气温，日本也经历了新指定的“酷热”日子。在首尔东北 80 英里（130 公里）的阳谷县的一片马铃薯田里，李相赫 (Lee Sang-hyuk) 挖了土，却发现没有任何值得挽救的东西。一周前，位于江原道的作物看起来状况良好。现在，土豆变软了，塌陷了，“就像煮土豆一样”，由于高温而变质，地面变成了接近烤箱的东西。继续阅读...

title.en: Tornado tears through French village, leaving dozens hurt and homes ravaged
title.zh: 龙卷风席卷法国村庄，造成数十人受伤，房屋被毁

summary.en: The south-western village of Pomas was hardest hit, with hundreds of homes damaged and fifteen people taken to hospital.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A tornado has torn through the French village of Pomas in the country's south-west, injuring 39 people and damaging hundreds of homes.

Local authorities said 17 people were taken to hospital. One man said his pregnant wife was injured after their house collapsed on her.

More than 120 emergency workers were deployed to the village south of Carcassonne after winds reaching 117km/h (73mph) tore roofs off houses and damaged an estimated 300 homes on Monday.

"Half the village has been destroyed," said one resident called Pierre, who described the tornado as swirling like a "huge red and yellow chimney".

"There's a huge castle and a third of it is has collapsed - even though these are stones that have stood for 1,000 years," Pierre told Ici Occitanie.

The extreme weather has left about 2,800 homes across 10 villages without electricity, according to officials.

Local sub-prefect Emmanuelle Plantier-Lemarchand told French radio that she was not aware of anyone missing. She lowered the number of victims from 41 to 39, and said 15 of them had been treated in hospital.

"I heard this massive noise... then I saw everything flying around in the air and my roof collapsed," shocked resident Chantal told French radio. "I've got no house left, that's for sure."

French authorities had issued an orange alert for thunderstorms in large parts of the country's south-west, which have already been hit by power outages and transport disruptions.

Authorities in the Aude department in south-west France cancelled the third stage of the Vuelta a Espana cycling race in the area after a hailstorm in the French Pyrenees forced riders to seek shelter.

Eyewitness footage from the region captured the swirling vortex of the tornado looming in the horizon above houses and trees.

Images from the small village of Pomas, which was the hardest hit, showed uprooted trees, damaged cars and rubble from destroyed homes.

Meanwhile there were flight delays and cancellations at airports in Bordeaux, Marseille, Nice, Toulouse and north of Paris to the north, said Transport Minister Philippe Tabarot.

On average, France experiences several dozen tornadoes per year, according to the country's national weather service Météo-France.

It comes after Europe's summer of unprecedented heatwaves and wildfires, with France's south-west region among the worst affected with an area of 42,000 hectares burnt in one of the largest forest fires since World War Two.
body.zh: 一场龙卷风席卷了法国西南部的波马斯村，造成 39 人受伤，数百间房屋受损。 当地政府称，17 人被送往医院。一名男子说，他怀孕的妻子在房子倒塌后受伤。 周一，时速 117 公里（73 英里）的大风掀翻了房屋屋顶，估计有 300 所房屋受损，超过 120 名紧急救援人员被部署到卡尔卡松以南的村庄。 “半个村庄已被摧毁，”一位名叫皮埃尔的居民说，他形容龙卷风像“巨大的红黄色烟囱”一样旋转。 “有一座巨大的城堡，尽管这些石头已经屹立了 1000 年，但它的三分之一已经倒塌了，”皮埃尔告诉 Ici Occitanie。 据官员称，极端天气导致 10 个村庄约 2,800 户家庭断电。 当地副省长埃曼纽尔·普朗蒂埃·勒马尚 (Emmanuelle Plantier-Lemarchan) 告诉法国电台，她不知道有人失踪。她将受害者人数从 41 人减少到 39 人，并表示其中 15 人已在医院接受治疗。 震惊的居民尚塔尔告诉法国电台：“我听到巨大的噪音……然后我看到一切都在空中飞舞，我的屋顶倒塌了。” “我已经没有房子了，这是肯定的。” 法国当局已对该国西南部大部分地区发布雷暴橙色警报，这些地区已经遭受停电和交通中断的影响。 法国比利牛斯山脉的冰雹迫使车手寻求庇护，法国西南部奥德省当局取消了该地区环西班牙自行车赛的第三赛段。 该地区的目击者镜头捕捉到龙卷风的漩涡在房屋和树木上方的地平线上若隐若现。 来自受灾最严重的波马斯小村庄的图像显示，树木被连根拔起，汽车受损，房屋被毁，瓦砾遍地。 与此同时，交通部长菲利普·塔巴罗特表示，波尔多、马赛、尼斯、图卢兹以及巴黎北部的机场都出现了航班延误和取消。 据法国国家气象局称，法国平均每年会经历数十次龙卷风。 此前，欧洲夏季遭遇了前所未有的热浪和野火，法国西南部地区是受影响最严重的地区，面积达 42,000 公顷，是第二次世界大战以来最大规模的森林火灾之一。

title.en: Moon set to turn red as rare partial lunar eclipse graces UK skies
title.zh: 罕见的月偏食照亮英国天空，月亮将变成红色

summary.en: There will be a partial lunar eclipse in the UK on 28 August, and may cause the Moon appear reddish in colour.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Skywatchers across the UK could have the chance to see a stunning partial lunar eclipse later this week as the Sun, Earth, and Moon line up in the night sky.

Lunar eclipses occur when the Moon is full which will take place in the early hours of 28 August. It may cause the full Moon - nicknamed the Sturgeon Moon - to take on an eerie reddish glow.

It comes just weeks after the UK experienced its most dramatic partial solar eclipse in nearly 30 years.

Adding to the spectacle, its position in the sky will be low on the horizon, causing a phenomenon known as the Moon illusion. This makes the Moon appear bigger and more dramatic than usual.

The partial eclipse will begin at 03:33 BST in London, when the Moon enters Earth's darkest shadow.

It will reach its maximum at 05:12 BST, when around 90% of the Moon will be within the umbra.

By this point the Moon will be very low in the south-western sky, causing something known as the Moon illusion .

This is a term for when the Moon appears much larger than it is based on its position in the sky - an effect caused by the way our brains process visual information.

The effect is particularly noticeable during a moonrise or moonset, when the lunar disc is seen alongside familiar objects on the ground.

A lunar eclipse happens when the Earth passes between the Sun and the Moon, causing the Moon to temporarily move into the Earth's shadow.

During a partial eclipse, only part of the Moon enters the darkest section of that shadow, known as the umbra.

Sunlight passing through the Earth's atmosphere is scattered, with shorter blue wavelengths scattering more easily, while more of the longer wavelength red light reach the Moon.

These wavelengths are then reflected back towards Earth, giving the eclipsed Moon its reddish colour.

For the best chance of seeing the eclipse, astronomers recommend finding a high location with an unobstructed view towards the south-western horizon.

Viewing conditions are expected to vary considerably across the UK during the early hours of Friday morning.

With low pressure in charge, cloud and heavy showers are likely to affect some parts of the country, while other areas remain clear.

Currently, the best viewing conditions are expected across central and eastern parts of England and Wales. However, even here, the cloud cover could change a lot from one hour to the next and is very hard to forecast accurately.

You can check the latest hour-by-hour forecast where you are online or via the BBC Weather app.
body.zh: 本周晚些时候，当太阳、地球和月亮在夜空中排成一行时，英国各地的天文爱好者可能有机会看到令人惊叹的月偏食。 月食发生在 8 月 28 日凌晨满月时。它可能会导致满月（绰号“鲟鱼月”）呈现出怪异的红色光芒。 就在几周前，英国经历了近 30 年来最剧烈的日偏食。 更糟糕的是，它在天空中的位置将低于地平线，从而导致一种称为月亮错觉的现象。这使得月亮看起来比平时更大、更引人注目。 日偏食将于英国夏令时 03:33 在伦敦开始，届时月球将进入地球最暗的阴影。 它将在英国夏令时 05:12 达到最大值，届时大约 90% 的月球将位于本影内。 此时，月亮将位于西南天空中很低的位置，从而造成所谓的月亮错觉。 这是一个术语，指的是当月球看起来比它在天空中的位置大得多时，这是由我们的大脑处理视觉信息的方式引起的。 这种效应在月出或月落期间尤其明显，此时月盘与地面上熟悉的物体并排出现。 当地球经过太阳和月球之间时，就会发生月食，导致月球暂时移入地球的阴影中。 在日偏食期间，只有月球的一部分进入阴影最暗的部分，即本影。 穿过地球大气层的阳光会被散射，波长较短的蓝色光更容易散射，而更多波长较长的红光到达月球。 然后这些波长被反射回地球，使月食呈现出微红色。 为了获得观看日食的最佳机会，天文学家建议寻找一个可以一览无余地看到西南地平线的高处。 预计周五凌晨英国各地的观看情况会有很大差异。 由于低压，云和大阵雨可能会影响该国的部分地区，而其他地区则保持晴朗。 目前，英格兰和威尔士中部和东部地区的观看条件预计最佳。然而，即使在这里，云量在一小时与下一小时之间也可能发生很大变化，并且很难准确预测。 您可以在线或通过 BBC 天气应用程序查看最新的每小时天气预报。

title.en: Goat sanctuary purchases 16.9 acres of more land
title.zh: 山羊保护区购买了 16.9 英亩的土地

summary.en: The land purchased by Buttercups Sanctuary for Goats will enable it to house up to 160 goats.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A goat sanctuary in Kent has purchased an additional 16.9 acres of land, which it said would enable it to house up to 160 goats.

Buttercups Sanctuary for Goats in Boughton Monchelsea said that the new plot of land was close to where it was currently situated and would provide "long-lasting results for both our adorable residents and the wider, beautiful countryside".

Matt Huggins said that it was the "most significant step since the charity's foundation".

"It's been something we've all been dreaming of for a long, long time, and we're all very excited to get going," Huggins added.

According to the sanctuary, the purchased plot of land had historically been used for agriculture and will enable it to rescue more goats and double its on-site capacity.

It said a lot of work would need to be carried out on the land despite being a "blank canvas", but new goats are expected to begin living there by spring 2027.

Huggins added that its long-term vision included solar panels, wind turbines and habitat networks for the wildlife, which he expected would take years to be fully completed.

"There's a long road ahead, and we are going to need the help of our supporters to make it a final reality, but we've taken the first major step," he said.

title.en: Access to bilingual education lags behind in Andalusia's rural areas, study reveals
title.zh: 研究显示安达卢西亚农村地区双语教育的普及率落后

summary.en: Over the past two decades, bilingual education programs have significantly expanded within the Spanish education system, with the aim of improving foreign language learning—primarily English—while making it more accessible for all. Although more and more schools are offering...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Over the past two decades, bilingual education programs have significantly expanded within the Spanish education system, with the aim of improving foreign language learning—primarily English—while making it more accessible for all. Although more and more schools are offering bilingual education, they are unevenly distributed across the country, generating inequalities among students.

To shed light on this issue, a study by the University of Córdoba (UCO) analyzed the distribution of bilingual schools across Andalusia, revealing a gap between the most populous cities and municipalities, where the largest number of bilingual schools are concentrated, and rural areas, where they are still scarce.

Previous studies had already pointed to inequalities in urban areas, which are closely tied to families' financial means and the neighborhoods where they live. Now, a new study broadens its scope to address inequalities between municipalities based on population size.

As the authors explain, this line of research aims to assess whether bilingual education programs are ensuring equal opportunities for the entire population, in line with the democratizing purpose for which they were designed. To do so, the study analyzed more than 2,500 primary schools and 1,600 compulsory secondary schools across Andalusia. The conclusion is clear: The larger the municipality, the more likely schools are to offer bilingual instruction.

The paper was published in the Journal of Education Policy by UCO researchers Alberto Álvarez Sotomayor (Department of Social Sciences, Philosophy, Geography, Translation, and Interpretation) and David Gutiérrez Rubio (Department of Mathematics), in collaboration with researcher Juan M. Gómez Espino (Department of Sociology, Pablo de Olavide University) and Carlos Lubián (Department of Political Science and Sociology, University of Santiago de Compostela).

As the authors point out, the data from this study—part of the EQUIBIL project—reveals a substantial difference in the bilingual resources available, which would support claims that these programs are elitist and "urban-focused."

In terms of primary education, 41.8% of schools in Andalusia offer bilingual instruction. In municipalities with more than 20,000 inhabitants, the percentage rises to 48.7%. However, as the focus shifts to smaller communities, the presence of bilingual schools decreases, falling below 20% in municipalities with fewer than 3,000 inhabitants.

The same pattern holds true for secondary schools: 56.1% of Andalusian secondary schools are bilingual, but this percentage rises to 66.7% in...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 在过去的二十年中，双语教育项目在西班牙教育系统中得到了显着扩展，其目的是改善外语学习（主要是英语），同时让所有人更容易获得外语学习。尽管越来越多的学校提供​​双语教育，但它们在全国各地的分布不均，造成了学生之间的不平等。 为了阐明这个问题，科尔多瓦大学（UCO）的一项研究分析了安达卢西亚双语学校的分布，揭示了人口最多的城市和直辖市（双语学校数量最多集中）与农村地区（双语学校仍然稀缺）之间的差距。 之前的研究已经指出了城市地区的不平等，这与家庭的经济状况和居住的社区密切相关。现在，一项新的研究扩大了范围，以解决城市之间基于人口规模的不平等问题。 正如作者所解释的那样，这一系列研究的目的是评估双语教育计划是否能够确保全体人口的平等机会，符合其设计的民主化目的。为此，该研究分析了安达卢西亚 2,500 多所小学和 1,600 所义务中学。结论很明确：城市越大，学校就越有可能提供双语教学。 该论文由UCO研究人员Alberto Álvarez Sotomayor（社会科学、哲学、地理学、翻译和口译系）和David Gutiérrez Rubio（数学系）与研究员Juan M. Gómez Espino（巴勃罗·德奥拉维德大学社会学系）和Carlos Lubián（政治学系和口译系）合作发表在《教育政策杂志》上。圣地亚哥德孔波斯特拉大学社会学）。 正如作者指出的，这项研究（EQUIBIL 项目的一部分）的数据揭示了可用双语资源的巨大差异，这支持了这些项目是精英主义和“以城市为中心”的说法。 在初等教育方面，安达卢西亚41.8%的学校提供​​双语教学。在居民超过 20,000 人的城市中，这一比例上升至 48.7%。然而，随着重点转向较小的社区，双语学校的数量逐渐减少，在居民人数不足 3,000 人的城市中，双语学校的比例降至 20% 以下。 同样的模式也适用于中学：56.1% 的安达卢西亚中学是双语学校，但这一比例在 2019 年上升至 66.7%。
