title.en: Hotel stigma may drive Chinese hospitality graduates away from careers
title.zh: 酒店耻辱可能会让中国酒店管理专业毕业生放弃职业生涯

summary.en: Research published in the International Journal of Environment and Sustainable Development analyzed interviews with more than 300 Chinese hotel interns to examine how perceptions of hotel work affect whether graduates pursue a career in the industry. The findings suggest that...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Research published in the International Journal of Environment and Sustainable Development analyzed interviews with more than 300 Chinese hotel interns to examine how perceptions of hotel work affect whether graduates pursue a career in the industry. The findings suggest that negative perceptions deter graduate interns from pursuing careers in hospitality.

Fundamentally, the team found that occupational stigma—the belief that a profession has low status or is undesirable—was most associated with weaker professional identity. Graduates with this perception generally did not choose hotel work as a career.

The findings highlight a significant recruitment problem for China's hotel industry. Despite its reliance on a large and stable workforce, only an estimated 10% to 20% of hospitality and tourism graduates enter the sector.

Moreover, internships, which are intended to provide graduates with practical experience early in their careers, sometimes reinforce negative perceptions and lead many graduates to leave the sector before they have taken more than a few tentative steps along this career path.

The study found that vocational skills sometimes offset the stigma. Interns with additional skills were less affected by negative perceptions of the industry. This suggests that practical training and professional certification might boost confidence in hotel careers and improve professional identity in the sector.

Feifei Yu et al, Hotel interns' career choice intentions from a high-versus-low climate changing region background, International Journal of Environment and Sustainable Development (2026). DOI: 10.1504/ijesd.2026.155727

body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 《国际环境与可持续发展杂志》上发表的研究分析了对 300 多名中国酒店实习生的采访，以研究对酒店工作的看法如何影响毕业生是否从事该行业的职业。研究结果表明，负面看法阻碍了毕业生实习生从事酒店业的职业生涯。 从根本上说，研究小组发现职业耻辱——认为某种职业地位低下或不受欢迎的信念——与较弱的职业认同最相关。具有这种认知的毕业生一般不会选择酒店工作作为职业。 调查结果凸显了中国酒店业面临的重大招聘问题。尽管酒店和旅游业依赖大量稳定的劳动力，但估计只有 10% 至 20% 的酒店和旅游业毕业生进入该行业。 此外，旨在为毕业生在职业生涯早期提供实践经验的实习有时会强化负面看法，导致许多毕业生在沿着职业道路迈出更多尝试性步骤之前就离开该行业。 研究发现，职业技能有时可以抵消这种耻辱。具有额外技能的实习生受行业负面看法的影响较小。这表明实践培训和专业认证可能会增强人们对酒店职业的信心并提高该行业的职业认同。 Feifei Yu等人，高气候变化地区与低气候变化地区背景下的酒店实习生的职业选择意向，国际环境与可持续发展杂志（2026）。 DOI：10.1504/ijesd.2026.155727 Swati Mestri 拥有电子工程学士学位，自 2019 年以来一直担任内容编辑。她拥有编辑技术、医疗保健和材料科学领域研究文档的经验，并且对技术和空间特别感兴趣。完整档案 → 物理学硕士，具有研究经验。长期科学新闻爱好者。在 Science X 的编辑成功中发挥着关键作用。完整档案 →

title.en: Process doubles the size of PFAS molecules, making them easy to destroy

summary.en: Ask a chemist to name the strongest single bond in organic chemistry, and they'll likely say carbon-fluorine. It's that bond, repeated dozens of times over, that gives per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) their nickname: forever chemicals. Manufacturers prize PFAS for the...

body.en: Ask a chemist to name the strongest single bond in organic chemistry, and they'll likely say carbon-fluorine. It's that bond, repeated dozens of times over, that gives per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) their nickname: forever chemicals. Manufacturers prize PFAS for the same reason regulators dread them. The bonds barely break down, which is exactly why the compounds are so good at repelling water, oil and heat in everything from semiconductor fabrication to nonstick cookware. This is also why PFAS persist in soil, water and living tissue long after serving their industrial purpose.
body.zh: 如果让化学家说出有机化学中最强的单键，他们很可能会说碳-氟。正是这种重复数十次的化学键赋予全氟烷基物质和多氟烷基物质 (PFAS) 绰号：永远的化学品。制造商青睐 PFAS 的原因与监管机构害怕它们的原因相同。这些键几乎不会断裂，这正是这些化合物在从半导体制造到不粘炊具等各种领域中如此出色的防水、防油和防热性能的原因。这也是为什么 PFAS 在达到其工业用途后很长一段时间内仍存在于土壤、水和活组织中。

title.en: What would happen to human interaction if AI could read our emotions?
title.zh: 如果人工智能能够解读我们的情绪，人​​类互动会发生什么？

summary.en: AI systems are increasingly being developed to recognize emotions by analyzing facial expressions, voices, body language and other physiological signals. Although the scientific validity of many of these systems remains contested, they are already being tested in health care and...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

AI systems are increasingly being developed to recognize emotions by analyzing facial expressions, voices, body language and other physiological signals. Although the scientific validity of many of these systems remains contested, they are already being tested in health care and security settings.

Rather than focusing on the technology's current shortcomings, PhD candidate Prégent asks a different question: What if these systems work exactly as intended? "Companies are showcasing all the benefits of these technologies," she says. "As philosophers and scholars, it's our job to wave a flag and show what could be at stake if they become reliable."

To explore the implications of fully functioning emotion recognition technologies (ERTs), Prégent developed several future scenarios. One involves a surgeon arriving at a hospital to perform an operation. Before she enters the operating room, an ERT system flags her as emotionally unstable. She is taken aside by her employer and prevented from operating.

The surgeon insists she is perfectly capable of carrying out the procedure. The reason for the alert has nothing to do with her professional skills. She is going through a difficult divorce and is worried about one of her children. Although she deliberately left those concerns at home, the technology has interpreted her emotional state as a reason to question whether she can do her job.

"The technology forces her to expose something that belongs to her private life," Prégent says. "She has to explain what is happening at home and justify why she believes she can still perform the operation. But the system has already judged her emotional state and a decision has been made."

For Prégent, the example illustrates a broader societal risk. People occupy many different social roles throughout their lives: They are surgeons, but also parents, partners, friends and neighbors. They usually decide for themselves which aspects of those roles they bring to a particular situation.

ERT, Prégent argues, could blur those boundaries. If people can no longer hide their inner emotions, the distinction between their private and professional lives is at risk of collapse. Instead of deciding for themselves what they reveal, people may find that technology exposes parts of their emotional lives and forces them to explain or defend them.

Prégent sees similar tensions beyond the workplace. She imagines a government representative delivering a public apology after a fatal incident. However, ERT indicates that they do not feel genuine sadness or regret. Instead of listening to the apology, the public...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 人工智能系统越来越多地被开发来通过分析面部表情、声音、肢体语言和其他生理信号来识别情绪。尽管其中许多系统的科学有效性仍然存在争议，但它们已经在医疗保健和安全环境中进行了测试。 博士候选人 Prégent 没有关注该技术当前的缺点，而是提出了一个不同的问题：如果这些系统完全按照预期工作会怎样？ “公司正在展示这些技术的所有好处，”她说。 “作为哲学家和学者，我们的工作就是挥舞旗帜，表明如果他们变得可靠，可能会面临什么危险。” 为了探索功能齐全的情绪识别技术 (ERT) 的影响，Prégent 开发了几种未来场景。其中一个涉及外科医生到达医院进行手术。在她进入手术室之前，ERT 系统将她标记为情绪不稳定。她被雇主带到一边并被禁止工作。 外科医生坚称她完全有能力进行手术。报警的原因与她的专业技能无关。她正在经历一场艰难的离婚，并担心她的一个孩子。尽管她故意将这些担忧留在家里，但技术已将她的情绪状态解读为质疑她是否能胜任工作的理由。 “技术迫使她暴露一些属于她私生活的东西，”普雷金特说。 “她必须解释家里发生的事情，并证明为什么她相信自己仍然可以进行手术。但系统已经判断了她的情绪状态，并做出了决定。” 对于普雷金特来说，这个例子说明了更广泛的社会风险。人们一生中扮演着许多不同的社会角色：他们是外科医生，也是父母、伴侣、朋友和邻居。他们通常会自己决定将这些角色的哪些方面应用于特定情况。 普雷金特认为，ERT 可能会模糊这些界限。如果人们无法再隐藏自己的内心情感，那么他们的私人生活和职业生活之间的区别就有崩溃的危险。人们可能会发现技术暴露了他们的部分情感生活，并迫使他们解释或捍卫它们，而不是自己决定要透露什么。 普雷金特在工作场所之外也看到了类似的紧张局势。她想象政府代表在发生致命事件后公开道歉。然而，ERT 表明他们并没有感到真正的悲伤或遗憾。公众没有听到道歉，而是......

title.en: Blood-clotting protein may be SARS-CoV-2's hidden accomplice, helping it hide from antibodies and reach blood vessels
title.zh: 凝血蛋白可能是 SARS-CoV-2 的隐藏同谋，帮助其躲避抗体并到达血管

summary.en: Fibrinogen, the abundant plasma protein best known for forming blood clots, may play a second and far less benign role during SARS-CoV-2 infection: acting as a molecular bridge that simultaneously hides the virus from neutralizing antibodies and delivers it to the cells lining...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Fibrinogen, the abundant plasma protein best known for forming blood clots, may play a second and far less benign role during SARS-CoV-2 infection: acting as a molecular bridge that simultaneously hides the virus from neutralizing antibodies and delivers it to the cells lining blood vessels.

That is the hypothesis put forward by Saroj Kumar Panda (Department of Chemistry and Biochemistry, University of Texas at Arlington), Shashi Singh, and Parth Sarthi Sen Gupta (School of Biosciences and Bioengineering, D Y Patil International University, Pune) in a Viewpoint article published in ACS Pharmacology & Translational Science .

The proposal offers a single mechanistic explanation for two features of COVID-19 that have long been treated as separate problems: the virus's ability to evade immunity and the vascular damage, microclotting and inflammation that characterize severe disease and long COVID.

SARS-CoV-2 is generally described as entering cells through the ACE2 receptor. But the spike protein carries clusters of positively charged lysine and arginine residues in its N-terminal domain (NTD) and receptor-binding domain (RBD). In contrast, human fibrinogen is negatively charged at physiological pH. The authors argue this electrostatic attraction is more than incidental chemistry.

When fibrinogen binds the spike NTD, it can mask antigenic sites, providing a molecular shield against antibody detection. At the same time, the other end of the fibrinogen molecule, its gamma chain, engages endothelial receptors including the integrins αvβ3 and α5β1, platelet receptor GPIIb/IIIa and ICAM-1. The result is a tether with the virus on one end and the blood vessel wall on the other.

To test whether the idea was structurally plausible, the team ran molecular docking studies. In their preliminary results, γ-fibrinogen bound to the spike NTD appeared to open up the RBD and NTD, making the RBD's RGD motif more accessible to integrins: Integrin binding strengthened to a HADDOCK score of −127 ± 6 kcal/mol with fibrinogen present, compared with −109.4 ± 4.9 kcal/mol without it.

Binding to ACE2 moved the opposite way. Spike bound ACE2 more strongly when fibrinogen was absent (−122 ± 4.6 kcal/mol) than when the complex had formed (−98.1 ± 4.8 kcal/mol). Taken together, the simulations suggest fibrinogen may not merely coat the virus but reshape it, nudging SARS-CoV-2 away from the classical ACE2 route and toward integrin-mediated entry into endothelial cells, the pathway most closely tied to inflammation and vascular injury.

title.en: World's oceans hit highest temperature on record as El Niño grows
title.zh: 随着厄尔尼诺现象的加剧，世界海洋达到有记录以来的最高温度

summary.en: The record "is another clear signal of an ocean under growing stress", according to Dr Samantha Burgess from the European Copernicus climate change service.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及受造之物关怀与环保责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
The world's oceans are hotter than ever recorded, new data suggests, as they suffer from human-caused climate change and the growing El Niño weather phenomenon.

The average surface temperature of the planet's seas outside the polar regions hit 21.1C (70F) on Saturday, according to figures from the European Copernicus climate change service.

That edges past the 21.09C recorded on three separate days in March 2024, and is far above average for the time of year.

Warmer oceans can have wide-reaching consequences, including supercharging extreme weather, raising sea levels and harming marine life.

"This record is another clear signal of an ocean under growing stress," said Dr Samantha Burgess, deputy director of Copernicus.

"El Niño is adding heat to the system, but it is doing so on top of decades of human-driven warming," she added.

The data is based on sea temperatures 10m (32ft 10in) below the surface, using measurements from buoys, ships and satellites, which are combined to produce a global estimate.

While the margin of record is currently very small and any global estimate comes with uncertainties, scientists say its timing is particularly notable.

Average worldwide sea temperatures tend to reach their yearly peak in March or April, which corresponds to the end of summer in the southern hemisphere - and not in August.

The southern hemisphere contains more of the planet's ocean surface than the northern hemisphere and so exerts a bigger influence on average sea temperatures.

What is especially concerning to scientists is that the oceans are already so hot when the natural El Niño weather phenomenon is still some way off its expected peak.

El Niño brings unusually warm waters to the surface of the eastern and central tropical Pacific Ocean. Warmer waters across such a large area means that global average temperatures typically spike too.

El Niño is expected to keep strengthening until Christmas time, with scientists warning that it is on course to be the strongest in centuries .

"The fact that we are already breaking records is an early indicator of how strong the El Niño is becoming," said Dr Jeremy Grist, senior research fellow at the National Oceanography Centre in Southampton.

"All things being equal we might expect the ocean temperature record to be broken again in March [or] April 2027," he added.

The waters far away from El Niño's Pacific hunting ground are also extremely warm, including around the UK and Europe.

The western English Channel has seen almost continuous marine heatwave conditions for more than three years, peaking at 7C above normal in July, according to Prof Tim Smyth, director of science at Plymouth Marine Laboratory.

body.zh: 新数据显示，由于人为气候变化和日益严重的厄尔尼诺天气现象，世界海洋的温度比以往任何时候都要高。 根据欧洲哥白尼气候变化服务机构的数据，周六极地以外的地球海洋表面平均温度达到 21.1 摄氏度（70 华氏度）。 这一气温略高于 2024 年 3 月连续三天记录的 21.09 摄氏度，远高于一年中该时期的平均气温。 海洋变暖可能会产生广泛的影响，包括加剧极端天气、海平面上升和损害海洋生物。 哥白尼副主任萨曼莎·伯吉斯博士说：“这一记录是海洋压力日益增大的另一个明显信号。” 她补充说：“厄尔尼诺现象正在给系统增加热量，但这是在数十年人为导致的变暖的基础上发生的。” 该数据基于海面以下 10 m（32 英尺 10 英寸）的海水温度，使用浮标、船舶和卫星的测量结果，将这些数据结合起来得出全球估计值。 虽然目前的记录差距非常小，而且任何全球估计都存在不确定性，但科学家表示，其时机尤其值得注意。 全球平均海水温度往往在三月或四月达到年度峰值，这对应于南半球的夏末，而不是八月。 南半球比北半球拥有更多的地球海洋表面，因此对平均海洋温度的影响更大。 让科学家们特别担心的是，当自然厄尔尼诺天气现象距离预期峰值还有一段距离时，海洋已经如此炎热。 厄尔尼诺现象给东部和中部热带太平洋海面带来异常温暖的海水。如此大面积的水域变暖意味着全球平均气温通常也会飙升。 厄尔尼诺现象预计将持续增强，直到圣诞节期间，科学家警告称，这将是几个世纪以来最强的一次。 南安普敦国家海洋学中心高级研究员杰里米·格里斯特博士说：“我们已经打破记录这一事实是厄尔尼诺现象变得多么强烈的早期指标。” 他补充道：“在所有条件相同的情况下，我们预计海洋温度记录将在 2027 年 3 月或 4 月再次被打破。” 远离厄尔尼诺现象的太平洋狩猎场的水域也非常温暖，包括英国和欧洲周围的水域。 普利茅斯海洋实验室科学主任蒂姆·史密斯教授表示，三年多来，西英吉利海峡几乎持续出现海洋热浪天气，7月份的最高气温比正常水平高出7摄氏度。 科学家表示，地球上如此普遍的变暖现象是这种影响日益增强的明显迹象......

summary.en: Common medications may reshape the gut microbiome long after the last dose is taken. In a study of more than 2,500 people, researchers found lasting microbial changes linked not only to antibiotics, but also to antidepressants, beta-blockers, acid-reducing drugs, and...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Common medications may reshape the gut microbiome long after the last dose is taken. In a study of more than 2,500 people, researchers found lasting microbial changes linked not only to antibiotics, but also to antidepressants, beta-blockers, acid-reducing drugs, and benzodiazepines. Some effects were still detectable years later, suggesting past medication use may strongly influence the gut bacteria people carry today.

title.en: Bird flu is spreading. Your backyard feeder could make it worse
title.zh: 禽流感正在蔓延。你的后院喂食器可能会让情况变得更糟

summary.en: Backyard bird feeders could become unexpected hotspots for H5N1 as Australia’s bird flu outbreak spreads, bringing species together in ways that rarely occur naturally. Experts say stopping feeding is safest, while smaller amounts of food, no hand-feeding, and careful cleaning...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及受造之物关怀与环保责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Backyard bird feeding is one of our country’s most popular pastimes. Research reveals about half of Australian households feed wild birds, with many people doing so daily.

However, this practice could act as a superspreader event – where a disease infects an unusually high number of people or animals – of the H5N1 virus. This deadly strain of bird flu has already decimated wild bird and mammal populations worldwide. It is now spreading across Australia, most recently killing more than 1,000 crested terns and a long-nosed fur seal, the first detection in a mainland mammal.

Although many Australians feed wild birds, the practice is controversial . This is mainly due to concerns about people offering unsuitable foods and birds becoming dependent on humans.

So why is backyard bird feeding such a problem when it comes to bird flu? And can we do it safely?

People feed wild birds for various reasons , including to provide food during tough times or simply enjoy their presence. Most care deeply about their avian companions and believe feeding them is helpful .

Feeding wild birds heightens the risk of disease transmission at feeding locations . When we offer supplementary food, such as seeds or meat scraps, this attracts birds of many different species in a combination and number that would not happen in nature. They may carry deadly diseases, such as the H5N1 virus, and potentially spread them to other birds.

This can create a transmission hotspot right on our back deck. And catching bird flu can push our most threatened species, such as the orange-bellied parrot , to the brink of extinction.

The fatal effects of H5N1 are not only contained to birds. Scavenger animals such as possums, red foxes and crows can be exposed to the virus while devouring the carcasses of infected birds. Humans in close contact with infected wildlife, such as wildlife carers and veterinarians, can contract H5N1. However, human infection is rare and typically only causes mild symptoms.

Backyard bird feeding may seem like a harmless hobby. But given how many people do it, and the risks it poses to both birds and people, bird feeding activities could lead to many more wildlife deaths .

The most effective strategy is to stop feeding birds altogether. If you don’t offer food to wild birds, they will be less likely to congregate in your backyard or garden. And they will be fine without your help. Our previous research found most birds that visit feeders obtain most of their nutrition from natural sources, such as insects and worms. So the food we provide is a snack, not an essential meal.

Having feeders full of seeds and leftover meat will attract more birds. So to discourage them from congregating, simply provide less food. Much like COVID-era social...
body.zh: 后院喂鸟是我国最受欢迎的消遣之一。研究显示，大约一半的澳大利亚家庭喂养野生鸟类，其中许多人每天都这样做。 然而，这种做法可能会成为 H5N1 病毒的超级传播事件——一种疾病感染异常多的人或动物。这种致命的禽流感病毒已经导致世界各地的野生鸟类和哺乳动物数量大量减少。它目前正在澳大利亚各地蔓延，最近导致 1,000 多只凤头燕鸥和一只长鼻海豹死亡，这是首次在大陆哺乳动物中发现这种病毒。 尽管许多澳大利亚人喂养野生鸟类，但这种做法存在争议。这主要是由于担心人们提供不合适的食物以及鸟类变得依赖人类。 那么，为什么在禽流感方面，后院喂鸟会成为一个问题呢？我们可以安全地做到这一点吗？ 人们出于各种原因喂养野生鸟类，包括在困难时期提供食物或只是享受它们的存在。大多数人非常关心他们的鸟类同伴，并相信喂养它们是有帮助的。 喂养野鸟会增加喂养地点疾病传播的风险。当我们提供补充食物（例如种子或肉末）时，会吸引许多不同物种的鸟类，其组合和数量在自然界中是不会发生的。它们可能携带致命疾病，例如 H5N1 病毒，并有可能将其传播给其他鸟类。 这可以在我们的后甲板上创建一个传输热点。感染禽流感可能会将橙腹鹦鹉等最受威胁的物种推向灭绝的边缘。 H5N1 的致命影响不仅限于鸟类。负鼠、红狐和乌鸦等食腐动物在吞食受感染鸟类的尸体时可能会接触到病毒。与受感染野生动物密切接触的人类，例如野生动物护理人员和兽医，可能会感染 H5N1。然而，人类感染很少见，通常只会引起轻微症状。 后院喂鸟似乎是一种无害的爱好。但考虑到有多少人这样做，以及它对鸟类和人类造成的风险，鸟类喂养活动可能会导致更多野生动物死亡。 最有效的策略是完全停止喂养鸟类。如果您不向野鸟提供食物，它们就不太可能聚集在您的后院或花园里。没有你的帮助，他们也会没事的。我们之前的研究发现，大多数访问喂食器的鸟类从昆虫和蠕虫等天然来源获取大部分营养。所以我们提供的食物是零食，而不是必需的膳食。 装满种子和剩余肉的喂食器会吸引更多的鸟类。因此，为了阻止他们聚集，只需提供更少的食物即可。就像新冠病毒时代的社交......

title.en: A ghostly ribbon of stars reveals hidden dark matter
title.zh: 一条幽灵般的星带揭示了隐藏的暗物质

summary.en: A faint ribbon of stars around a distant galaxy has become the first globular cluster stellar stream ever identified beyond the Milky Way. Because the stars trace the galaxy’s gravity, researchers used the stream to estimate how much invisible dark matter surrounds it and how...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
For billions of years, an ancient cluster of stars has been gradually coming apart, shedding stars that now form a faint, narrow ribbon across space. That delicate structure is offering astronomers a new way to investigate one of the universe's biggest mysteries.

An international research team, including an astrophysicist from Northwestern University, has identified the first stellar stream of this type ever observed outside the Milky Way. Astronomers have long predicted that such streams should exist around other galaxies, but their extreme faintness has made them difficult to detect.

The newly discovered stream also offers scientists an unusual tool for studying dark matter, which remains one of the major unanswered questions in astrophysics. By analyzing the stream's shape, researchers reconstructed the gravitational field of its host galaxy and used that information to determine how unseen dark matter influenced the stars' paths.

The findings could eventually help scientists investigate how dark matter is distributed across many different galaxies and throughout the universe.

"The stars in a stellar stream all travel along nearly the same orbit, and that orbit is shaped by the galaxy's gravity," said Northwestern's Tjitske Starkenburg, who coauthored the study. "By modeling that gravity, we can estimate the galaxy's total mass. We already know roughly how much of that mass comes from visible matter like stars, so the rest must be dark matter."

Starkenburg, an expert in extragalactic astronomy, is a research assistant professor at Northwestern's Center for Interdisciplinary Exploration and Research in Astrophysics. The study was co-led by Julie Kiel Holm of the University of Copenhagen and Sarah Pearson of the Technical University of Denmark.

Globular clusters are densely packed groups of stars held together by gravity. As one of these clusters travels around its host galaxy, the galaxy's gravitational pull can slowly strip stars away from it.

Those stars do not simply scatter in every direction. Instead, they tend to continue along nearly the same orbital path, creating long, thin stellar streams that retain information about the gravitational forces they have experienced.

Astronomers have identified dozens of streams produced by globular clusters inside the Milky Way. Until now, however, no comparable stream had been detected in another galaxy. Such structures are generally so faint that they disappear against the light of their host galaxies.

The breakthrough came through archival observations from NASA's Hubble Space Telescope presented by study coauthors David Sand and Catherine Fielder, both astronomers at the University of Arizona. While study coauthor David Hendel was examining images of the ultra-diffuse galaxy UGC 9050-Dw1 for...
body.zh: 数十亿年来，古老的星团逐渐分裂，脱落的恒星现在在太空中形成一条微弱而狭窄的丝带。这种微妙的结构为天文学家提供了一种研究宇宙最大谜团之一的新方法。 包括西北大学天体物理学家在内的一个国际研究小组发现了在银河系外首次观测到的此类恒星流。天文学家长期以来一直预测，此类流应该存在于其他星系周围，但它们的极度微弱使它们难以被发现。 新发现的暗物质流还为科学家提供了一种不寻常的工具来研究暗物质，暗物质仍然是天体物理学中尚未解答的主要问题之一。通过分析该流的形状，研究人员重建了其宿主星系的引力场，并利用该信息来确定看不见的暗物质如何影响恒星的路径。 这些发现最终可以帮助科学家研究暗物质如何分布在许多不同的星系和整个宇宙中。 “恒星流中的恒星都沿着几乎相同的轨道运行，而该轨道是由星系的引力决定的，”西北大学的蒂斯克·斯塔肯堡（Tjitske Starkenburg）说，他是这项研究的合著者。 “通过对引力进行建模，我们可以估计星系的总质量。我们已经大致知道其中有多少质量来自恒星等可见物质，所以其余的一定是暗物质。” 斯塔肯伯格是河外天文学专家，西北大学天体物理学跨学科探索与研究中心的研究助理教授。这项研究由哥本哈根大学的 Julie Kiel Holm 和丹麦技术大学的 Sarah Pearson 共同领导。 球状星团是由重力聚集在一起的密集恒星团。当这些星团之一围绕其宿主星系运行时，星系的引力会慢慢地将恒星从它身上剥离。 这些星星并不简单地分散在各个方向。相反，它们倾向于继续沿着几乎相同的轨道路径运行，产生又长又细的恒星流，保留有关它们所经历的引力的信息。 天文学家已经发现了银河系内部球状星团产生的数十条流。然而，到目前为止，尚未在另一个星系中检测到类似的流。这些结构通常非常微弱，以至于它们在宿主星系的光线下消失了。 这一突破来自美国宇航局哈勃太空望远镜的档案观测，该观测由研究合著者、亚利桑那大学的天文学家大卫·桑德和凯瑟琳·菲尔德提出。当研究合著者 David Hendel 正在检查超漫射星系 UGC 9050-Dw1 的图像时……

title.en: Too much or too little sleep may make your body age faster
title.zh: 睡眠过多或过少都可能使身体衰老得更快

summary.en: Both too little and too much sleep may be linked to faster aging throughout the body. Researchers analyzing 23 biological aging clocks found the lowest aging levels among people sleeping about 6.4 to 7.8 hours per day. Short or long sleep was also associated with numerous...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A new analysis of biological aging across the human body suggests that both sleeping too little and sleeping too much are associated with faster aging in the brain, heart, lungs, immune system, and other organs. These sleep patterns were also linked to a broad range of diseases.

"Previous studies have found that sleep is largely linked to aging and the pathological burden of the brain. Our study goes further and shows that too little and too much sleep are associated with faster aging in nearly every organ, supporting the idea that sleep is important in maintaining organ health within a coordinated brain-body network, including metabolic balance and a healthy immune system," says study leader Junhao Wen, assistant professor of radiology at Columbia University Vagelos College of Physicians and Surgeons.

Scientists are increasingly using aging clocks to estimate whether a person is aging biologically faster or slower than their chronological age. These tools rely on machine learning and biological information (e.g., proteins from a minimally invasive blood test) to calculate patterns associated with aging.

Many aging clocks provide a single measure for the entire body. However, different organs can age at different speeds. One familiar example is the decline in ovarian function that contributes to the biological clock associated with female fertility.

Wen and his colleagues have been developing aging clocks that focus on individual organs. The goal is to provide more detailed and potentially more personalized information about a person's health.

"Everyone is excited by these aging clocks and their ability to predict disease and mortality risk," Wen says. "But to me, the more exciting question is, can we link aging clocks to a lifestyle factor that can be modified in time to slow aging?"

Sleep offered researchers an ideal way to explore that question because mounting evidence suggests that sleep plays an important role in health. Wen also had a personal interest in the issue.

"I'm also a light sleeper and was getting worried about the effects on myself," says Wen.

To create the aging clocks, Wen used information from about half a million participants in the UK Biobank. Machine learning was applied to identify biological signatures associated with aging in different organs.

The researchers built clocks using several types of information, including structural measurements from medical imaging, proteins associated with specific organs, and molecules detected in the blood.

"In the liver, for example, we have an aging clock built with protein data, an aging clock of metabolic data, and an aging clock of imaging data," Wen says. "This allows us to see whether sleep is distinctively associated with aging clocks derived from multiple omics and...
body.zh: 一项对人体生物衰老的新分析表明，睡眠过少和睡眠过多都与大脑、心脏、肺、免疫系统和其他器官的加速衰老有关。这些睡眠模式也与多种疾病有关。 “之前的研究发现，睡眠在很大程度上与衰老和大脑的病理负担有关。我们的研究更进一步，表明睡眠太少和太多都与几乎每个器官的衰老速度加快有关，这支持了这样的观点，即睡眠对于维持协调的脑体网络中的器官健康非常重要，包括代谢平衡和健康的免疫系统，”研究负责人、哥伦比亚大学瓦格洛斯内外科医学院放射学助理教授文俊豪说。 科学家越来越多地使用衰老时钟来估计一个人的生物学衰老速度是否比实际年龄快或慢。这些工具依靠机器学习和生物信息（例如，微创血液测试中的蛋白质）来计算与衰老相关的模式。 许多老化时钟为整个身体提供单一测量。然而，不同的器官会以不同的速度老化。一个熟悉的例子是卵巢功能下降，这会影响与女性生育能力相关的生物钟。 温和他的同事们一直在开发关注个体器官的衰老时钟。目标是提供有关个人健康的更详细且可能更个性化的信息。 “每个人都对这些衰老时钟及其预测疾病和死亡风险的能力感到兴奋，”文说。 “但对我来说，更令人兴奋的问题是，我们能否将衰老时钟与可以及时改变以减缓衰老的生活方式因素联系起来？” 睡眠为研究人员提供了探索这个问题的理想方法，因为越来越多的证据表明睡眠在健康中发挥着重要作用。温家宝对这个问题也有个人兴趣。 “我的睡眠质量也很浅，我很担心这对自己造成的影响，”文说。 为了创建衰老时钟，温使用了英国生物银行约 50 万参与者的信息。应用机器学习来识别与不同器官衰老相关的生物特征。 研究人员利用多种类型的信息构建了时钟，包括医学成像的结构测量、与特定器官相关的蛋白质以及血液中检测到的分子。 “例如，在肝脏中，我们有一个由蛋白质数据构建的衰老时钟、一个代谢数据的衰老时钟和一个成像数据的衰老时钟，”文说。 “这使我们能够了解睡眠是否与来自多个组学的衰老时钟有明显的相关性，并且......

title.en: Screen time at ages 1 and 6 may matter more than parents realize
title.zh: 1 岁和 6 岁的屏幕时间可能比父母意识到的更重要

summary.en: More screen time during infancy and around the start of school was linked to poorer academic performance and weaker working memory years later. The findings suggest that early childhood may contain particularly sensitive windows when screen habits can have longer-lasting effects.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Screens are now a routine part of life for many young children, raising growing questions about how early exposure could influence development over time. New longitudinal research that tracked children from age 1 through age 8 found that greater screen viewing, especially during infancy and around the time children begin school, was associated with lower academic performance at age 9 and weaker working memory at age 10.5. The results suggest that when children are exposed to screens could matter just as much as how much time they spend using them.

The World Health Organization (WHO) and the American Academy of Pediatrics recommend avoiding screen use before 18-24 months and limiting it to less than one hour per day for children ages 2 to 5. Many children, however, spend more time with screens than those guidelines advise. Research into the effects of screen viewing on cognitive development has also produced mixed results. Much of the previous work has relied on snapshots taken at a single point in time, focused mainly on school-age children, or lacked repeated measurements throughout early childhood. Studies that follow children across several developmental stages can help identify periods when screen exposure may be especially important while also accounting more effectively for family and environmental factors.

Researchers from Inserm and the National University of Singapore conducted the study, which was published in the World Journal of Pediatrics . Using information from the Growing Up in Singapore Towards healthy Outcomes (GUSTO) birth cohort, the team examined parent-reported screen viewing at six different ages. They then compared those measurements with children's academic performance and working memory several years later.

The analysis included 502 children who were followed from infancy into middle childhood. Higher screen viewing during certain stages of development was associated with poorer academic results later on and weaker working memory. The clearest patterns appeared for screen exposure during infancy and near the beginning of formal schooling, indicating that these periods may be particularly sensitive for cognitive development.

Children who accumulated more screen exposure across childhood also tended to perform less well academically. Together, the findings suggest that total viewing time is only part of the picture. The age at which heavier screen use occurs may also be important, with early childhood potentially representing a period when screen habits have longer-term implications for learning and memory.

title.en: UK's rarest bird of prey rears new chicks in secret location
title.zh: 英国最稀有的猛禽在秘密地点抚养新雏鸟

summary.en: The Montagu Harrier successfully nested for the second year running in the same secret location.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
The UK's rarest bird of prey has successfully nested for the second year running in the same secret location, the Royal Society for the Protection of Birds (RSPB) has reported.

A male Montagu's harrier, known as "AU" by conservationists, bred with two different females, rearing six chicks across two nests on English farmland.

Montagu's harriers were put on a "red list" of birds most at risk in the UK in 2021. Numbers have declined from a high of nine successful nests in 2011, to no evidence of successful breeding between 2020 and 2024.

An RSPB spokesperson said: "We are doing our absolute utmost to save this iconic species in the UK and are delighted with six flying juveniles this year."

The charity said careful monitoring, in partnership with the farmers on whose land the birds nested, meant the nests were protected by fences to exclude ground predators such as foxes.

The single male Montagu's harrier has also been working very hard to keep his two nests of hungry chicks fed.

The BBC was given exclusive access to the nest and was able to witness some of the spectacular feeding behaviour of the raptors: the male drops prey in mid-air and the female rolls upside down to catch it in her talons.

These slender, long-winged raptors make an epic annual migration to Africa in winter and return to Europe to nest over summer, often setting up home in agricultural fields.

But little is known about the behaviour of juvenile harriers once they leave the nest. This year, for the first time, the RSPB has fitted two of the chicks with satellite tags in the hope of providing the birds with better protection.

"It will allow us for the first time ever to work out where they're going, what migration route, how long they'll spend there, and will they come back to the UK in the first year or the second year," said Mark Thomas, head of investigations at the RSPB.

It is also hoped the tagging can better protect the rare birds from having their nests, on the ground, hidden among crops, inadvertently destroyed.

"This is a species right on the brink, and climate change is not helping that. The harvest here, for example, this year, was like a month earlier than in previous years. So it almost puts any Montagu's harrier nest at the peril of inadvertently being destroyed by farm machinery," said Thomas.

Conservationists have urged birders to look out for the youngsters, and report any sightings by emailing the RSPB's Montagu's hotline at montys@rspb.org.uk.
body.zh: 据英国皇家鸟类保护协会 (RSPB) 报道，英国最稀有的猛禽已连续第二年在同一秘密地点成功筑巢。 一只雄性蒙塔古鹞被自然资源保护者称为“AU”，与两只不同的雌性一起繁殖，在英国农田的两个巢中养育了六只雏鸟。 2021 年，蒙塔古鹞被列入英国最危险鸟类的“红色名单”。数量已从 2011 年成功筑巢 9 个的高峰下降到 2020 年至 2024 年间没有成功繁殖的证据。 皇家鸟类保护协会的一位发言人表示：“我们正在尽最大努力拯救英国的这一标志性物种，我们对今年有六只飞行幼崽感到高兴。” 该慈善机构表示，与鸟儿筑巢的土地上的农民合作进行仔细监控，意味着鸟巢受到栅栏的保护，以排除狐狸等地面掠食者。 单身雄性蒙塔古鹞也一直在非常努力地工作，以保证他的两窝饥饿的雏鸟有吃的。 英国广播公司获得了进入猛禽巢穴的独家访问权限，并目睹了猛禽的一些壮观的进食行为：雄性猛禽将猎物抛在半空中，雌性则翻滚着用爪子捕捉猎物。 这些细长、长翼的猛禽每年冬天都会进行一次史诗般的迁徙，前往非洲，并在夏天返回欧洲筑巢，通常在农田里安家。 但人们对幼年鹞离开巢穴后的行为知之甚少。今年，皇家鸟类保护协会首次为其中两只小鸟安装了卫星标签，希望为这些小鸟提供更好的保护。 英国皇家鸟类保护协会调查负责人马克·托马斯表示：“这将使我们有史以来第一次弄清楚他们要去哪里、迁徙路线是什么、他们将在那里待多久，以及他们会在第一年还是第二年回到英国。” 人们还希望标签能够更好地保护这些稀有鸟类的巢穴，它们在地面上、隐藏在农作物中的巢穴不会被无意中破坏。 “这是一个濒临灭绝的物种，气候变化对此无济于事。例如，今年这里的收成比往年早了一个月。因此，这几乎使任何蒙塔古鹞巢都面临着被农业机械无意中摧毁的危险，”托马斯说。 环保人士敦促观鸟者留意这些幼鸟，并通过电子邮件报告皇家鸟类保护协会蒙塔古热线：montys@rspb.org.uk。

title.en: Songs created by AI banned from Australia's music charts
title.zh: 澳大利亚音乐排行榜禁止人工智能创作的歌曲

summary.en: The move comes weeks after a DJ admitted using AI to remix a Madonna song that topped the Australian charts.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Songs that are largely or wholly created by AI have been banned from Australia's music charts.

The Australian Recording Industry Association (ARIA) said the new code would help "promote the human nature of artistry".

It follows a controversy around a cover of Madonna's Like A Prayer by Australian DJ Josh Fawaz which recently topped the ARIA dance singles chart and peaked at number 2 on the country's overall chart.

The song has become a staple of commercial radio station playlists and been streamed more than 48 million times on Spotify alone.

ARIA said that Australian artists were competing for attention "in the most crowded market in history" and that it was "not interested in promoting or celebrating the success of AI-generated music that does not contain human artistry".

Under the new rules, AI assistance can still be used, but humans must have written the song, and have performed the lead vocal and primary instruments.

AI can also still be used for mastering songs and, for example, using drum machines and auto tune.

Earlier this year a song was banned from Sweden's music charts because it was created by AI.

And in July, the International Federation of the Phonographic Industry (IFPI) said AI guidelines would be rolled out in Latin America, the Middle East, Africa and Southeast Asia for use in their official charts.

The updated code, based on the IFPI directive, also excludes music that raises "stream or chart manipulation concerns".

ARIA chief executive Annabelle Herd said: "These changes reflect our intent to remain dynamic and promote the human nature of artistry in what is, to say the least, a rapidly developing space."

"Artists already use AI tools in their work, the charts can and should evolve to keep room for that, but music generated wholesale by services built on artists' recordings is a different matter."

She added: "A chart that rewards unlicensed AI output would undercut the very basis of the recorded music we exist to represent."

Artists will be required to declare AI use when they submit a song for chart consideration.

ARIA said that if it later emerged music was largely AI-generated it could retrospectively adjust chart positions, and if the piece topped the charts, it may request that awards given for reaching Number One were returned.

Last month, they shared an AI-assisted version of their 2014 hit High on Instagram, captioned: "When you re-record your own song with AI so Australian radio will play it."

Band member Adam Hyde told Channel Nine's Today show that AI-generated music was "removing the human experience from life".

In July this year, Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese promised "the strongest possible protection" from AI for Australian creatives.

title.en: AI is hitting entry-level jobs hardest, Stanford study finds
title.zh: 斯坦福大学研究发现，人工智能对入门级工作的打击最大

summary.en: Young employment in AI-impacted fields down 19% compared to more AI-resistant occupations.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及管家责任、供应与公共福祉。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: For years , AI industry watchers of all stripes have been warning of a coming jobs apocalypse driven by ultra-intelligent AI systems that will be able to replicate most human tasks more cheaply. Now, newly updated research from Stanford University economists suggests AI seems to be causing significant entry-level job losses for younger workers in some fields, even as older workers appear largely unaffected so far. The August 2026 edition of "Canaries in the Coal Mine? Six Facts about the Recent Employment Effects of Artificial Intelligence" updates and revises a paper of the same name published last year with fresh data and refined statistics. In that update, the Stanford researchers find the employment trends they identified for entry-level workers last year are persisting and expanding. Specifically, employment levels for workers aged 22 to 25 in the most "AI-exposed" occupations are now 19 percent below those of their peers in fields less exposed to AI disruption. Last year, that gap measured just 13 percent. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 多年来，各行各业的人工智能行业观察家一直警告称，由超智能人工智能系统驱动的就业灾难即将到来，这些系统将能够以更便宜的成本复制大多数人类任务。现在，斯坦福大学经济学家最新的研究表明，人工智能似乎正在导致某些领域的年轻工人大量入门级失业，尽管老年工人到目前为止似乎基本上没有受到影响。 2026 年 8 月版《煤矿里的金丝雀？人工智能近期就业影响的六个事实》更新和修订了去年发表的同名论文，提供了新的数据和精细的统计数据。在那次更新中，斯坦福大学的研究人员发现，他们去年确定的入门级工人的就业趋势正在持续存在并扩大。具体来说，从事“受人工智能影响最大”职业的 22 至 25 岁工人的就业水平目前比受人工智能影响较少的领域的同龄人低 19%。去年，这一差距仅为 13%。阅读全文 评论

title.en: Data centers become "killer application" for new power transformer tech
title.zh: 数据中心成为新型电力变压器技术的“杀手级应用”

summary.en: Solid-state transformers could also benefit EV charging and someday households.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Data centers have become the largest driver of surging electricity demand that is straining US power grids. But the AI data center boom has also accelerated investment in a technology that could provide a silver lining for everyone—solid-state power transformers that replace industrial-age technology with modern power electronics. Power grids currently rely on conventional transformer technology that is painstakingly assembled by hand and has a fundamental design dating back to the 1880s. Two copper wire coils manually wound around a steel core create electromagnetic fields that help step up voltage levels of alternating current electricity for long-distance transmission or step down voltage levels for the electricity use of homes and businesses. The largest power transformers cannot be mass-manufactured but are instead custom-built for each utility company’s electrical substations. Manufacturing constraints, coupled with the scramble to upgrade US power infrastructure, have meant utility companies and other customers must wait up to several years for delivery of new power transformers. That is not only a problem for expanding power grid infrastructure to support growing electricity demand, but also delays the process of replacing aging power transformers. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 数据中心已成为电力需求激增的最大推动力，这给美国电网带来了压力。但人工智能数据中心的繁荣也加速了对一项技术的投资，这项技术可以为每个人带来一线希望——用现代电力电子技术取代工业时代技术的固态电力变压器。目前，电网依赖于手工精心组装的传统变压器技术，其基本设计可以追溯到 1880 年代。手动缠绕在钢芯上的两个铜线线圈会产生电磁场，有助于提高交流电的电压水平以进行长距离传输，或降低电压水平以供家庭和企业用电。最大的电力变压器无法大规模制造，而是为每个公用事业公司的变电站定制。制造限制，加上美国电力基础设施升级的争夺，意味着公用事业公司和其他客户必须等待数年才能交付新的电力变压器。这不仅是扩大电网基础设施以支持不断增长的电力需求的问题，而且还推迟了更换老化电力变压器的进程。阅读全文 评论

title.en: RFK Jr. may upend how vaccine recommendations are categorized
title.zh: RFK Jr. 可能会颠覆疫苗建议的分类方式

summary.en: There are currently 3 categories. Without reason, RFK Jr. is considering changes.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Under anti-vaccine Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr., the US health department is considering changing how vaccine recommendations are categorized and described. The move creates the possibility that vaccinations currently considered "routine" or "universal" could be given new designations that sound less definitive or more conditional, such as "recommended with qualification" or recommended based on "shared clinical decision-making." Kennedy has made no new rules or recommendations for the categories yet. However, he laid out ideas and possibilities in a Request for Information (RFI) posted online Friday and published in the Federal Register on Monday . In the 10-page document , Kennedy poses questions about the current categories and asks the public to weigh in on ideas for how to change or replace them. The deadline to comment on the questions and ideas is September 20. Currently, there are three categories of vaccination recommendations granted by the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, which is informed by a panel of independent expert advisors, the Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices (ACIP). The three categories are: routine, otherwise considered universal (a recommendation that everyone should get a vaccine); risk-based recommendations (only certain groups at higher risk should get a vaccine); and recommendations based on "shared clinical decision-making," or SCDM (a flexible but uncommon recommendation for vaccination based on the characteristics, values, and preferences of a patient and the judgment of their healthcare provider). Read full article Comments
body.zh: 在反疫苗的卫生部长小罗伯特·F·肯尼迪的领导下，美国卫生部门正在考虑改变疫苗建议的分类和描述方式。此举创造了一种可能性，即目前被认为是“常规”或“通用”的疫苗可能会被赋予新的名称，这些名称听起来不那么明确或更有条件，例如“有资格推荐”或基于“共同临床决策”推荐。肯尼迪尚未针对这些类别制定新的规则或建议。不过，他在周五在线发布并于周一在《联邦公报》上发表的信息请求 (RFI) 中阐述了想法和可能性。在这份长达 10 页的文件中，肯尼迪提出了有关当前类别的问题，并要求公众就如何改变或取代它们提出意见。对问题和想法发表评论的截止日期是 9 月 20 日。目前，疾病控制和预防中心授予了三类疫苗接种建议，这些建议由独立专家顾问小组、免疫实践咨询委员会 (ACIP) 提供信息。这三个类别是：常规的，否则被认为是普遍的（建议每个人都应该接种疫苗）；基于风险的建议（只有某些风险较高的群体才应该接种疫苗）；基于“共同临床决策”或 SCDM 的建议（根据患者的特征、价值观和偏好及其医疗保健提供者的判断而提出的灵活但不常见的疫苗接种建议）。阅读全文 评论

title.en: Ads and tracking infiltrated TVs. Now they're coming for monitors.
title.zh: 广告和跟踪渗透到电视中。现在他们来找显示器了。

summary.en: Monitor vendors are playing with fire.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Ads and tracking have turned TVs into privacy nightmares . Both are so widespread among smart TVs that I’ve written a guide for avoiding them . One recommendation in that guide is to use a computer monitor. But in recent years, monitors have become more capable of pushing ads and tracking users. Without more straightforward approaches from vendors, such as easily comprehensible privacy policies and avoiding inappropriate ads, monitors are dangerously encroaching into smart-TV-like territory. LG monitors’ McAfee ads LG lost some trust after a recent report that some of its monitors installed McAfee pop-up ads onto connected computers . Since at least 2024 , some of these displays installed an app, LG Monitor App Installer, onto connected computers under the cover of driver updates installed through Windows Update. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 广告和跟踪已将电视变成了隐私噩梦。这两种情况在智能电视中都非常普遍，因此我编写了一份避免它们的指南。该指南中的一项建议是使用计算机显示器。但近年来，显示器推送广告和跟踪用户的能力变得越来越强。如果供应商没有采取更直接的方法，例如易于理解的隐私政策和避免不当广告，显示器就会危险地侵入类似智能电视的领域。 LG 显示器的迈克菲广告 最近有报道称 LG 显示器的一些显示器在联网计算机上安装了迈克菲弹出广告，导致 LG 失去了一些信任。至少从 2024 年开始，其中一些显示器在通过 Windows 更新安装的驱动程序更新的掩护下，在连接的计算机上安装了一个应用程序 LG Monitor App Installer。阅读全文 评论

title.en: GM vehicles under federal scrutiny after hundreds of reports
title.zh: 数百份报告后，通用汽车汽车接受联邦审查

summary.en: The eBoost brake-by-wire system is responsible for at least 22 crashes now.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: The federal government is expanding a safety investigation into a number of vehicles manufactured by General Motors after receiving hundreds of reports of brake failure. The problem affects more than 1.1 million cars, including many of GM's electric vehicles, as well as ones it has built for Honda and Acura. The problem is with the brake-by-wire system (which GM calls eBoost ), which can suffer a spindle fracture while driving. GM says that in the event of that happening, the car should still retain a number of critical safety features—antilock brakes, traction control, and stability control—at least until it comes to a complete stop, at which point they become inoperable. But NHTSA's ODI says that it has received many reports that contradict this behavior and allege that eBoost failures are followed by an immediate loss of braking, which obviously poses a safety risk. Indeed, NHTSA has received 227 incident reports, a number that grows to 745 once you include the hundreds of occurrences reported to GM. Twenty-two cases resulted in crashes, and while six people have been injured in five crashes, thankfully there have been no fatal incidents. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 在收到数百份制动故障报告后，联邦政府正在扩大对通用汽车制造的一些车辆的安全调查。该问题影响了超过 110 万辆汽车，其中包括通用汽车的许多电动汽车，以及为本田和讴歌生产的汽车。问题出在线控制动系统（通用汽车称之为 eBoost ）上，该系统在行驶时可能会发生主轴断裂。通用汽车表示，如果发生这种情况，汽车仍应保留一些关键的安全功能——防抱死制动、牵引力控制和稳定性控制——至少直到它完全停止为止，此时它们将变得无法操作。但 NHTSA 的 ODI 表示，它已收到许多与这种行为相矛盾的报告，并声称 eBoost 故障后会立即失去制动能力，这显然会带来安全风险。事实上，NHTSA 已收到 227 起事故报告，如果算上向通用汽车报告的数百起事故，这一数字将增至 745 起。有 22 起事故导致了车祸，虽然 5 起事故中有 6 人受伤，但幸运的是没有发生致命事故。阅读全文 评论

title.en: Sharing dangerous driving videos is 'truly reprehensible', PM says
title.zh: 总理表示，分享危险驾驶视频“确实应受到谴责”

summary.en: His comments come as the government urged TikTok and other social media firms to remove wrong-way driving videos.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
The government has urged social media companies to remove posts celebrating dangerous driving, as Prime Minister Andy Burnham branded sharing them "truly reprehensible".

Earlier Defence Minister Luke Pollard told BBC Breakfast that "social media companies could take the content down easily and adjust their algorithms to stop it being distributed".

Two police officers died when a car going the wrong way down a dual carriageway crashed into their vehicle near Middlesbrough on Saturday. Five passengers in the other car were also killed.

A TikTok account believed to belong to one of the five passengers, 18-year-old Makai Saddington, previously shared videos appearing to show dangerous driving, which have since been removed.

But Cleveland Police said "there is no evidence to indicate that filming of the activities that took place on Friday night and Saturday morning has taken place for the purposes of TikTok".

Pollard said the government had "already taken steps" to tell social media companies to take down such content.

He added: "They know exactly what content is on their site, they know how their algorithm works.

"They also know that people post content to get views and the more views you get, sometimes you get money for it, so it's a financial incentive to post outrageous content that gets more people watching it."

Speaking to reporters in Kyiv, Burnham said the people who share footage glorifying dangerous driving are "doing something that's truly reprehensible".

A Downing Street spokeswoman said "the glorification of dangerous driving for clips and entertainment is utterly disgraceful".

She added that the culture secretary has been clear that footage should be removed by social media platforms "in line with their legal obligations", and that Ofcom has the government's "full backing to take action" against those that fail in their duties.

Video content featuring illegal activity is not necessarily illegal itself - according to the Online Safety Act - it is up to the social network to decide whether flagged content is illegal and act accordingly.

TikTok said its policies prohibit content that could cause significant physical harm, including dangerous driving.

It added that it is actively removing videos and accounts that break its rules, including the account believed to belong to Saddington.

The company said between January and March 2026, 99.8% of the content removed for violating those policies it took down proactively.

While TikTok is taking some videos down, it is not necessarily because it has deemed them to be illegal - it may only be because they breach the firm's own terms and conditions.

There are specific exceptions which are set out in the Online Safety Act, but they can be difficult to interpret.

title.en: Twitch and Amazon face legal action over using livestreams to train AI
title.zh: Twitch 和亚马逊因使用直播训练人工智能而面临法律诉讼

summary.en: The lawsuit alleges Twitch used streamers' videos to train AI without their permission or proper compensation.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Amazon is facing a lawsuit , external over its move to train its AI models on videos people broadcast on the popular streaming platform Twitch.

The move faced backlash from users when it was announced in August - with people having the option to opt-out if they do not want their data used this way.

The class action lawsuit has been brought on behalf of millions of streamers who use Twitch, alleging its parent company Amazon used their videos to train AI without their permission or proper compensation.

Streamers on the platform reportedly produced , external more than 215 million hours of content in the first few months of 2026 alone.

It claims Twitch breached its contract with users by using that content as AI training data for Amazon's models without obtaining their permission.

It adds streamers should not have their work commercially exploited to develop AI without consent or compensation.

The lawsuit seeks damages for streamers whose content was allegedly used to train AI, as well as an order preventing Amazon from continuing the alleged practice.

It is not clear when Amazon began collecting Twitch users' data to train its AI models.

Twitch's chief product officer Mike Minton previously said he did not know if users' data had been scraped for training before it gave people the opportunity to opt-out.

He said he was unsure what Amazon "has done in terms of model training and what they've used and not used".

In Twitch's own FAQs about AI training, it said a person's audio might be used to "refine models that create speech to text".

It said this would help improve automatic subtitles on Twitch streams as well as Amazon videos.

Those that want to disable the feature would need to navigate to the Settings tab in their Streamer Dashboard, click the Security and Privacy tab, then scroll down to near the bottom of the options and toggle off "training for Generative AI".

However, the opt-out only applies to individual streams, meaning creators' content could still be used for AI training when they appear in a stream where the feature remains enabled.

Amazon, which bought Twitch for nearly $1bn (£740m) in 2014, has made AI a major focus as it competes with Google, Meta and other tech giants.

Sign up for our Tech Decoded newsletter to follow the world's top tech stories and trends. Outside the UK? Sign up here .
body.zh: 亚马逊因在热门流媒体平台 Twitch 上播放的视频上训练其人工智能模型而面临外部诉讼。 此举在 8 月份宣布时遭到了用户的强烈反对，如果人们不希望自己的数据以这种方式使用，他们可以选择退出。 该集体诉讼是代表数百万使用 Twitch 的主播提起的，指控其母公司亚马逊在未经许可或适当补偿的情况下使用他们的视频来训练人工智能。 据报道，仅 2026 年前几个月，该平台上的流媒体就制作了超过 2.15 亿小时的内容。 它声称 Twitch 在未经用户许可的情况下将这些内容用作亚马逊模型的人工智能训练数据，违反了与用户的合同。 它还补充说，未经同意或补偿，主播不应将其作品用于商业用途以开发人工智能。 该诉讼要求对内容据称被用来训练人工智能的流媒体造成损害，并要求下令阻止亚马逊继续其所谓的做法。 目前尚不清楚亚马逊何时开始收集 Twitch 用户数据来训练其人工智能模型。 Twitch 的首席产品官迈克·明顿 (Mike Minton) 此前表示，他不知道用户的数据是否已被抓取用于培训，然后才给人们选择退出的机会。 他表示，他不确定亚马逊“在模型训练方面做了什么，以及他们使用了什么和没有使用什么”。 在 Twitch 自己的关于人工智能训练的常见问题解答中，它表示一个人的音频可能会被用来“改进创建语音到文本的模型”。 该公司表示，这将有助于改进 Twitch 流媒体和亚马逊视频的自动字幕。 想要禁用该功能的用户需要导航到 Streamer 仪表板中的“设置”选项卡，单击“安全和隐私”选项卡，然后向下滚动到选项底部附近并关闭“生成 AI 训练”。 然而，选择退出仅适用于单个流，这意味着当创作者的内容出现在该功能保持启用的流中时，仍然可以用于人工智能训练。 亚马逊于 2014 年以近 10 亿美元（7.4 亿英镑）的价格收购了 Twitch，在与谷歌、Meta 和其他科技巨头竞争时，已将人工智能作为主要焦点。 订阅我们的 Tech Decoded 时事通讯，了解世界顶级科技故事和趋势。在英国以外？在这里注册。

summary.en: Players will get what they expect from the new CoD title: boots-on-the-ground military action with a slight tactical edge. But what’s with all the distractions? There’s a lot riding on this year’s Call of Duty, the inescapable first-person shootfest that’s been lobbing a grenade...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Players will get what they expect from the new CoD title: boots-on-the-ground military action with a slight tactical edge. But what’s with all the distractions? There’s a lot riding on this year’s Call of Duty, the inescapable first-person shootfest that’s been lobbing a grenade into the autumn release schedule since 2003. Previous instalment, Black Ops 7, performed poorly compared to previous titles, forcing Activision to post a semi-apology to fans. And that’s not the only challenge Modern Warfare 4 is facing: there’s a new indie shooter, Wardogs, promising a feel somewhere between classic CoD and Classic Battlefield. Then, lurking on the horizon, in mirror shades and an exotic sports car, is Grand Theft Auto 6, which is surely going to smash and grab all the attention (and money) from the market in mid-November. The good news is that, judging by the early access beta test that ran over the penultimate August weekend, we’re definitely getting what we expect from a Modern Warfare title: quasi-authentic boots-on-the-ground military action with a slight tactical edge. The weapons and general gunplay are highly effective, from default assault rifle, the Han 86 – a classic CoD beginner’s gun with decent fire rate and handling – to the bullet-spraying Nightshade SMG and the absolutely lethal KG-7 Vulcan sniper rifle. They all feel good to hold and fire, and there’s enough balance to let you experiment with slightly more offbeat numbers like the burst-fire Hyeon AR and the possibly overpowered Mar-9 marksman rifle. body.zh: 玩家将从新的 CoD 游戏中获得他们所期望的东西：具有轻微战术优势的实地军事行动。但所有的干扰是怎么回事呢？今年的《使命召唤》有很多亮点，这是一场不可避免的第一人称射击盛宴，自 2003 年以来，它一直在秋季发布时间表中投掷手榴弹。上一期《黑色行动 7》与之前的游戏相比表现不佳，迫使动视公司向粉丝们发表了半道歉的声明。这并不是《现代战争 4》面临的唯一挑战：还有一款新的独立射击游戏《Wardogs》，它给人的感觉介于经典 CoD 和经典战地之间。然后，潜伏在地平线上的《侠盗猎车手 6》（Grand Theft Auto 6），戴着镜罩和一辆异国情调的跑车，它肯定会在 11 月中旬粉碎并吸引市场的所有注意力（和金钱）。好消息是，从八月倒数第二个周末进行的早期测试来看，我们肯定得到了我们对《现代战争》游戏的期望：准真实的实地军事行动，具有轻微的战术优势。武器和一般枪战都非常有效，从默认的突击步枪 Han 86（一款经典的 CoD 初学者枪，具有不错的射速和操控性）到子弹喷射的 Nightshade SMG 和绝对致命的 KG-7 Vulcan 狙击步枪。它们握持和开火的感觉都很好，而且有足够的平衡性让你可以尝试稍微另类的数字，比如连发的 Hyeon AR 和可能被压倒的 Mar-9 射手步枪。继续阅读...

It slithers across floors, winds around furniture, steals things and slaps anyone within reach – finally answering the question nobody asked: what if your own arm turned to crime? As Toot Games co-founder Matthew Jackson puts it: “You are the bad thing that happens to the people.” Continue reading...

title.en: TikTok to pay $400m to US in one of largest child privacy settlements
title.zh: TikTok 将向美国支付 4 亿美元，这是最大的儿童隐私和解协议之一

summary.en: The deal stems from a 2024 lawsuit alleging TikTok and its parent company ByteDance collected "vast amounts of data" on millions of users under the age of 13.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
TikTok has agreed to pay $400m (£293m) to the US to end a lawsuit alleging its platform violated children‘s privacy, marking one of the largest ever settlements over the issue.

The deal stems from a 2024 suit by the Department of Justice under former President Joe Biden alleging TikTok and its parent company ByteDance collected "vast amounts of data" on millions of users under the age of 13.

Doing so was against the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA), a federal law enacted in 2000. It is the same law that dozens of US states are now suing Meta over .

"Children and parents are better protected today than they were when this case began," assistant Attorney General Brett Shumate said.

Other companies to have paid penalties to the US government for COPPA violations include Google's YouTube, which in 2019 paid $170m, and Epic Games, which in 2022 paid $275m.

Meta is also now facing penalties that could exceed hundreds of billions of dollars stemming from COPPA violations alleged by attorneys general of 29 US states. A jury trial in the lawsuit started this week , with the Instagram and Facebook owner accused of targeting child users and profiting from them.

While the TikTok lawsuit predates last year's split of TikTok's US business and operations from its original base of China, the settlement only involves TikTok's operations in China.

ByteDance, which is a privately held company, was most recently valued by investors at $550bn , external .

Under the terms of the deal, TikTok and ByteDance will immediately pay the DOJ $300m. It will pay another $100m when the government vacates a 2019 consent decree , external with the Federal Trade Commission.

As part of the agreement, the predecessor to ByteDance, Musical.ly, was required to pay a $5.7m fine for COPPA violations and ensure it sought parental consent for any user aged under 13.

The justice department did not detail on Friday any action against TikTok beyond the fine. But the department noted that since it sued the platform, TikTok has "undergone significant changes," including to its ownership, privacy practices and platform controls for young users.

When the lawsuit was filed, attorneys for the US said there were more than 170 million teenagers using TikTok and that the app was "directed to children." Yet, it did not effectively gauge the age of users or get parental consent for use from those underage.

In 2024, former President Biden pushed for TikTok to be either banned, or have the company divest its US operations. President Donald Trump went on to support divestment of the app, which occurred last year.

Its US operations are now 81% owned by a consortium of investors, while Bytedance maintains a 19% stake.
body.zh: TikTok 同意向美国支付 4 亿美元（2.93 亿英镑），以结束指控其平台侵犯儿童隐私的诉讼，这是该问题有史以来最大的和解协议之一。 该交易源于前总统乔·拜登领导下的司法部于 2024 年提起的诉讼，指控 TikTok 及其母公司字节跳动收集了数百万 13 岁以下用户的“大量数据”。 这样做违反了 2000 年颁布的联邦法律《儿童在线隐私保护法》(COPPA)。美国数十个州现在正在通过同一法律起诉 Meta。 助理司法部长布雷特·舒马特（Brett Shumate）表示：“与此案开始时相比，今天的儿童和家长受到了更好的保护。” 其他因违反 COPPA 行为而向美国政府支付罚款的公司包括谷歌旗下的 YouTube（2019 年支付了 1.7 亿美元）和 Epic Games（2022 年支付了 2.75 亿美元）。 美国 29 个州总检察长指控 Meta 因违反 COPPA 规定而面临可能超过数千亿美元的处罚。该诉讼的陪审团审判于本周开始，Instagram 和 Facebook 所有者被指控针对儿童用户并从中获利。 虽然 TikTok 诉讼早于去年 TikTok 的美国业务和业务从其原来的中国基地剥离出来，但和解协议仅涉及 TikTok 在中国的业务。 字节跳动是一家私营公司，最近投资者的外部估值为 5500 亿美元。 根据交易条款，TikTok 和字节跳动将立即向司法部支付 3 亿美元。当政府撤销 2019 年联邦贸易委员会的同意令时，它将再支付 1 亿美元。 作为协议的一部分，字节跳动的前身 Musical.ly 需要因违反 COPPA 规定而支付 570 万美元的罚款，并确保其为所有 13 岁以下的用户征求家长的同意。 周五，除了罚款之外，司法部没有详细说明针对 TikTok 采取的任何行动。但该部门指出，自起诉该平台以来，TikTok“经历了重大变化”，包括其所有权、隐私做法和对年轻用户的平台控制。 提起诉讼时，美国律师表示，有超过 1.7 亿青少年使用 TikTok，并且该应用程序“针对儿童”。然而，它并没有有效地衡量用户的年龄，也没有获得未成年人使用的父母同意。 2024 年，前总统拜登推动禁止 TikTok，或者让该公司剥离其美国业务。唐纳德·特朗普总统继续支持去年撤资该应用程序。 其美国业务目前由一个投资者财团持有 81% 的股份，而字节跳动则保留 19% 的股份。

summary.en: Although mobiles blared in public are nothing new, this crop of headphone-dodging irritants are truly maddening. It’s time to take them on ‘Interesting cities can’t be quiet”, runs one of grime DJ and music industry thinker Elijah’s epigrams – and in its essential spirit, he is...

body.en: Although mobiles blared in public are nothing new, this crop of headphone-dodging irritants are truly maddening. It’s time to take them on ‘Interesting cities can’t be quiet”, runs one of grime DJ and music industry thinker Elijah’s epigrams – and in its essential spirit, he is right. Silent, tidy, prim cities should be treated with suspicion. Any such atmosphere denotes that something has gone wrong at a macro level: either you’ve wound up in an authoritarian regime or, worse, Switzerland. But not all urban sounds are created equal, and some are more unwelcome than others. Take the tide of (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube) reels crashing on the shores of our collective attention on public transport, thanks to the astonishing number of grown adults who think it’s OK to surf the slopwave without headphones. Dan Hancox is a writer and editor covering music, politics and cities. His latest book is Multitudes: How Crowds Made the Modern World Continue reading...
body.zh: 尽管手机在公共场合大声喧哗并不是什么新鲜事，但这种躲避耳机的刺激物确实令人抓狂。 Grime DJ 和音乐产业思想家 Elijah 的警句之一是，现在是时候让他们“有趣的城市不能安静”了，从本质上讲，他是对的。安静、整洁、古板的城市应该受到怀疑。任何这样的气氛都表明宏观层面出了问题：要么你陷入了独裁政权，要么更糟糕的是瑞士。但并不是所有的城市声音都是一样的，有些城市声音比城市声音更不受欢迎。丹·汉考克斯 (Dan Hancox) 是一位涵盖音乐、政治和城市的作家和编辑，他的最新著作《群体如何创造现代世界》让我们对公共交通产生了集体关注。

body.en: Henry Astor looked back to his grandfather’s time for the inspiration to find older varieties that could help nature on his Cotswold farm It is the earliest harvest Henry Astor can remember. But walking through the scorched wheatfields of his Cotswolds farm, signs of life are everywhere – swarms of insects, kaleidoscopic wildflower meadows, bushy hedgerows several metres wide. A yellowhammer perches on a nearby tree. There are 18 other red-listed birds on the farm, says Astor, who this year ringed 23 barn owls, three kestrels, two little owls as well as goshawk chicks. “Last winter we had clouds of goldfinch, chaffinch and greenfinch,” he says. Britain has lost 73 million birds since 1970 ; but at Bruern Farms, a small but welcome reversal is taking shape. Continue reading...
body.zh: 亨利·阿斯特 (Henry Astor) 回顾祖父时代，寻找灵感，在他的科茨沃尔德 (Cotswold) 农场寻找可以帮助大自然的老品种。这是亨利·阿斯特 (Henry Astor) 记忆中最早的收获。但走过科茨沃尔德农场烧焦的麦田时，生命的迹象随处可见——成群的昆虫、万花筒般的野花草地、几米宽的浓密树篱。一只黄锤栖息在附近的一棵树上。阿斯特说，农场里还有其他 18 只被列入红色名录的鸟类，今年他圈养了 23 只仓鸮、三只红隼、两只小猫头鹰以及苍鹰雏鸟。 “去年冬天，我们看到了金翅雀、苍头燕雀和绿翅雀的云彩，”他说。自1970年以来，英国已经失去了7300万只鸟类；但在布鲁恩农场，一个虽小但值得欢迎的逆转正在形成。继续阅读...

Excess mortality in three of the EU’s larger countries – Germany, France and Spain – alone has already exceeded 25,000, according to the provisional national figures, and experts say the toll will rise significantly once August totals are consolidated. summary.en: ARBOREK, West Papua, Indonesia — “Rockhead fish, salamander fish, starfish and coral.” That’s what dozens of children from Arborek, a small island in Indonesia’s Raja Ampat archipelago, said when asked what they see in nature that is yellow and orange. The children rattled off...

body.en: ARBOREK, West Papua, Indonesia — “Rockhead fish, salamander fish, starfish and coral.” That’s what dozens of children from Arborek, a small island in Indonesia’s Raja Ampat archipelago, said when asked what they see in nature that is yellow and orange. The children rattled off the fish and other marine life they encounter when they play in the sea, during a reading of a children’s book about Raja Ampat and the threat of nickel mining. A coral reef and marine life in the waters off Raja Ampat in Southwest Papua province, Indonesia. Image courtesy of Econusa. Research suggests that children who grow up closely connected to their surroundings can develop sophisticated understandings of their local environment. A 2014 study of children in 22 villages in Indonesian Borneo, for example, found that they recognized relationships among forests, rivers, wildlife and other environmental changes. So Sekar Bestari, the book’s illustrator, wasn’t surprised by the children’s answers. “Most of the time when we read the books to children, they understand them, so don’t underestimate children’s knowledge,” she said after the reading in Arborek. “We’re not surprised anymore today.” The reading was part of a three-day gathering of Indigenous communities in Arborek that brought together representatives from 20 Indigenous subtribes in Raja Ampat, as well as Indigenous people from other parts of Indonesia and abroad. The gathering, organized by Greenpeace Indonesia and local NGO Institut USBA, was intended to strengthen solidarity among Indigenous communities in protecting their lands, waters and biodiversity. summary.en: WICHABAI, Guyana — At sunrise in Guyana’s South Rupununi, Leroy Ignacio stops beside a tree scored with large claw marks. The animal responsible was a giant anteater. “They even rub their backs on the trunk to leave a scent behind,” says Ignacio, president of the South Rupununi...

body.en: WICHABAI, Guyana — At sunrise in Guyana’s South Rupununi, Leroy Ignacio stops beside a tree scored with large claw marks. The animal responsible was a giant anteater. “They even rub their backs on the trunk to leave a scent behind,” says Ignacio, president of the South Rupununi Conservation Society (SRCS), as he demonstrates the motion. Indigenous researchers had long observed anteaters (Myrmecophaga tridactyla) climbing and marking trees, behaviors previously documented by scientists only in isolated cases. Working with four Indigenous communities, SRCS placed cameras at trees identified by locals. The resulting 883 recorded visits suggested the solitary animals use the trees to communicate. For nearly a quarter-century, SRCS has built a multi-community approach to conservation grounded in traditional knowledge. Its members are villagers, farmers and teachers who work with participating communities to research wildlife, develop conservation guidelines and teach local ecology. Before SRCS, Indigenous-led conservation in the Rupununi was mostly in the form of scattered projects and traditional stewardship by Makushi and Wapichan communities. But the discovery of an endangered bird, the red siskin (Spinus cucullatus), gave several South Rupununi communities a reason to organize across village boundaries. A flock of red siskins in Upper Takutu-Upper Essequibo, Guyana. Image by Nick Athanas via Flickr (CC BY-NC-SA 2.0). A multi-community movement It all began with a scientific trip, recounts Ignacio. In 2000, researchers from the Smithsonian and the University of Kansas, both in the U.S., came to the South Rupununi to survey birds. title.en: Xokleng Indigenous people plant thousands of critically endangered pine in Brazil
title.zh: Xokleng 原住民在巴西种植了数千棵极度濒危的松树

summary.en: The Xokleng Indigenous people of Santa Catarina state of southern Brazil have planted nearly a 100,000 seedlings of a critically endangered native tree, Mongabay contributor Letícia Klein reported. The Brazilian pine (Araucaria angustifolia), or araucária, can grow more than 50...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自受造栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: The Xokleng Indigenous people of Santa Catarina state of southern Brazil have planted nearly a 100,000 seedlings of a critically endangered native tree, Mongabay contributor Letícia Klein reported. The Brazilian pine (Araucaria angustifolia), or araucária, can grow more than 50 meters (164 feet) tall and has a straight trunk with a broad crown of branches near its top. Araucária pine forests historically covered large swathes of southern Brazil, but their range declined by roughly 97% in the last century. “Just as our pine is endangered, my people are also endangered, and consequently our language and culture are endangered,” Carl Gakran, executive director of the Zág (pronounced zā) Institute, told Klein. The institute was founded in conjunction with Isabel Gakran, his wife, to organize and expand the replanting effort. Carl Gakran began the restoration effort in 2016 after he learned that the Brazilian pine was listed as critically endangered by the IUCN Red List, the global conservation authority. He initially planned to grow just 10 trees on his own property. But the idea gained traction with the community, and they began the project the following year. Araucária pine trees produce edible nuts called pinhão, a staple food in the culinary tradition of southern Brazil. They are also eaten by at least another 22 animal species. Project organizers and volunteers harvest the seeds but leave at least 40% behind for wildlife. “Following our elders’ knowledge, we speak to the seeds, explain what’s happening, and perform harvest rituals. We harvest 60%, no more…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 据 Mongabay 撰稿人 Letícia Klein 报道，巴西南部圣卡塔琳娜州的 Xokleng 土著人民已经种植了近 10 万株极度濒危本土树苗。巴西松 (Araucaria angustifolia) 或南洋杉，可长到 50 米（164 英尺）高，树干笔直，顶部附近有宽阔的枝冠。南洋杉森林历史上覆盖了巴西南部的大片地区，但其范围在上个世纪减少了约 97%。 “正如我们的松树濒临灭绝一样，我的人民也面临着危险，因此我们的语言和文化也受到了威胁，”扎格（发音为 zā）研究所执行主任卡尔·加克兰 (Carl Gakran) 告诉克莱因。该研究所是与他的妻子伊莎贝尔·加克兰 (Isabel Gakran) 共同创立的，旨在组织和扩大重新种植工作。卡尔·加克兰 (Carl Gakran) 得知巴西松被全球保护机构 IUCN 红色名录列为极度濒危物种后，于 2016 年开始了修复工作。他最初计划在自己的土地上只种植 10 棵树。但这个想法得到了社区的关注，他们在第二年开始了这个项目。南洋杉树生产称为 pinhão 的可食用坚果，这是巴西南部烹饪传统中的主食。至少另外 22 种动物也吃它们。项目组织者和志愿者收获种子，但至少留下 40% 的种子给野生动物。 “按照我们长辈的知识，我们与种子交谈，解释发生了什么，并进行收获仪式。我们收获了 60%，仅此而已……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

title.en: Did you know forests can save themselves?
title.zh: 您知道森林可以自救吗？

summary.en: Did you know forests can save themselves? (With a little help from us, of course). Turns out, trees can be super valuable apart from being used for timber. Their seeds, nuts, leaves, bark, and more are natural commodities… and have the potential to prevent logging, support local...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自受造栏目的新闻，重点涉及受造之物关怀与环保责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Did you know forests can save themselves? (With a little help from us, of course). Turns out, trees can be super valuable apart from being used for timber. Their seeds, nuts, leaves, bark, and more are natural commodities… and have the potential to prevent logging, support local communities, and protect the health of our precious ecosystems. These are called non-timber forest products (aka NTFPs). In this 4-part series with @therainforester and Mongabay, we explore the ways that harvesting sustainably from our forests can keep them alive! Follow along for more episodes.This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 您知道森林可以自救吗？ （当然，需要我们的一点帮助）。事实证明，树木除了用作木材之外，还具有极高的价值。它们的种子、坚果、叶子、树皮等都是天然商品……并且有潜力防止伐木、支持当地社区并保护我们宝贵的生态系统的健康。这些被称为非木材林产品（又名 NTFP）。在这个由 @therainforester 和 Mongabay 合作的 4 部分系列中，我们探索了如何从森林中可持续采伐来维持森林的生存！敬请关注更多剧集。本文最初发表于 Mongabay

body.en: Peter J McKosky celebrates the return of the river otter after a century to New York, but notes that hundreds are violently killed in traps every year elsewhere in the state Your report on the river otter’s return to New York City’s Bronx River after a century’s absence ( 19 August ) is genuinely wonderful news – proof that patient ecological restoration works. But it sits uneasily alongside a fact rarely mentioned: New York state still permits the trapping and killing of hundreds of river otters every year, purely for recreation. State wildlife data shows an average annual toll of around 900 otters , sometimes over 1,100, killed in body-gripping and leg-hold traps designed to crush, hold, drown or kill by force. Otters are recognised as an indicator species – their presence signals genuine ecosystem health. There is no overpopulation crisis and, with the fur trade in serious decline, barely an economic rationale left. What remains is the recreational interest of a small minority of trappers. Continue reading...
body.zh: 彼得·J·麦科斯基 (Peter J McKosky) 庆祝河獭在一个世纪后重返纽约，但他指出，在该州其他地方，每年都有数百只河獭在陷阱中被暴力杀害。您关于河獭在缺席一个世纪后重返纽约市布朗克斯河的报告（8 月 19 日）确实是一个好消息，证明耐心的生态恢复是有效的。但它与一个很少被提及的事实令人不安：纽约州每年仍然允许捕获和杀死数百只水獭，纯粹是为了娱乐。州野生动物数据显示，每年平均有约 900 只水獭（有时超过 1,100 只）死于旨在压碎、抓住、淹死或强行杀死的夹体和夹腿陷阱。水獭被认为是指示物种——它们的存在标志着真正的生态系统健康。不存在人口过剩危机，而且随着毛皮贸易的严重下滑，几乎没有任何经济理由可言。剩下的只是少数捕猎者的娱乐兴趣。继续阅读...

body.en: The conservationist Harry Green was a naturalist of the amateur school, with an encyclopedic knowledge of British wildlife based on a lifetime in the field. Though born and brought up in Oxfordshire, he spent the whole of his adult life in his adopted county of Worcestershire. Harry, who has died aged 92, remembered being kept awake during the second world war by calling corncrakes in the meadows near his home. Later he strove, against the odds, to save Britain’s last colony of marsh warblers near Pershore. These, and the corncrakes, eventually vanished, but other species, such as hobbies, little egrets and Cetti’s warblers, did arrive and thrive. Continue reading...
body.zh: 自然资源保护主义者哈里·格林（Harry Green）是一位业余博物学家，凭借在该领域的一生，对英国野生动物有了百科全书式的了解。尽管他在牛津郡出生和长大，但他的整个成年生活都是在他收养的伍斯特郡度过的。已去世 92 岁的哈利记得，在第二次世界大战期间，他因在家附近的草地上叫玉米秧鸡而无法入睡。后来，他克服重重困难，努力拯救英国珀肖尔附近最后的沼泽莺群。这些鸟和玉米秧鸡最终消失了，但其他物种，如白鹭、小白鹭和塞蒂莺，确实出现并繁衍生息。继续阅读...

title.en: One of the World's ‘Most Wanted’ Lost Fish Is Rediscovered
title.zh: 世界上最想要的一种丢失的鱼被重新发现

summary.en: On a vast network of rivers flowing through the jungles of Papua New Guinea, researchers have rediscovered the spinach pipefish, a relative of the seahorse, which had not been recorded in more than 40 years. The fish has long been sought after by conservationists, who feared it...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自受造栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
On a vast network of rivers flowing through the jungles of Papua New Guinea, researchers have rediscovered the spinach pipefish, a relative of the seahorse, which had not been recorded in more than 40 years. The fish has long been sought after by conservationists, who feared it had gone extinct.

On an expedition that unfolded like a search for a missing person, researchers spent two weeks traversing the Sepik River and its tributaries, scouring villages and markets for evidence of the missing pipefish. They showed its photo to fishers, vendors, and village elders and asked where it might be found.

The task was daunting. The Sepik River extends across 700 miles of forests, floodplains, and wetlands along the northern coast of Papua New Guinea. “Travel is almost entirely by motorized boat or canoe, often taking many hours between villages,” said Jerrica Agebigo of the New Guinea Binatang Research Centre. The vast scale of the river system meant that scientists were heavily reliant on local knowledge.

In interviews, villagers consistently reported spotting a long, slender fish in the shallows of the Sepik River. Though they called the fish many names — Karuweng , Inap , Karuwena , Sako — their descriptions matched the profile of the missing species.

In the final days of the expedition, a fisher named Helen Asu managed to nab two pipefish using the handheld net she relied on to catch prawns. Researchers shared photos of her catch with Australian ichthyologist Gerald Allen, one of the last researchers to document the spinach pipefish in the 1980s. He confirmed the rediscovery.

“It makes my heart sing to hear that the spinach pipefish has been recorded anew,” said marine biologist Amanda Vincent, who chairs an expert group on seahorses, pipefishes, and seadragons for the International Union for Conservation of Nature. “To learn that the spinach pipefish still exists gives us hope that other ‘lost’ species are out there, too.”

The spinach pipefish had been named one of the 10 “most wanted” lost freshwater fish species by SHOAL, a U.K. conservation group. Its rediscovery highlights the urgency of protecting freshwater fish, the group said.

In interviews throughout the expedition, villagers reported declines of native fish, which are imperiled by mining, logging, and other threats. Globally, freshwater fish are under growing pressure. A recent U.N. report found that over the last half-century, populations of migratory freshwater fish have declined by 81 percent.
body.zh: 在流经巴布亚新几内亚丛林的广阔河流网络中，研究人员重新发现了菠菜尖嘴鱼，它是海马的近亲，这种鱼已有 40 多年没有记录。这种鱼长期以来一直受到自然资源保护者的追捧，他们担心它已经灭绝。 在一次像寻找失踪人员一样展开的探险中，研究人员花了两周时间穿越塞皮克河及其支流，在村庄和市场中搜寻失踪海龙鱼的证据。他们向渔民、商贩和村长展示了它的照片，并询问在哪里可以找到它。 这项任务是艰巨的。塞皮克河沿着巴布亚新几内亚北部海岸绵延 700 英里，横跨森林、洪泛区和湿地。新几内亚比纳唐研究中心的杰里卡·阿格比戈 (Jerrica Agebigo) 说：“旅行几乎完全依靠机动船或独木舟，在村庄之间通常需要花费很多小时。”河流系统规模庞大，意味着科学家严重依赖当地知识。 在采访中，村民们一致表示在塞皮克河的浅滩上发现了一条细长的鱼。尽管他们给这种鱼起了很多名字——Karuweng、Inap、Karuwena、Sako——但他们的描述与失踪物种的概况相符。 在探险的最后几天，一位名叫海伦·阿苏的渔民用她用来捕虾的手持网成功捕获了两条海龙。研究人员与澳大利亚鱼类学家杰拉尔德·艾伦 (Gerald Allen) 分享了她捕获的照片，杰拉尔德·艾伦是 20 世纪 80 年代最后记录菠菜尖嘴鱼的研究人员之一。他证实了这一重新发现。 国际自然保护联盟海马、海龙和海马专家组主席、海洋生物学家阿曼达·文森特 (Amanda Vincent) 表示：“听到菠菜海龙鱼被重新记录下来，我的心在歌唱。” “了解到菠菜尖嘴鱼仍然存在，让我们希望其他‘消失’的物种也在那里。” 菠菜尖嘴鱼被英国保护组织 SHOAL 评为 10 种“最想要”消失的淡水鱼类之一。该组织表示，它的重新发现凸显了保护淡水鱼的紧迫性。 在整个探险过程中的采访中，村民们报告说，由于采矿、伐木和其他威胁，本地鱼类数量减少。在全球范围内，淡水鱼面临着越来越大的压力。联合国最近的一份报告发现，在过去的半个世纪里，洄游淡水鱼的数量减少了 81%。

title.en: Country diary 1926: Amorous impulse sends insects on a nuptial flight

summary.en: 27 August 1926: Air-pilots report seeing wasps and small green flies almost a mile-high in the sky The report by experienced air-pilots of a wasp at 6,000 feet and small green flies – probably aphides – at 4,000 should make us realise how little we know of the habits of the...
