body.en: 27 August 1926 : Air-pilots report seeing wasps and small green flies almost a mile-high in the sky The report by experienced air-pilots of a wasp at 6,000 feet and small green flies – probably aphides – at 4,000 should make us realise how little we know of the habits of the common creatures which we, boastfully, think we understand. Who would imagine that a wasp could ascend so high! It has proved that it can, but what did it go up for? A certain town-tip that I pass occasionally is a great place for wasps; they swarm over the rags, paper, tins, and rubbish of all kinds, and undoubtedly find much that for their grubs is fattening food in what man has thrown away as useless. Probably the old meat and fruit tins, jam pots too, are mines of treasure for these busy wasps. But surely no wasp expects to find a town-tip up in the sky, nor can it be worth the labour of ascent to that altitude in the hope of finding winged game, though the wasp is an excellent fly-catcher. The mother or queen wasps are busy laying eggs, so that cannot have tempted a drone to seek a mate in the upper air. Nuptial flight may explain the swarm of green flies at a great height; many insects ascend when they are stirred by amorous impulse, and high flight must influence distribution. A strong wind would carry them far from their original home, and doubtless many insect hordes are swept out to sea and trouble us no more. Continue reading...
body.zh: 1926 年 8 月 27 日：飞行员报告称在几乎一英里高的天空中看到了黄蜂和小绿蝇。经验丰富的飞行员报告称在 6,000 英尺高空发现了黄蜂，在 4,000 英尺高处发现了小绿蝇（可能是蚜虫），这应该让我们意识到，我们对这些我们自以为了解的常见生物的习性知之甚少。谁能想到黄蜂能飞得这么高！事实证明可以，但是它涨起来是为了什么？我偶尔经过的某个城镇尖端是黄蜂的好地方。它们成群结队地爬过破布、纸张、罐头盒和各种垃圾，毫无疑问，它们在人类丢弃的无用物品中发现了许多让它们的幼虫增肥的食物。对于这些忙碌的黄蜂来说，旧的肉类和水果罐头、果酱罐可能都是宝藏。但毫无疑问，没有黄蜂期望在天空中找到城镇的顶端，也不值得为了寻找有翅膀的猎物而费力爬到那个高度，尽管黄蜂是出色的捕蝇者。黄蜂妈妈或蜂王正忙于产卵，因此不可能诱使雄蜂在高空寻找配偶。婚飞或许可以解释为什么绿蝇会飞到很高的地方。许多昆虫在受到爱情冲动的刺激时就会上升，高飞必然会影响分布。一阵强风会将它们吹离原来的家园，毫无疑问，许多昆虫群会被卷入大海，不再打扰我们。继续阅读...

title.en: Rising CO2 Speeds the Growth of Grasses on the African Savanna
title.zh: 二氧化碳浓度上升加速了非洲稀树草原上的草的生长

summary.en: On the arid African savanna, grasses are growing faster than they were a generation ago, boosted by rising levels of carbon dioxide from the burning of fossil fuels. That is the finding of a new study that warns that faster growth could fuel larger wildfires and alter the...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自受造栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
On the arid African savanna, grasses are growing faster than they were a generation ago, boosted by rising levels of carbon dioxide from the burning of fossil fuels. That is the finding of a new study that warns that faster growth could fuel larger wildfires and alter the distribution of wildlife.

Since the dawn of the industrial age, the amount of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere has grown by half, which is helping to speed photosynthesis and cause many plants to grow faster. The phenomenon, known as “carbon fertilization,” has been well documented in forests , and some experts believe it may be responsible for the greening of drylands around the globe.

It was long assumed, however, that grasses on the African savanna gain little from the extra carbon dioxide, as they already employ a highly efficient form of photosynthesis. But researchers are now finding otherwise. An analysis of three decades of data gathered from experiments and observations across Kruger National Park in South Africa shows that rising carbon dioxide levels are prompting faster growth.

Between 1989 and 2021, grass production rose by 28 percent, a shift that could not be explained by changes in rainfall, temperature, grazing, fire, or other drivers, according to the study , which was published in Nature . Researchers say that extra carbon dioxide is allowing grasses to use water more efficiently, which is helping them to grow more quickly, even through dry spells. Modeling suggests that savanna grasses will continue to benefit from the surplus carbon dioxide even as warming intensifies heat and drought.

The faster growth brings new risks, however. Researchers say more grass means more fuel for wildfires. It also means more forage, which could boost the number of grazing animals. And there is no guarantee that the additional carbon drawn down by grasses will stay locked away.

“The wider impact depends on where the extra grass ends up,” said lead author Kimberley Simpson, an ecologist at the University of Sheffield. “If it is eaten by animals or burned in fires, much of the carbon is quickly released back into the atmosphere.”
body.zh: 在干旱的非洲大草原上，由于化石燃料燃烧产生的二氧化碳含量不断上升，草类的生长速度比上一代人更快。这是一项新研究的发现，该研究警告说，更快的生长可能会引发更大的野火并改变野生动物的分布。 自工业时代到来以来，大气中的二氧化碳含量增加了一半，这有助于加速光合作用，使许多植物生长得更快。这种被称为“碳施肥”的现象在森林中已有详细记录，一些专家认为它可能是全球旱地绿化的原因。 然而，长期以来人们一直认为非洲大草原上的草从额外的二氧化碳中获得的很少，因为它们已经采用了高效的光合作用形式。但研究人员现在发现并非如此。对南非克鲁格国家公园三十年来的实验和观察收集的数据的分析表明，二氧化碳水平的上升正在促进更快的生长。 根据发表在《自然》杂志上的这项研究，1989 年至 2021 年间，草产量增加了 28%，这一变化无法用降雨、温度、放牧、火灾或其他驱动因素的变化来解释。研究人员表示，额外的二氧化碳可以让草更有效地利用水，从而帮助它们生长得更快，即使在干旱时期也是如此。模型表明，即使气候变暖加剧了炎热和干旱，稀树草原草仍将继续受益于过剩的二氧化碳。 然而，更快的增长带来了新的风险。研究人员表示，更多的草意味着更多的野火燃料。这也意味着更多的草料，这可能会增加食草动物的数量。并且不能保证草吸收的额外碳会被锁住。 “更广泛的影响取决于多余的草最终去了哪里，”谢菲尔德大学生态学家金伯利·辛普森说。 “如果它被动物吃掉或在火中燃烧，大部分碳会很快释放回大气中。”

title.en: Filipino Cacao Growers Learn to Live With a Hotter Climate
title.zh: 菲律宾可可种植者学会如何适应炎热的气候

summary.en: In “Chocolates Melting Away” — the First-Place Winner of the 2026 Yale Environment 360 Film Contest — Breech Asher Harani explores how cacao growers in the Philippines are developing new techniques to protect their crops from increasingly turbulent weather. Read more on E360 →
summary.zh: 这是一则来自受造栏目的新闻，重点涉及管家责任、供应与公共福祉。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
In “Chocolates Melting Away” — the First-Place Winner of the 2026 Yale Environment 360 Film Contest — Breech Asher Harani explores how cacao growers in the Philippines are developing new techniques to protect their crops from increasingly turbulent weather.

In the Philippines, ideal growing conditions for cacao have fueled an industry with a market value of more than $400 million. In the Davao region, on the island of Mindanao, growers tend trees, harvest fruits, and produce premium chocolates for the domestic market. But climate change, which has brought drought, floods, more humidity, and extreme heat to the region, has presented growers with serious challenges.

Based in Davao, filmmaker Breech Asher Harani set out to document the concerns of cacao farmers at two artisanal operations and speak with agricultural researchers about the industry’s efforts to adapt to changing conditions. Farmers demonstrated how they use intercropping, produce fertilizers from agricultural waste to increase yields and quality, and employ innovative irrigation systems to minimize water loss.

Subscribe to the E360 Newsletter for weekly updates delivered to your inbox. Sign Up .

“These farmers are very well versed when it comes to climate mitigation strategies and sustainable farming techniques,” Harani says, noting that he never sensed a feeling of hopelessness among growers. Not only do the cacao farmers seem “ready to face the battle,” Harani says, “they are also ready to show others what they are doing so their methods can be replicated.”

Harani hopes his film elevates the importance of farmers, “whose hard work sustains our everyday needs,” and that viewers will feel motivated to take action against climate change, “which is already reshaping what we eat.”

About the Filmmaker: Breech Asher Harani is a filmmaker and artist whose work spans narrative, documentary, experimental, and animated forms. In 2019, he was named a JCS International Young Creatives awardee at the International Emmy Awards, and was subsequently listed on Forbes Asia’s 30 Under 30 for the Arts. Harani is the first recipient of a Climate and Labor Film Grant, awarded jointly by the Pulitzer Center, the Financial Times , and One World Media.

About the Contest: Now in its 13th season, the Yale Environment 360 Film Contest honors the year’s best environmental documentary shorts from around the world. This year we received 596 submissions from more than 80 countries across six continents, with the winners selected by the editors of Yale Environment 360 .
body.zh: 在 2026 年耶鲁环境 360 度电影大赛一等奖《巧克力融化》中，Breech Asher Harani 探讨了菲律宾的可可种植者如何开发新技术来保护作物免受日益动荡的天气影响。 在菲律宾，理想的可可生长条件催生了一个市场价值超过 4 亿美元的产业。在棉兰老岛的达沃地区，种植者照料树木、收获水果，并为国内市场生产优质巧克力。但气候变化给该地区带来了干旱、洪水、湿度增加和极端高温，给种植者带来了严峻的挑战。 总部位于达沃的电影制作人布里奇·阿舍·哈拉尼 (Breech Asher Harani) 着手记录两个手工作业中可可种植者的担忧，并与农业研究人员讨论该行业为适应不断变化的条件所做的努力。农民们展示了如何利用间作、利用农业废弃物生产肥料来提高产量和质量，以及如何采用创新的灌溉系统来最大限度地减少水的流失。 订阅 E360 新闻通讯，每周更新发送到您的收件箱。报名 。 哈拉尼说：“这些农民非常精通气候缓解策略和可持续农业技术。”他指出，他从未在种植者中感受到绝望的感觉。哈拉尼说，可可种植者似乎不仅“准备好面对这场战斗”，“他们还准备向其他人展示他们正在做的事情，以便他们的方法可以被复制。” 哈拉尼希望他的电影能够提升农民的重要性，“他们的辛勤工作维持着我们的日常需求”，并且观众会感到有动力采取行动应对气候变化，“这已经在重塑我们的饮食。” 关于电影制片人：布里奇·阿舍·哈拉尼 (Breech Asher Harani) 是一位电影制片人和艺术家，其作品涵盖叙事、纪录片、实验和动画形式。 2019年，他被评为国际艾美奖JCS国际青年创意奖获得者，随后入选福布斯亚洲30位30岁以下艺术精英。哈拉尼是第一位获得气候与劳工电影奖的获奖者，该奖由普利策中心、英国《金融时报》和同一个世界媒体联合颁发。 关于大赛：耶鲁环境 360 度电影大赛现已进入第 13 季，旨在表彰来自世界各地的年度最佳环境纪录片短片。今年，我们收到了来自六大洲 80 多个国家的 596 份参赛作品，获奖者由耶鲁环境 360 的编辑选出。

title.en: A London Scheme to Cut Car Pollution Restored Lung Growth in Children
title.zh: 伦敦一项旨在减少汽车污染的计划恢复了儿童肺部的生长

summary.en: A controversial scheme aimed at slashing car pollution in Central London was a boon to children in the area, whose lungs grew faster after the program was launched, researchers found. Read more on E360 →
summary.zh: 这是一则来自受造栏目的新闻，重点涉及受造之物关怀与环保责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A controversial scheme aimed at slashing car pollution in Central London was a boon to children in the area, whose lungs grew faster after the program was launched, researchers found.

Established in 2019, the Ultra Low Emission Zone initially covered around 8 square miles in Central London. To drive in the zone, owners of older, more polluting cars, buses, and trucks would have to pay a daily fee, equal to around $17 for most drivers, with fines for those who skirted the fee. The scheme led to a steep drop of nitrogen dioxide pollution, which is known to impede lung growth.

To study the impact on children, researchers followed more than 3,400 students, between the ages of 6 and 9, at schools in Central London and in the town of Luton, roughly 30 miles away. Between 2018 and 2022, they regularly measured the lung volume of each child.

Before the emissions scheme was introduced, researchers found, children in London had stunted lung growth. But within five years of the program’s launch, they saw a turnaround. While exposure to pollution fell in both Central London and Luton over that period, in Central London it fell by more than twice as much. And as pollution dropped, the lungs of the children in London grew faster, until they had caught up with children in Luton.

The findings have significant health implications, as children without fully developed lungs are at greater risk of asthma and other health disorders. As pollution fell in Central London, researchers found, the proportion of children with impaired lung function also dropped, from 14 percent to 9 percent. The research was published in The Lancet Public Health .

U.K. Health Minister Karin Smyth said the study “is a powerful reminder of the impact that air quality has on children’s lung health, and will help to improve our understanding of how reductions in air pollution can restore normal lung growth among children, reduce the risk of respiratory illnesses in adulthood, and support our goal to give every child the best start in life.”

The Ultra Low Emission Zone was expanded in 2021 and again in 2023, and now covers all of Greater London. Under the scheme, officials estimate, levels of roadside nitrogen dioxide have fallen by 27 percent across London, while deaths linked to toxic air have dropped by 40 percent .

Despite its effect on pollution, the zone has proved highly controversial, sparking widespread protests over the fees and vandalism. Londoners have damaged or stolen hundreds of the more than 3,700 cameras installed citywide to monitor traffic.
body.zh: 研究人员发现，一项旨在减少伦敦市中心汽车污染的有争议的计划对该地区的儿童来说是一个福音，他们的肺部在该计划启动后生长得更快。 超低排放区成立于 2019 年，最初覆盖伦敦市中心约 8 平方英里的区域。要在该区域内开车，旧的、污染更严重的汽车、公共汽车和卡车的车主必须支付每日费用，对于大多数司机来说约为 17 美元，对那些逃避费用的人将处以罚款。该计划导致二氧化氮污染急剧下降，众所周知，二氧化氮污染会阻碍肺部生长。 为了研究对儿童的影响，研究人员跟踪了伦敦市中心和大约 30 英里外卢顿镇学校的 3,400 多名 6 至 9 岁的学生。 2018年至2022年间，他们定期测量每个孩子的肺容量。 研究人员发现，在排放计划推出之前，伦敦儿童的肺部发育受到阻碍。但在该计划启动后的五年内，他们看到了转变。在此期间，伦敦市中心和卢顿的污染暴露程度均有所下降，但伦敦市中心的污染暴露程度下降了两倍多。随着污染的下降，伦敦儿童的肺部生长得更快，直到赶上了卢顿的儿童。 这些发现具有重大的健康影响，因为肺部发育不完全的儿童患哮喘和其他健康疾病的风险更大。研究人员发现，随着伦敦市中心污染的减轻，肺功能受损的儿童比例也从 14% 下降到 9%。该研究发表在《柳叶刀公共卫生》上。 英国卫生部长卡琳·史密斯表示，这项研究“有力地提醒我们空气质量对儿童肺部健康的影响，并将有助于加深我们对减少空气污染如何恢复儿童肺部正常生长、降低成年后患呼吸道疾病的风险的理解，并支持我们为每个孩子提供最好的人生开端的目标。” 超低排放区于 2021 年和 2023 年再次扩大，目前已覆盖整个大伦敦地区。官员们估计，根据该计划，伦敦路边二氧化氮浓度下降了 27%，而与有毒空气相关的死亡人数下降了 40%。 尽管该区域对污染产生了影响，但事实证明该区域极具争议性，引发了对收费和破坏行为的广泛抗议。全市安装的 3,700 多个监控交通摄像头中，有数百个被伦敦人损坏或被盗。

The film, directed by Tom Stern, combines archival footage, animation, puppetry, and reenactments, and features...

body.en:
By providing your information, you agree to our Terms of Use and our Privacy Policy . We use vendors that may also process your information to help provide our services. This site is protected by reCAPTCHA Enterprise and the Google Privacy Policy and Terms of Service apply.

Sumerian Pictures has acquired North American rights to “ Butthole Surfers: The Hole Truth and Nothing Butt ,” a salute to the trailblazing American rock band, The Butthole Surfers.

The film is directed by Tom Stern and combines archival footage, animation, puppetry, and reenactments featuring the band. In addition, Richard Linklater, Flea, Dave Grohl, John Paul Jones, Henry Rollins, and Ice-T are interviewed about a group that was known for combining psychedelia, punk and grunge with energetic, anti-establishment, often chaotic live shows.

“Tom Stern and team are taking us on a wild ride and we are excited to bring audiences to the incredible story of these punk icons,” Rob Williams, president of Sumerian Pictures, said. Related Stories New York City’s East Side Will Lose Yet Another Movie Theater with Imminent Closure of AMC Kips Bay Indie Star Joe Swanberg Never Really Left — but He’s Definitely Back Now

Sumerian is a newcomer to the indie distribution scene , but it turned heads with its acquisition of the 2026 Sundance Grand Jury Prize and Audience Award winner, “Josephine,” starring Channing Tatum and Gemma Chan. The film is seen as a potential awards season player .

Though it only got into the film business last year, its parent company Sumerian has been in the music and publishing game for 20 years. Recent and upcoming Sumerian Pictures films include Louis Paxton’s comedy, “The Incomer”; the romantic comedy “Mile End Kicks,” directed by Chandler Levack; and “Horsegirls,” directed by Lauren Meyering.

“The Butthole Surfers are one of the most mind-blowing stories in rock history. Our goal was to make a film that captured their essence, so the ecstatic reactions of film festival audiences have been deeply gratifying,” Stern said. “I’m thrilled Sumerian has joined forces with us to bring this experience to an ever wider audience.”

Williams negotiated the deal on behalf of Sumerian with Dan Braun and Matt Burke from Submarine. Winner of the SXSW “Best in Texas” award, the documentary audience award at the Philadelphia Film Festival, and the grand jury prize for best documentary at the Independent Film Festival Boston, “Butthole Surfers: The Hole Truth and Nothing Butt” has been entertaining audiences at festivals around the country prior to its theatrical release this week as part of exclusive event engagements at Drafthouse Cinema....
body.zh: 提供您的信息，即表示您同意我们的使用条款和隐私政策。我们使用的供应商也可能处理您的信息以帮助提供我们的服务。本网站受 reCAPTCHA Enterprise 保护，并适用 Google 隐私政策和服务条款。 Sumerian Pictures 已获得《Butthole Surfers: The Hole Truth and Nothing Butt》的北美版权，这是向开拓性的美国摇滚乐队 The Butthole Surfers 致敬。 这部电影由汤姆·斯特恩执导，结合了乐队的档案镜头、动画、木偶和重演。此外，理查德·林克莱特 (Richard Linklater)、Flea、戴夫·格罗尔 (Dave Grohl)、约翰·保罗·琼斯 (John Paul Jones)、亨利·罗林斯 (Henry Rollins) 和 Ice-T 接受了采访，谈论了一个以将迷幻、朋克和垃圾摇滚与充满活力、反体制、常常混乱的现场表演相结合而闻名的乐队。 Sumerian Pictures 总裁罗布·威廉姆斯 (Rob Williams) 表示：“汤姆·斯特恩和他的团队正在带领我们踏上一段疯狂的旅程，我们很高兴能让观众了解这些朋克偶像的令人难以置信的故事。”相关故事随着 AMC Kips Bay 即将关闭，纽约东区将失去另一家电影院 独立明星乔·斯旺伯格 (Joe Swanberg) 从未真正离开过，但他现在肯定回来了 Sumerian 是独立发行领域的新人，但凭借查宁·塔图姆 (Channing Tatum) 和嘉玛·陈 (Gemma Chan) 主演的《约瑟芬》(Josephine) 获得 2026 年圣丹斯评审团大奖和观众奖得主，引起了人们的关注。该片被视为颁奖季的潜在选手。 尽管去年才涉足电影业务，但其母公司 Sumerian 已涉足音乐和出版行业 20 年。最近和即将上映的 Sumerian Pictures 电影包括路易斯帕克斯顿的喜剧《收入者》；钱德勒·莱瓦克 (Chandler Levack) 执导的浪漫喜剧《Mile End Kicks》；以及劳伦·迈耶林执导的《女骑士》。 “《屁眼冲浪者》是摇滚史上最令人兴奋的故事之一。我们的目标是制作一部捕捉其精髓的电影，因此电影节观众的欣喜若狂的反应非常令人满意，”斯特恩说。 “我很高兴 Sumerian 与我们联手，将这种体验带给更广泛的受众。” 威廉姆斯代表 Sumerian 与 Submarine 的丹·布劳恩 (Dan Braun) 和马特·伯克 (Matt Burke) 谈判了这笔交易。 《Butthole Surfers: The Hole Truth and Nothing Butt》获得了 SXSW“德克萨斯州最佳”奖、费城电影节观众纪录片奖以及波士顿独立电影节最佳纪录片评审团大奖，在本周影院上映之前，作为 Drafthouse Cinema 独家活动的一部分，《Butthole Surfers: The Hole Truth and Nothing Butt》一直在全国各地的电影节上为观众带来欢乐。

title.en: Marching in the Dark review – rural Indian widows show stunning resilience as they battle poverty and taboos
title.zh: 《在黑暗中行进》影评：印度农村寡妇在与贫困和禁忌作斗争中展现出惊人的韧性

summary.en: Kinshuk Surjan's documentary "Marching in the Dark" highlights the struggles of rural Indian widows in Maharashtra, a state with high farmer suicide rates. These women face severe financial hardship and social taboos after their husbands, often burdened by debt, take their own lives.
summary.zh: Kinshuk Surjan的纪录片《在黑暗中行进》讲述了印度马哈拉施特拉邦农村寡妇的困境，该邦农民自杀率很高。这些妇女在丈夫因债务自杀后，面临严重的经济困难和社会禁忌。

body.en: Kinshuk Surjan’s documentary follows women in dire financial straits whose bereavement compounds their social plight, which they confront together Out in rural India, a crisis casts a dark cloud over the seemingly tranquil vistas of wheat fields and soy farms. Over the past 20 years, more than 400,000 farmers have killed themselves , beset by mounting debts and low market prices for crops. Shot in Maharashtra, the state with the highest rate of farmer suicides in India, Kinshuk Surjan’s documentary sensitively captures another tragedy that lingers after death: left behind by their dead husbands, generations of grieving widows struggle to find their way in a society still burdened by patriarchal values. Sanjivani, a woman in her 30s, is one such case. Eight years after her husband killed himself, she has taken over some of the farming responsibilities, along with other odd jobs, to provide for her two children. The camera rarely finds her at rest; Sanjivani not only works in the fields but also performs domestic labour for her extended family – cooking, cleaning and doing laundry. Her resilience is stunning to witness, but even more impressive is the emotional support provided by a tight-knit network of other widows. Together, the women gather for counselling sessions where they can freely discuss their emotional, physical and financial issues. Continue reading...
body.zh: 金舒克·苏尔詹 (Kinshuk Surjan) 的纪录片讲述了陷入严峻经济困境的妇女的故事，她们的丧亲之痛加剧了她们的社会困境，她们共同面对在印度农村，一场危机给看似平静的麦田和大豆农场蒙上了一层乌云。过去 20 年来，超过 40 万农民因债务增加和农作物市场价格低迷而自杀。金舒克·苏尔詹 (Kinshuk Surjan) 的纪录片在印度农民自杀率最高的马哈拉施特拉邦拍摄，敏感地捕捉到了另一场死后挥之不去的悲剧：一代又一代悲伤的寡妇被死去的丈夫抛在身后，在仍然受父权价值观困扰的社会中挣扎着寻找出路。 30多岁的女性桑吉瓦尼（Sanjivani）就是这样的例子。在她丈夫自杀八年后，她承担了部分农活以及其他零工，以养活两个孩子。镜头很少能拍到她休息的样子。桑吉瓦尼不仅在田里干活，还为她的大家庭做家务劳动——做饭、打扫卫生和洗衣服。她的韧性令人惊叹，但更令人印象深刻的是其他寡妇组成的紧密网络所提供的情感支持。妇女们聚集在一起参加咨询会议，自由讨论她们的情感、身体和财务问题。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Kinshuk Surjan's documentary powerfully portrays the immense suffering of rural Indian widows in Maharashtra, who are left to navigate extreme poverty and social stigma after their husbands' suicides. Yahweh's ancient call to "plead the widow's cause" reminds us of the divine heart for those marginalized and oppressed by societal structures and tragic...
reflection.zh: Kinshuk Surjan的纪录片有力地描绘了马哈拉施特拉邦农村寡妇的巨大苦难，她们在丈夫自杀后，不得不面对极度贫困和社会污名。雅伟“为寡妇辩护”的古老呼召，提醒我们神对那些被社会结构和悲惨境遇边缘化和压迫的人的心意。这部电影是一个深刻的提醒，要我们寻求公义，捍卫弱势群体，确保没有人会在最黑暗的时刻被遗忘。

verse.textEn: Learn to do right; seek justice. Defend the oppressed. Take up the cause of the fatherless; plead the case of the widow.
verse.textZh: 学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的；给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇辨屈。

title.en: Disciples review – fresh-faced boys are sucked into a nightmare of extremism in India
title.zh: 《门徒》影评——印度稚嫩少年被卷入极端主义噩梦

summary.en: A prestigious school in the holy city of Varanasi and its controversial, dogmatic teachings are the subject of this shocking documentary The effect of political and religious indoctrination on young minds resembles a slow-release poison. Unfolding in observational vignettes,...
summary.zh: 这部令人震惊的纪录片以圣城瓦拉纳西一所著名学校及其备受争议的教条式教学为主题。政治和宗教灌输对年轻人思想的影响，犹如慢性毒药。影片通过观察式的小片段展开，...

body.en: A prestigious school in the holy city of Varanasi and its controversial, dogmatic teachings are the subject of this shocking documentary The effect of political and religious indoctrination on young minds resembles a slow-release poison. Unfolding in observational vignettes, Pankaj Johar and Sunaina Kapoor’s thought-provoking documentary centres on Vidya Mutth, a prestigious Hindu school in the holy city of Varanasi, India, where sectarian beliefs are drilled into its students, all in the name of cultural preservation. The film opens with controversial speeches made by the school’s spiritual leader, Guru Avimuktesh, who advocates the abolition of religious freedom, and for Indian Muslims to either convert to Hinduism or leave for Pakistan. A prominent Hindu figure with a large following, he personally oversees the entrance exam, a sequence captured in dynamic handheld shots. While boys take the test, their parents look on with apprehension and anxiety; to be accepted would be an honour, not only for their child but for the whole family. Continue reading...
body.zh: 这部令人震惊的纪录片以圣城瓦拉纳西的一所著名学校及其备受争议的教条主义教义为主题。政治和宗教灌输对年轻人的影响就像一种缓慢释放的毒药。潘卡吉·乔哈尔 (Pankaj Johar) 和苏奈娜·卡普尔 (Sunaina Kapoor) 这部发人深省的纪录片以观察性的小片段展开，以印度圣城瓦拉纳西的一所著名的印度教学校维迪亚·穆特 (Vidya Mutth) 为中心，学校以文化保护的名义向学生灌输宗派信仰。影片以学校精神领袖阿维穆克泰什 (Guru Avimuktesh) 发表的颇具争议的演讲开始，他主张废除宗教自由，并要求印度穆斯林要么皈依印度教，要么前往巴基斯坦。他是一位拥有大量追随者的著名印度教人物，亲自监督入学考试，整个过程由动态手持镜头捕捉。当男孩参加考试时，他们的父母在一旁忧心忡忡地看着；被录取将是一种荣幸，不仅是他们的孩子，也是整个家庭。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The documentary "Disciples" starkly illustrates the profound influence of early education, showing how young boys in Varanasi are shaped by dogmatic teachings. Proverbs 22:6 reminds us that the way a child is trained profoundly impacts their future path, highlighting the lasting consequences when education fosters division rather than wisdom. This film...
reflection.zh: 纪录片《门徒》深刻揭示了早期教育的巨大影响，展现了瓦拉纳西的稚嫩少年如何被教条主义教义所塑造。箴言22:6提醒我们，孩子所受的训练将深刻影响他们未来的道路，突显了当教育助长分裂而非智慧时所带来的持久后果。这部电影警示我们，塑造年轻心灵责任重大，孩子们很容易受到可能导致“极端主义噩梦”的意识形态的影响。

verse.textEn: Start children off on the way they should go, and even when they are old they will not turn from it.
verse.textZh: 教养孩童，使他走当行的道，就是到老他也不偏离。

title.en: ‘We’re barely above porn’: why would a film-maker choose to make a deliberately bad ‘mockbuster’?
title.zh: “我们几乎比色情片好不了多少”：为什么电影制作人会选择制作一部故意拍得很烂的“恶搞电影”？

summary.en: Filmmaker Anthony Frith directed a low-budget "mockbuster" in six days for the studio behind Sharknado, then created a documentary about the experience. The article discusses the critical reception of his intentionally "bad" film.
summary.zh: 电影制作人安东尼·弗里斯为《鲨卷风》背后的工作室，仅用六天时间执导了一部低成本的“恶搞电影”，随后又制作了一部关于这次经历的纪录片。文章探讨了评论界对这部他有意为之的“烂片”的评价。

body.en: With a tiny budget and six days, Anthony Frith directed a film for the studio behind Sharknado – and then made Mockbuster, a documentary about the experience Directors don’t tend to appreciate having their films eviscerated by critics. And us critics, well practised in lobbing proverbial grenades from the safety of our pretentiously book-lined, Cahiers du Cinéma-strewn offices, don’t tend to look an artist in the eyes and tell them that their work sucks. This is, however, exactly what I do to the Australian film-maker Anthony Frith. I’ve even prepared a zinger for the occasion. “Your film is a lemon that’s been eaten by a turkey then dumped into a vat of curdled mayonnaise,” I say. Continue reading...
body.zh: 安东尼·弗里斯 (Anthony Frith) 用有限的预算和六天的时间为《Sharknado》背后的工作室执导了一部电影，然后制作了《Mockbuster》，这是一部讲述导演们不喜欢自己的电影被评论家挖空的经历的纪录片。而我们的影评人，在我们自命不凡的书籍林立、电影手册散布的办公室里，熟练地投掷众所周知的手榴弹，不会倾向于直视艺术家的眼睛，告诉他们他们的作品很糟糕。然而，这正是我对澳大利亚电影制片人安东尼·弗里斯所做的。我什至还为这个场合准备了一杯辛格酒。 “你的电影是一个被火鸡吃掉的柠檬，然后倒入一桶凝结的蛋黄酱中，”我说。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Anthony Frith's commitment to directing a film in just six days, even a "mockbuster" that he knew would face harsh criticism, highlights the intrinsic value of effort. Colossians 3:23 reminds us to work heartily, as for Yahweh and not for men, suggesting that the dignity of our labor comes from our intention and dedication, not solely from the outcome or...
reflection.zh: 安东尼·弗里斯仅用六天时间执导一部电影，即便他知道这部“恶搞电影”会面临严厉批评，他的这种投入精神突显了努力的内在价值。歌罗西书3:23提醒我们，无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给雅伟做的，不是给人做的。这表明我们劳动的尊严源于我们的意图和奉献，而不仅仅是结果或评论界的赞誉。这种视角能将最非传统或看似“糟糕”的项目，转化为有意义的努力。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: How the mob took Hollywood: the story of organized crime and the movies
title.zh: 黑帮如何掌控好莱坞：有组织犯罪与电影的故事

summary.en: Hollywood Crime Story: The Mob Takes Over the Movies looks back at how criminals insinuated themselves in the film business “From the foundation of Hollywood, organized crime is there.” So claims Tom Patterson, producer and director of new three-part documentary series,...
summary.zh: 纪录片《好莱坞犯罪故事：黑帮掌控电影业》回顾了犯罪分子如何渗透电影业。该三部曲纪录片的制片人兼导演汤姆·帕特森称：“从好莱坞创立之初，有组织犯罪就已存在。”

body.en: Hollywood Crime Story: The Mob Takes Over the Movies looks back at how criminals insinuated themselves in the film business “From the foundation of Hollywood, organized crime is there.” So claims Tom Patterson, producer and director of new three-part documentary series, Hollywood Crime Story: The Mob Takes Over the Movies. Organized crime’s connection to the film industry actually predates Tinseltown, being present for the foundation of the medium itself, when inventor Thomas Edison sicced his hired goons on competitors in an attempt to maintain total control over early motion picture technology. As covered in Hollywood Crime Story, this resulted in said competitors – mostly Jewish businessmen from the east coast – fleeing westward and establishing the town and studio system that would become synonymous with movies as we know them. Continue reading...
body.zh: 《好莱坞犯罪故事：黑帮接管电影》回顾了犯罪分子如何潜入电影行业“从好莱坞的根基开始，有组织的犯罪就在那里。”新的三集纪录片系列《好莱坞犯罪故事：黑帮接管电影》的制片人兼导演汤姆·帕特森如是说。有组织犯罪与电影业的联系实际上早于好莱坞，当时发明家托马斯·爱迪生（Thomas Edison）为了保持对早期电影技术的完全控制，而雇佣了暴徒来对付竞争对手，这一点就为电影本身奠定了基础。正如《好莱坞犯罪故事》中所报道的那样，这导致上述竞争对手（主要是来自东海岸的犹太商人）向西逃亡，并建立了城镇和制片厂系统，该系统将成为我们所知的电影的代名词。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The documentary "Hollywood Crime Story" reveals how organized crime, driven by the pursuit of wealth and power, embedded itself in the film industry from its very beginning, even with figures like Thomas Edison using "hired goons." This historical account reminds us that the love of money can indeed be a root of all kinds of evil, corrupting even creative...
reflection.zh: 纪录片《好莱坞犯罪故事》揭示了有组织犯罪如何从电影业的早期，甚至从托马斯·爱迪生使用“雇佣打手”开始，就因对财富和权力的追求而渗透其中。这个历史记载提醒我们，贪爱钱财确实是万恶之根，它能腐蚀社会中富有创造力和影响力的领域。这凸显了在面对非法利益的诱惑时，保持正直所需的持续警惕。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.en: Mourinho review – if he didn’t want to open up, maybe he shouldn’t have starred in a docuseries …
title.zh: 穆里尼奥影评——如果他不想敞开心扉，也许他就不该出演纪录片……

summary.en: Football manager José Mourinho stars in a three-parter from the creators of Bros: After the Screaming Stops. Don’t expect it to be quite so entertaining … Among his previous credits, the director of this mini-series Joe Pearlman can count the revelatory and hilarious 2018 film,
summary.zh: 足球经理何塞·穆里尼奥主演了一部三集纪录片，由《兄弟：尖叫停止后》的创作者制作。别指望它会那么有趣……这部迷你剧的导演乔·珀尔曼之前的作品包括2018年那部揭露性十足又滑稽的电影，

body.en: Football manager José Mourinho stars in a three-parter from the creators of Bros: After the Screaming Stops. Don’t expect it to be quite so entertaining … Among his previous credits, the director of this mini-series Joe Pearlman can count the revelatory and hilarious 2018 film, Bros: After the Screaming Stops . That documentary worked brilliantly because its subjects seemed so sweetly but devastatingly lacking in discretion or self-awareness that everything they said landed like a line from a Christopher Guest parody. They couldn’t help themselves. In terms of a character study, storied football manager José Mourinho is a very different kettle of cold fish. Like the Goss twins, he takes himself very seriously indeed, but that’s pretty much where the similarities end. He’s something of a closed book. “You are pushing me to speak about myself,” he says, towards the end of the final part of this series. “And I don’t want to.” Which is fair enough but it does beg the question: why then, would you agree to be the subject of an in-depth three part documentary series? Mourinho is on Netflix Continue reading...
body.zh: 足球经理何塞·穆里尼奥在《兄弟：尖叫停止之后》创作者制作的三部曲中担任主演。别指望它会这么有趣……在这部迷你剧的导演乔·皮尔曼 (Joe Pearlman) 之前的作品中，可以数 2018 年的一部具有启发性和搞笑性的电影《兄弟：尖叫停止后》。这部纪录片取得了出色的效果，因为它的主题看起来如此甜蜜，但严重缺乏判断力或自我意识，以至于他们所说的一切都像克里斯托弗·盖斯特（Christopher Guest）戏仿中的台词一样。他们无法自拔。就性格研究而言，传奇足球经理何塞·穆里尼奥是一个非常不同的冷鱼。和戈斯双胞胎一样，他确实非常认真地对待自己，但相似之处也仅此而已。他就像一本合上的书。 “你迫使我谈论我自己，”他在本系列最后一部分的结尾说道。 “而我不想。”这很公平，但它确实引出了一个问题：那么，为什么你会同意成为一个深入的三部分纪录片系列的主题呢？穆里尼奥在 Netflix 上继续阅读...

reflection.en: José Mourinho's documentary is critiqued for his unwillingness to truly open up, despite the public platform it offers. This reminds us that fame and public attention, like a refiner's fire, test a person's true character, revealing what lies beneath the surface. When given a stage, our authenticity is often put to the test, showing whether we are willing...
reflection.zh: 穆里尼奥的纪录片因他不愿真正敞开心扉而受到批评，尽管它提供了一个公共平台。这提醒我们，名声和公众关注，如同炼金的炉火，考验着一个人的真实品格，揭示其表象之下的本质。当我们被赋予一个舞台时，我们的真诚往往会受到考验，展现我们是否愿意被真实地了解。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: Monsters of God review – a messy feud between rival reptile smugglers gets the Tiger King treatment
title.zh: 《上帝的怪物》影评：一场爬行动物走私犯之间的混乱恩怨，获得“虎王”式待遇

summary.en: A new documentary, "Monsters of God," explores the underworld of the animal trade through the lens of a messy feud between rival reptile smugglers. Director Eric Goode presents two figures whose intense rivalry and accusations are compared to the popular "Tiger King" series, highlighting the dramatic and often absurd...
summary.zh: 一部名为《上帝的怪物》的新纪录片，通过两位敌对爬行动物走私犯之间混乱的恩怨，探讨了动物贸易的地下世界。导演埃里克·古德呈现的这两个人物，他们之间激烈的竞争和相互指控被比作热门剧集《虎王》，揭示了这个非法世界中戏剧性且往往荒谬的冲突。

body.en: Director Eric Goode has found two enemies to rival Joe Exotic and Carole Baskin in his new documentary about the animal trade’s underworld Through the fear and general miasma of the Covid pandemic, TV brought people together like never before. Among the most-watched series of 2020 was of course Tiger King, Netflix’s hit about an improbably twisty feud between a gay, polyamorous big-cat breeder and convicted felon, and the conservationist rival whom he accused of murder (more specifically, of feeding her missing husband to the tigers in her sanctuary – which she denies). It was the perfect hit for quarantine: bold and ridiculous enough to get everyone talking, and with precisely no bearing on the grief and awfulness that was all around. Producer and co-director Eric Goode has made a smattering of Tiger King follow-ups since then, as well as another series, Chimp Crazy, about the self-described Dolly Parton of the primate world. His latest project – a co-production between his own outfit, Goode Films, HBO, and A24 – continues the theme, focusing this time on the reptile trade and taking its lead from the 2008 book The Lizard King by journalist Bryan Christy. It’s stuffed full of wild stories and even wilder characters: there are canny smugglers, underworld crime gangs, and even legitimate zoos that are said to have turned a blind eye to the provenance of their big, scaly friends. The series is centred on the US – although clearly the supply chain is global – and the two men who kickstarted the illegal trade: Hank Molt and copycat trader Tommy Crutchfield. Like Joe Exotic and Carole Baskin before them, there is no love lost between Crutchfield and Molt, and no odd biographical detail too trivial to skip over. Hank, says Tommy, “will turn anything good into bad”, while Hank reckons that Tommy is “one of the angriest and most bitter people I’ve ever met”. Along the way we learn that Hank used to be a mayonnaise salesman, and that Tommy worked at an extremely on-the-nose Florida establishment named Snake-a-Torium as a teenager, where he would later have his wedding reception. What follows is the story not only of their enduring beef and betrayals, but of other adjacent vendettas in the illicit reptilian market. Despite environmental concerns becoming increasingly en vogue in the late 60s, a “don’t ask, don’t tell” attitude still pervaded the world of wildlife trading, with many zoos happy to acquire what they needed from whoever happened to have it. There were, however, serious consequences for some of the creatures involved. With the police on his back, Molt once buried a stash of animals alive in New Jersey’s Pine Barrens, a location which would later become infamous via The Sopranos. When he was eventually arrested, Crutchfield would become the go-to...
body.zh: 导演埃里克·古德（Eric Goode）在他关于动物贸易黑社会的新纪录片中找到了两个可以与乔·异国情调（Joe Exotic）和卡罗尔·巴斯金（Carole Baskin）匹敌的敌人。在新冠疫情的恐惧和普遍的瘴气中，电视以前所未有的方式将人们聚集在一起。 2020 年收视率最高的剧集当然是《虎王》，这部 Netflix 热播剧讲述了一名同性恋、多角恋大型猫科动物饲养员和被定罪的重罪犯，以及他指控谋杀（更具体地说，将她失踪的丈夫喂给她庇护所里的老虎——她否认）的自然资源保护主义竞争对手之间的矛盾。这是隔离期间的完美打击：大胆而荒谬，足以让每个人都议论纷纷，却与周围的悲伤和可怕毫无关系。从那时起，制片人兼联合导演埃里克·古德制作了一些《虎王》的后续作品，以及另一部剧集《疯狂黑猩猩》，讲述了自称灵长类动物世界的多莉·帕顿的故事。他的最新项目——由他自己的公司 Goode Films、HBO 和 A24 联合制作——延续了这一主题，这次重点关注爬行动物贸易，并以记者 Bryan Christy 2008 年出版的《蜥蜴王》一书为主导。它充满了疯狂的故事，甚至更疯狂的人物：有精明的走私者、黑社会犯罪团伙，甚至还有据说对他们的大而有鳞的朋友的出处视而不见的合法动物园。该系列以美国为中心（尽管供应链显然是全球性的）以及发起非法贸易的两个人：汉克·莫尔特（Hank Molt）和模仿商人汤米·克拉奇菲尔德（Tommy Crutchfield）。就像之前的乔·异国情调和卡罗尔·巴斯金一样，克拉奇菲尔德和莫尔特之间没有失去爱情，也没有琐碎而无法跳过的奇怪的传记细节。汤米说，汉克“会把任何好事变成坏事”，而汉克认为汤米是“我见过的最愤怒、最痛苦的人之一”。一路上我们了解到，汉克曾经是一名蛋黄酱推销员，而汤米十几岁时曾在佛罗里达州一家名为 Snake-a-Torium 的非常引人注目的餐厅工作，后来他在那里举办了婚宴。接下来的故事不仅讲述了他们持久的争执和背叛，还讲述了非法爬行动物市场上其他相邻的仇杀。尽管环境问题在 20 世纪 60 年代末变得越来越流行，但“不问、不说”的态度仍然普遍存在于野生动物贸易领域，许多动物园乐于从碰巧拥有它们的人那里获得所需的东西。然而，这对一些涉及的生物造成了严重后果。莫尔特背着警察，曾在新泽西州的松林贫瘠之地活埋了一批动物，这个地方后来因《黑道家族》而臭名昭著。当他最终被捕时，克拉奇菲尔德将成为首选......

reflection.en: The documentary about rival reptile smugglers, likened to the "Tiger King" phenomenon, exposes a messy feud driven by intense rivalry and accusations. This kind of conflict often stems from a lack of humility, where individuals prioritize their own interests and perceived superiority. Yahweh calls us to a different path, urging us to value others above...
reflection.zh: 这部关于爬行动物走私犯之间激烈争斗的纪录片，被比作“虎王”现象，揭示了由强烈竞争和指控驱动的混乱恩怨。这种冲突往往源于缺乏谦卑，个人将自己的利益和自认为的优越感置于首位。雅伟呼召我们走一条不同的道路，敦促我们在分歧中也要看别人比自己强。

verse.textEn: Do nothing out of selfish ambition or vain conceit. Rather, in humility value others above yourselves.
verse.textZh: 凡事不可结党，不可贪图虚浮的荣耀；只要存心谦卑，各人看别人比自己强。
